prs.title: fix(coding-agent): warn when an npm package update leaves the installed version unchanged
prs.body:
## What was wrong

`pi update --extensions` first looks up the newest version of each npm package with `npm view`. If that version is newer than the installed one, pi runs `npm install <name>@latest`. The two commands read different registry documents, and each is cached separately. Shortly after a publish, `npm view` can already report the new version while `npm install` still resolves the old one. npm then exits successfully, pi prints "Updated packages", and the startup banner lists the same package again on the next launch. The user can't tell that nothing was actually updated.

## What the change does

- `shouldUpdateNpmSource` now returns the installed version and the registry version along with its decision. Both are carried on `NpmUpdateTarget`.
- After `npm install`, `updateNpmBatch` re-reads each package's installed version. If the registry lookup succeeded and the version did not change, it emits a `progress` event with the message: `<source> is still X (registry reports Y); npm registry metadata may be stale, try again in a few minutes`.
- The package CLI now prints `progress` events in yellow. Until now nothing emitted them.

Install behavior is unchanged: pi still installs `@latest`.

## Testing

- New test in `test/package-manager.test.ts`: two packages are flagged for update and only one is actually upgraded. The warning is emitted only for the unchanged one. The test fails without the change.
- `test/package-manager.test.ts` passes (129 tests), and `npm run check` passes.
- Ran the built CLI with an `npmCommand` stub whose `view` reports `1.0.1` and whose `install` changes nothing:
  ```
  Updating npm:demo-pkg...
  npm:demo-pkg is still 1.0.0 (registry reports 1.0.1); npm registry metadata may be stale, try again in a few minutes
  Updated packages
  ```

Fixes #11536

Requested by @davidbrai

prs.title: fix(ai): do not retry Zhipu usage limit errors (code 1308)
prs.body:
When a Zhipu/Z.ai (`open.bigmodel.cn`) plan hits its usage cap, the API returns HTTP 429 with error code `1308`. The cap resets after hours, but `isRetryableAssistantError()` still marked the error as retryable, because the bare `429` in the message matched the transient-error pattern. The agent-level retry then re-sent a request that could not succeed and slowed down the final error. With default settings that is 3 attempts, about 14 s.

This change adds the Zhipu `"code":"1308"` error code to the non-retryable provider-limit patterns in `packages/ai/src/utils/retry.ts`, next to the existing quota and subscription-limit entries. The pattern matches the JSON code field, not a bare number, so request IDs or byte counts that contain 1308 do not trigger it.

Not changed: the provider-level HTTP retry (`retry.provider.maxRetries`, off by default). It still retries every 429 based on the status code alone.

Testing:
- `npm run check` passes.
- `test/retry.test.ts` passes.
- Calling `isRetryableAssistantError` directly on the reported message, `429 {"code":"1308","message":"已达到 5 小时的使用上限。…"}`, returned `true` before the change and returns `false` after.

Fixes #11537

Requested by @davidbrai

prs.title: fix(tui): stop writing OSC 133 prompt markers in regular mode
prs.body:
In regular TUI mode, user and assistant messages wrote OSC 133 (`A`/`B`/`C`) shell-integration markers straight to the terminal. Terminals that display OSC 7501 program status (Rex, iTerm2 3.7.5+) read `133;A` as a new shell prompt and drop the current status. As a result, the `working` indicator disappeared right after a run started and only `done` showed up at the end. Fullscreen mode was not affected because it already strips these markers before writing.

## Change
- `TuiMainScreen.doRender()` (`packages/tui/src/tui-main-screen.ts`) now strips OSC 133 markers from the start of each rendered line before compositing and writing. It uses the same pattern as fullscreen (`OSC133_ZONE_PREFIX`).
- The message components still produce the markers. Fullscreen uses them internally for prompt navigation and already strips them before writing, so its behavior is unchanged.
- In regular mode, the terminal's own jump-to-prompt shortcuts no longer stop at pi messages (added in #1805).

## Testing
- New test in `packages/tui/test/tui-render.test.ts`: no `ESC]133;` reaches the terminal across a full render and a differential render, with both BEL and ST terminators. It fails without the change and passes with it.
- These pass:
  - `packages/tui` `npm test`
  - `test/user-message.test.ts` and `test/assistant-message.test.ts` in coding-agent
  - `npm run check`
- I ran `pi -ne --tui-mode regular` with `PI_PROGRAM_STATUS=1` and a streaming test provider, capturing all terminal output with `script`.
  - Before: `7501 working`, then repeated `133;A`/`133;B`/`133;C`, then `7501 done`.
  - After: only `7501 idle` → `working` → `done`, and no OSC 133.

Fixes #11519

Requested by @davidbrai

prs.title: fix(coding-agent): treat sessions in the sessions directory as default storage
prs.body:
`SessionManager.usesDefaultSessionDir()` returns false for a session in pi's own sessions directory whenever the session's cwd differs from the cwd its folder was named after. pi then treats that folder as a custom `--session-dir`.

Because of that:

- `/resume` → All lists only `--home-user-a--` instead of every project.
- The resume hint printed on exit adds `--session-dir ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-user-a--`.

Both callers of `usesDefaultSessionDir()` (the `/resume` All scope and `formatResumeCommand`) only need to know whether the session lives in pi's sessions directory or in a custom `--session-dir`. It now returns true when the session directory sits directly inside the sessions directory. A custom `--session-dir` or `sessionDir` outside that directory still returns false.

<-- agent -->

## Trace

1. A session is saved under `~/.pi/agent/sessions/--home-user-a--/` with cwd `/home/user/a`.
2. `/home/user/a` is deleted or moved. On resume, the missing-cwd prompt offers "continue in current cwd", and the user picks `/home/user/b`.
3. `SessionManager.open(file, undefined, "/home/user/b")` keeps `--home-user-a--` as the session directory. The default directory for cwd `/home/user/b` is `--home-user-b--`, so `usesDefaultSessionDir()` is false.

## Testing

- Added tests in `test/session-manager/file-operations.test.ts`:
  - a session reopened with another cwd reports default storage (this test fails on `main`)
  - a custom session directory does not
- `npm run check` and `./test.sh` pass.

prs.title: fix(coding-agent): let the SDK stream resolve auth for summaries
prs.body:
In sessions created by `createAgentSession`, compaction, branch summaries and bug-report summaries resolved the stored OAuth credential in `AgentSession._getSummarizationRequestAuth`, then passed the access token on as `options.apiKey`. The SDK's stream function calls `modelRuntime.streamSimple`, which resolves auth again. Because it was given an explicit `apiKey`, `resolveProviderAuth` took the API-key override branch instead of using stored OAuth. Built-in providers accept the token either way. A provider whose API-key path differs from its OAuth path, such as one that refuses explicit keys, failed every summary while normal prompts worked.

`createAgentSession` now marks its stream function with `markRuntimeStreamFunction`. This records it in a module-level `WeakMap` keyed by the function, mapped to its `ModelRuntime`. `_getSummarizationRequestAuth` skips pre-resolution when the agent's stream function is marked for the session's own runtime, so that runtime resolves auth once, as it does for normal prompts. The check runs after virtual-model routing. Bare `streamSimple` and custom `streamFn`s still receive resolved credentials, so the fixes for #6324 and #7579 are unchanged. If a caller replaces `agent.streamFunction`, the old behavior applies.

**Testing**
- Added `test/suite/regressions/11520-sdk-summary-oauth-auth.test.ts`. It builds an SDK session on a provider that has stored OAuth and also an API-key method, runs a branch summary, and asserts two things: no `getAuth` call carries an `apiKey` override, and the provider receives the OAuth access token. It fails without the change and passes with it.
- `npm run check` passes and `./test.sh` passes. I also ran the related tests: 6324 branch-summary auth, compaction model overrides, auto-compaction cancellation, SDK stream options, virtual models, and the compaction and branch-summary tests.
- Manual reproduction: an SDK script with an `openai` OAuth credential that logs `ModelRuntime.getAuth` during `navigateTree(..., { summarize: true })`. Before the change there were two calls, the second with `apiKey = <oauth token>`. After the change there is one call, with no override.

Fixes #11520

Requested by @badlogic

issues.title: [Channels] QQ Bot silently drops bot-authored messages, so bot-to-bot group conversation cannot be enabled
issues.body:
### What happened?

In group all-message mode (`groupAllPolicy: "all"` or `"keyword"`), the QQ channel drops every message whose author has `bot: true` — both group and direct messages — before it reaches the model. The only trace is a stderr line such as `[QQ:qq] Bot message dropped in group <group_openid>`; the agent never sees the message, and no configuration enables bot-to-bot traffic.

The guards sit in the three inbound handlers, so another Qwen Code bot cannot talk to this one in a shared group even when the operator configures `groupAllPolicy: "all"` together with `groups: {"*": {"requireMention": false}}`. The intended behavior is still documented a few lines away, where the message formatter says it deliberately does not hard-block bot messages and tags them with `[bot]` so the model can judge — that code is unreachable because the callers return first.

### What did you expect to happen?

Bot-authored messages should be delivered to the agent with a `[bot]` tag on the sender, and the model (together with the channel's existing wake/silence rules and `<noreply>`) should decide whether replying makes sense. That is what the formatter's comment describes, and it is the only way an operator can intentionally run bot-to-bot conversation.

### Client information

<details>
<summary>Client Information</summary>

- Qwen Code version: 0.26.1 local build (the guards are present on current `main` too)
- Channel: QQ Bot (`type: "qq"`), `groupAllPolicy: "all"`, `groups: {"*": {"requireMention": false}}`
- OS: Linux (aarch64)

</details>

### Login information

OpenAI-compatible provider configured through `modelProviders`.

### Anything else we need to know?

History: the hard block was introduced during the review rounds of the group-message PR (#6457) as an "infinite bot loop" defense. The same change kept a comment saying hard-blocking would prevent intentional bot-to-bot interactions that the operator explicitly configures, and that `[bot]` tagging was the design — the two sides were never reconciled, and a later review cleanup removed the tag path instead of restoring it. Happy to send a PR that restores `[bot]` tagging and lets the model decide.

issues.body:
The `web-shell E2E Smoke` lane fails deterministically right now at the same case on unrelated PRs, which means every PR pays a re-attribution round and none of them caused it.

## What fails

`client/e2e/web-shell.host-directory-picker.spec.ts:90` — `@smoke allows real interaction with a host-owned directory browser outside WebShell`:

```
Error: expect(locator).toBeVisible() failed
Locator: locator('[data-web-shell-dialog-title="Add Workspace"]')
Timeout: 20000ms
  - waiting for locator('[data-web-shell-dialog-title="Add Workspace"]')
```

Observed twice today on two different PRs and two different runners, same signature:

| Run job | PR | Runner | Time (UTC) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 123394314718 | #15684 | ecs-qwen-hz5-3 | 10:52 |
| 123416718925 | #15858 | ecs-qwen-hz5-15 | 11:43 |

Neither PR touches `packages/web-shell` — #15684 is managed-agent server-side, #15858 is a CI download-proxy fix — and both fail at the same locator with a 20 s visibility timeout, so this is a shared precondition, not either diff.

## Not ruled out (no main-side control yet)

main's own `Qwen Code CI` runs at `cc2a80e6`/`0815735b`/`2919258c` are green, but those heads predate today's web-shell merges (`#15831` interactive Generated UI views 15:55, `#13679` Session Overview 17:06, `#15315` workspace/session copy 17:05, `#15841` model-name preservation 17:48, `#15669` CUA 17:37). Whether one of them broke the Add Workspace dialog is unproven until a main run on a later head completes, or until someone runs the spec locally.

## Reproduction

```
cd packages/web-shell && npx playwright test client/e2e/web-shell.host-directory-picker.spec.ts -g "allows real interaction"
```

A pass locally but a timeout in CI would point at the runner's display/timing environment rather than the dialog itself; the two recent passes make timing regression just as plausible as a product break.

labels.name: category/core

labels.description: Roadmap: Session management features

labels.name: status/ready-for-human
labels.description: Specified but requires human judgment to implement; not suitable for an autonomous agent

issues.body:
### What would you like to be added?

One implementation of the agent loop in `packages/core`, used by every surface. The agent loop is the cycle that sends a prompt, streams the reply, runs the requested tools, sends their results back, and repeats until the model stops calling tools.

The shared loop is introduced behind one experimental setting and adopted one surface at a time:

- `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` is a boolean, `false` by default, and takes effect after a restart. `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1` overrides it for CI and scripted runs. Both follow the pattern of `experimental.agentTeam` / `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM`.
- At each surface's entry point the setting chooses between the shared loop and that surface's current loop. The current loop stays untouched as the `else` branch, so with the setting off a surface behaves exactly as it does today. Surfaces that have not moved yet ignore the setting.
- A surface moves only after a parity suite shows that, with the setting on, its model requests and its output match the current loop. Any difference must be listed and linked to an issue.
- Each surface changes its default on its own once it has moved, starting with headless, and drops its current loop one release later. A surface does not wait for the others. Send options that tell the client to skip part of its work for one host are transition steps. Each is listed in the design with the step that removes it, and a surface keeps its old default while it has one open.

This issue tracks that work. Each step is its own PR.

#### Today's loops (upstream `56733c35aa`)

| Surface | Loop | Model call | Tool execution |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ink TUI | `packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.ts` | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` | scheduler completion callback → `submitQuery(ToolResult)` |
| OpenTUI | `packages/cli/src/ui/opentui/live-session.ts` | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` | a new scheduler per batch |
| Headless `-p` and the stream-json SDK transport | `packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts`, with a second copy of the loop in the drain turn (`:2888-3066`) | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` | `executeToolCall` per call, which builds a `CoreToolScheduler` per call (`nonInteractiveToolExecutor.ts:75-96`), plus its own partitioning, in-flight cap and ordered finalize |
| ACP: Zed, VS Code companion, `qwen serve` / Web Shell, channels | `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.ts`, four loop bodies: main `:7534`, Stop continuation `:8420`, cron `:11463`, notifications `:12792` | `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` directly (`:9744-9751`) | its own executor, `runToolCalls` / `runTool` (`:13799-17842`) |
| Hosted Harness | `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-model.ts:828-1143` | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`, but fires 13 hook events itself (`:67-81`) | journaled sequential dispatch (`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`) |
| Subagents, background and forked agents, workflows, in-process teams | `packages/core/src/agents/runtime/agent-core.ts`: `_runReasoningLoopInner` (`:1016`) and `processFunctionCalls` (`:2023`) | `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` directly, parsing chunks itself | one `CoreToolScheduler` per round |
| Speculation | `packages/core/src/followup/speculation.ts` | `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` directly | runs tools directly, without the scheduler |

`LlmClient.sendMessageStream` runs one model request plus the continuations it owns: the Stop hook, steering at a model boundary and the next-speaker check. It never runs tools. So every surface writes its own "run the tools, send the results, repeat" part, and three loops skip `LlmClient` altogether.

#### Target

```text
Surfaces: Ink · OpenTUI · headless/SDK · ACP · AgentCore · speculation (Hosted evaluated last)
   │  input, event sink, approval responder, mid-turn input, surface policies
   ▼
Shared agent loop (packages/core)
   model round : LlmClient.sendMessageStream for a main session,
                 Turn over the agent's own LlmChat for subagents and speculation
   tool batch  : one whole-batch CoreToolScheduler per round
   after batch : duplicate handling → finalizeToolResponses → recording
                 → loop guards and reminders → mid-turn input → ToolResult continuation
   outcome     : a typed terminal reason, mapped by each surface
   ▼
LlmClient → Turn → LlmChat (unchanged)
```

- Approvals go through a responder the surface supplies: a dialog in the TUI, `session/request_permission` in ACP, `can_use_tool` for SDK clients, and auto-deny in plain headless.
- Each surface maps the terminal reason to its own result: an exit code, an ACP `stopReason`, an agent `terminateMode`, or UI state.
- Surface-specific behavior is a policy passed to the loop, not a fork of it. Examples: the `--max-tool-calls` pre-launch ticker, structured output, idle-time continuations (Goal, teammates, drain turns), model overrides, and the daemon tool-loop guards.
- An interface with a second implementation, such as the `Turn`-backed model round, is added in the PR that needs it, not up front.

#### Plan

- [x] Design document, English and Chinese: #15343
- [x] PR1: the shared loop, the setting, headless (`-p` and stream-json) on the shared loop, and the parity suite: #15369
  - [ ] headless default on
  - [ ] remove the current headless loop
- [ ] PR2: ACP sessions
  - [x] PR 2a: the model round of fresh user prompts on the shared round; ACP keeps its tool step: #15509
  - [x] PR 2b: the tool batch of those turns on the whole-batch scheduler; the daemon tool-loop guards become the client's guards plus a surface policy: #15627
  - [x] PR 2c-1: the stop point of those turns on the client's chain, with the Todo Stop Guard as an ordered stop policy; background results and queued input no longer continue a turn at its stop point; `stopHookRunByHost` removed: #15695
  - [ ] PR 2c-2: channel, Goal-proposal, retry, continue and restore turns: #15902
  - [ ] PR 2c-3: Goal turns
  - [ ] PR 2c-4: cron and background-notification turns
  - [ ] ACP default on, then remove its current loop
- [ ] PR3: Ink TUI, then default on and removal
- [ ] PR4: OpenTUI, then default on and removal
- [ ] PR5: AgentCore (subagents, background and forked agents, workflows), then default on and removal
- [ ] PR6: speculation, then default on and removal
- [ ] Hosted Harness: evaluated separately, after the other surfaces
- [ ] Remove the setting

Out of scope for this round:

- session-level scheduling, i.e. when notifications, cron jobs, Goal turns and teammate messages start a loop;
- the Hosted Harness until its separate evaluation;
- the provider layer and `LlmChat`;
- `CoreToolScheduler` internals beyond the hooks the loop needs;
- UI rendering and wire protocols.

### Why is this needed?

Every behavior that belongs to the loop has to be written once per surface, and the copies have drifted apart.

In the code (upstream `56733c35aa`):

- **The session turn cap has three formulas.**
  - `LlmClient` stops at `max > 0 && count > max` (`client.ts:4529-4531`).
  - Headless stops at `max >= 0 && count > max` (`nonInteractiveCli.ts:663`).
  - The Hosted Harness stops at `max > 0 && round >= max` (`hosted-harness-model.ts:841`).

  With `model.maxSessionTurns: 0`, headless stops at the first turn while the other two never stop.
- **Duplicate provider tool-call suppression is assembled four times**: `nonInteractiveCli.ts:1962`, `use-llm-stream.ts:3236`, `Session.ts:14086` and `agent-core.ts:2085`. The key falls back three different ways.
- **The tool concurrency cap is implemented four times**: `coreToolScheduler.ts:5465`, `nonInteractiveCli.ts:2264`, `Session.ts:14365` and `:17031`. ACP runs only consecutive Agent calls concurrently (`Session.ts:14234`), while the scheduler runs every concurrency-safe call concurrently.
- **`finalizeToolResponses` is called separately by six loops, and once more inside the scheduler.**
- **Mod tool checks reach only some surfaces.** `modToolCheck` is wired per surface and reaches Ink, OpenTUI and headless. ACP sessions have none, so Zed, VS Code and Web Shell don't get them either.
- **ACP bypasses `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`.**
  - It re-implements UserPromptSubmit, the Stop hook and its cap, MessageDisplay, file snapshots, plan/arena reminders, workflow intent, the session token gate and Goal permits.
  - It has no next-speaker check, no `maxSessionTurns`, and none of the content loop heuristics or late MCP/skill reminders.
  - Its comments say so: "duplicated from coreToolScheduler.ts" (`Session.ts:15721`), "Mirrors the core send path" (`:9547`), "Mirror of core's checkGlobalDuplicate" (`:1364`). Some of its cross-references already point at code that has moved (`:7375`, `:14600`).
- **The Hosted Harness fires 13 hook events itself** (`hosted-harness-model.ts:67-81`). It sends a blocking Stop hook's continuation as `ToolResult`; `LlmClient` sends it as `Hook`.

Defects found while comparing the loops are filed separately: #15324 (ACP writes an edit cut off by max_tokens), #15325 (a stream-json message past `--max-session-turns` returns success), #15326 (OpenTUI runs tool calls from a retried attempt and skips recording native results). Writing the parity suite also turned up #15365 (in stream-json, a message sent during startup runs before the first message), which is outside the loop.

Open issues that come from this split: #14114, #12209, #12020, #8542, #13851, #12113.

Every new loop-level behavior pays the same price. For example, the loop-protection reminders (#15016) had to be injected separately in `client.ts`, `agent-core.ts` and `Session.ts`.

### Additional context

**Related issues.**

- #8775 proposed unifying the session loops on a `Turn`-based runtime. Its inventory still holds on current main. This issue tracks a staged, opt-in way to carry that direction out.
- #10219 and #10078 make agent backends pluggable.
- #11695 separates where tools execute.

This issue changes neither of those. It only makes sure there is one loop for them to plug into.

**Verification.**

- `integration-tests/fake-openai-server.ts` already records every request body. The parity suite runs each scripted scenario on a surface twice, with the setting off and on.
- It compares two things: the normalized request sequence (what the model saw), and the surface's output (stream-json frames or ACP `session/update` notifications).
- First scenarios:
  - plain text, a single tool, and a parallel read-only batch;
  - mixed safe and unsafe calls;
  - approval allowed and denied;
  - cancel during a tool;
  - retry mid-stream and model fallback;
  - an output-truncated edit;
  - loop detection;
  - a blocking Stop hook;
  - `--max-tool-calls`, `maxSessionTurns` and structured output.

**Acceptance for the end state.**

| Measure | Today | Target |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Agent loop implementations | 7, plus the extra copies inside headless and ACP | 1 |
| Loops that call `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` directly | 3 | 0 |
| Loops that parse stream chunks outside `turn.ts` | 3 | 0 |
| Loops that call `finalizeToolResponses` | 6 | 1 |
| Session turn-cap formulas | 3 | 1 |

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

### 希望新增什么？

在 `packages/core` 中只保留一份 agent loop 实现，供所有入口共用。agent loop 指这样一个循环：发送提示、流式接收回复、执行模型请求的工具、把工具结果发回模型，直到模型不再调用工具为止。

共享 loop 通过一个实验性设置引入，并按入口逐个迁移：

- `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 是布尔值，默认 `false`，重启后生效。`QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_UNIFIED_AGENT_LOOP=1` 可以覆盖它，供 CI 和脚本化运行使用。两者沿用 `experimental.agentTeam` / `QWEN_CODE_ENABLE_AGENT_TEAM` 的写法。
- 每个入口在启动处根据该设置，选择共享 loop 或自己现有的 loop。现有 loop 原样保留为 `else` 分支，所以设置关闭时，入口的行为与现在完全一致。尚未迁移的入口忽略该设置。
- 只有当对拍测试证明设置开启时，该入口的模型请求和输出都与现有 loop 一致，这个入口才算完成迁移。任何差异都必须列出，并关联到对应 issue。
- 每个入口完成迁移后各自修改默认值，从 headless 开始，一个版本之后再删除它的现有 loop，不必等其他入口。为某个宿主让 client 跳过部分工作的发送选项只是过渡手段：设计文档会逐项列出它们，并写明由哪一步移除；入口还有未关闭的选项时，保持原默认值。

本 issue 跟踪这项工作，每一步都是单独的 PR。

#### 现有的 loop（upstream `56733c35aa`）

| 入口 | loop 位置 | 模型调用 | 工具执行 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Ink TUI | `packages/cli/src/ui/hooks/use-llm-stream.ts` | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` | scheduler 完成回调 → `submitQuery(ToolResult)` |
| OpenTUI | `packages/cli/src/ui/opentui/live-session.ts` | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` | 每批新建一个 scheduler |
| Headless `-p` 与 stream-json SDK 传输 | `packages/cli/src/nonInteractiveCli.ts`，drain turn 中还有一份 loop 副本（`:2888-3066`） | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream` | 每个调用走一次 `executeToolCall`，每次都新建一个 `CoreToolScheduler`（`nonInteractiveToolExecutor.ts:75-96`），另外自行实现分批、并发上限和按序收尾 |
| ACP：Zed、VS Code companion、`qwen serve` / Web Shell、channels | `packages/cli/src/acp-integration/session/Session.ts`，内含四份 loop：主循环 `:7534`、Stop 续发 `:8420`、cron `:11463`、通知 `:12792` | 直接调用 `LlmChat.sendMessageStream`（`:9744-9751`） | 自带执行器 `runToolCalls` / `runTool`（`:13799-17842`） |
| Hosted Harness | `packages/cli/src/serve/hosted-harness-model.ts:828-1143` | `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`，但 13 种 hook 事件由它自己触发（`:67-81`） | 写日志的串行调度（`hosted-workspace-tool-turn.ts`） |
| Subagent、后台与 fork agent、workflow、进程内 team | `packages/core/src/agents/runtime/agent-core.ts`：`_runReasoningLoopInner`（`:1016`）与 `processFunctionCalls`（`:2023`） | 直接调用 `LlmChat.sendMessageStream`，并自行解析 chunk | 每轮一个 `CoreToolScheduler` |
| Speculation | `packages/core/src/followup/speculation.ts` | 直接调用 `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` | 直接执行工具，不经过 scheduler |

`LlmClient.sendMessageStream` 只负责一次模型请求，外加它自己处理的几种续发：Stop hook、模型边界处的 steering，以及 next-speaker 检查。它从不执行工具。因此“执行工具、发回结果、继续下一轮”这部分由每个入口各写一份，其中三个 loop 完全绕过了 `LlmClient`。

#### 目标结构

```text
入口：Ink · OpenTUI · headless/SDK · ACP · AgentCore · speculation（Hosted 最后单独评估）
   │  输入、事件出口、审批应答、中途输入、入口策略
   ▼
共享 agent loop（packages/core）
   模型轮：主会话用 LlmClient.sendMessageStream，
           subagent 与 speculation 在各自的 LlmChat 上使用 Turn
   工具批：每轮一个整批调度的 CoreToolScheduler
   批次后：重复调用处理 → finalizeToolResponses → 记录
           → 循环守卫与提醒 → 中途输入 → ToolResult 续发
   结束：返回带类型的终止原因，由各入口映射
   ▼
LlmClient → Turn → LlmChat（不改）
```

- 审批通过入口提供的应答器完成：TUI 弹对话框，ACP 发 `session/request_permission`，SDK 客户端走 `can_use_tool`，普通 headless 自动拒绝。
- 各入口把终止原因映射成自己的结果：退出码、ACP `stopReason`、agent 的 `terminateMode` 或 UI 状态。
- 入口特有的行为作为策略传给 loop，而不是复制一份 loop。例如：`--max-tool-calls` 的启动前计数、structured output、空闲时的续发（Goal、teammate、drain turn）、模型覆盖，以及 daemon 的工具循环守卫。
- 只有在需要第二种实现的 PR 里，才引入对应的接口（例如基于 `Turn` 的模型轮），不预先抽象。

#### 计划

- [x] 设计文档（中英文）：#15343
- [x] PR1：共享 loop、设置项、headless（`-p` 与 stream-json）切到共享 loop，以及对拍测试：#15369
  - [ ] headless 默认开启
  - [ ] 删除 headless 现有的 loop
- [ ] PR2：ACP 会话
  - [x] PR 2a：全新用户 prompt 的模型轮切到共享模型轮，ACP 保留自己的工具步骤：#15509
  - [x] PR 2b：这些轮次的工具批切到整批 scheduler；daemon 工具循环守卫改为 client 的守卫加一项入口策略：#15627
  - [x] PR 2c-1：这些轮次的 stop 点迁到 client 的链上，Todo Stop Guard 作为有序的 stop 策略；后台结果和排队的输入不再在 stop 点让这一轮继续；删除 `stopHookRunByHost`：#15695
  - [ ] PR 2c-2：channel、Goal 提案、retry、continue 和 restore 轮次：#15902
  - [ ] PR 2c-3：Goal 轮次
  - [ ] PR 2c-4：cron 和后台通知轮次
  - [ ] ACP 默认开启，随后删除它现有的 loop
- [ ] PR3：Ink TUI，随后默认开启并删除旧 loop
- [ ] PR4：OpenTUI，随后默认开启并删除旧 loop
- [ ] PR5：AgentCore（subagent、后台与 fork agent、workflow），随后默认开启并删除旧 loop
- [ ] PR6：speculation，随后默认开启并删除旧 loop
- [ ] Hosted Harness：在其他入口之后单独评估
- [ ] 删除该设置项

本轮不包括：

- 会话层调度，即通知、cron、Goal 轮次、teammate 消息何时启动一轮 loop；
- Hosted Harness（等单独评估）；
- provider 层与 `LlmChat`；
- loop 所需钩子之外的 `CoreToolScheduler` 内部逻辑；
- UI 渲染与通信协议。

### 为什么需要？

所有属于 loop 的行为都要在每个入口各实现一次，而这些副本已经各自走样。

代码中的例子（upstream `56733c35aa`）：

- **会话轮数上限有三种算法。**
  - `LlmClient`：`max > 0 && count > max`（`client.ts:4529-4531`）。
  - headless：`max >= 0 && count > max`（`nonInteractiveCli.ts:663`）。
  - Hosted Harness：`max > 0 && round >= max`（`hosted-harness-model.ts:841`）。

  设置 `model.maxSessionTurns: 0` 时，headless 在第一轮就停止，另外两处则永远不停。
- **重复的 provider 工具调用过滤被组装了四次**：`nonInteractiveCli.ts:1962`、`use-llm-stream.ts:3236`、`Session.ts:14086`、`agent-core.ts:2085`。键的回退规则有三种。
- **工具并发上限实现了四次**：`coreToolScheduler.ts:5465`、`nonInteractiveCli.ts:2264`、`Session.ts:14365` 和 `:17031`。ACP 只让连续的 Agent 调用并发（`Session.ts:14234`），而 scheduler 会让所有并发安全的调用并发。
- **六个 loop 各自调用 `finalizeToolResponses`，scheduler 内部还另有一次调用。**
- **Mod 工具检查只覆盖部分入口。** `modToolCheck` 按入口分别接线，只接到了 Ink、OpenTUI 和 headless。ACP 会话没有接，因此 Zed、VS Code、Web Shell 也都没有。
- **ACP 绕过了 `LlmClient.sendMessageStream`。**
  - 它自己重新实现了 UserPromptSubmit、Stop hook 及其次数上限、MessageDisplay、文件快照、plan/arena 提醒、workflow intent、会话 token 门限和 Goal 许可。
  - 它没有 next-speaker 检查，没有 `maxSessionTurns`，也没有内容循环启发式和会话中途的 MCP/skill 提醒。
  - 它的注释也写明了这一点：“duplicated from coreToolScheduler.ts”（`Session.ts:15721`）、“Mirrors the core send path”（`:9547`）、“Mirror of core's checkGlobalDuplicate”（`:1364`）。部分交叉引用指向的代码已经挪走（`:7375`、`:14600`）。
- **Hosted Harness 自己触发 13 种 hook 事件**（`hosted-harness-model.ts:67-81`）。Stop hook 阻断后的续发，它以 `ToolResult` 类型发送，而 `LlmClient` 用的是 `Hook`。

对比各 loop 时发现的缺陷已另行提交：#15324（ACP 会写入被 max_tokens 截断的编辑）、#15325（stream-json 中超过 `--max-session-turns` 的消息仍返回成功）、#15326（OpenTUI 会执行重试前的工具调用，且不记录原生工具结果）。编写对拍测试时还发现了 #15365（在 stream-json 中，启动期间发来的消息会先于第一条消息执行），它不属于 loop 本身。

由这种分裂导致的未关闭 issue：#14114、#12209、#12020、#8542、#13851、#12113。

每加一项 loop 层的新行为，都要付出同样的代价。例如 loop-protection 的提醒（#15016）就不得不分别注入到 `client.ts`、`agent-core.ts` 和 `Session.ts` 三处。

### 补充信息

**相关 issue。**

- #8775 提出以基于 `Turn` 的运行时统一各会话 loop，它的盘点在当前 main 上依然成立。本 issue 跟踪的是落实这一方向的一种分阶段、可选择开启的做法。
- #10219 与 #10078 让 agent 后端可插拔。
- #11695 把工具的执行位置独立出来。

本 issue 不改变上述两类工作，只确保它们可以接入的 loop 只有一份。

**验证方式。**

- `integration-tests/fake-openai-server.ts` 已经会记录每个请求体。对拍测试把每个脚本化场景在同一入口上跑两次：一次关闭设置，一次开启设置。
- 比较两样东西：规范化后的请求序列（模型实际看到的内容），以及入口的输出（stream-json 帧或 ACP `session/update` 通知）。
- 首批场景：
  - 纯文本、单个工具、并行只读批次；
  - 安全与不安全调用混合；
  - 审批通过与拒绝；
  - 工具执行中取消；
  - 流中途重试与模型回退；
  - 输出被截断的编辑；
  - 循环检测；
  - 阻断型 Stop hook；
  - `--max-tool-calls`、`maxSessionTurns` 与 structured output。

**最终状态的验收指标。**

| 指标 | 现在 | 目标 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| agent loop 实现数 | 7 份，另加 headless 与 ACP 内部的额外副本 | 1 |
| 直接调用 `LlmChat.sendMessageStream` 的 loop | 3 | 0 |
| 在 `turn.ts` 之外解析流式 chunk 的 loop | 3 | 0 |
| 调用 `finalizeToolResponses` 的 loop | 6 | 1 |
| 会话轮数上限的算法 | 3 | 1 |

</details>

issues.title: bug(loop): a stop sent as a user message does not cancel the pending loop_wakeup — self-paced /loop resumes itself after an explicit stop (0.26.1)

labels.name: priority/P2
labels.description: Medium - Moderately impactful, noticeable problem

labels.name: type/bug
labels.description: Something isn't working as expected

labels.name: category/core
labels.description: Core engine and logic

labels.name: scope/session-management
labels.description: Session state and persistence

labels.name: roadmap/background-automation
labels.description: Roadmap: Background and automation

issues.body:
## What happened?

I run a self-paced `/loop` (no interval) as an autonomous manager: the loop prompt
tells the agent to end every turn by arming a one-shot `loop_wakeup`, so the chain
re-arms itself each iteration. While one such tick was still running (~80 min of
tool calls), I sent a plain stop **as a normal user message** (in Russian,
translated: "stop work, write a checkpoint, we will continue later") — I did not
press Esc.

The incident, from the session transcript (timestamps UTC):

- `10:02:20` — a tick starts (previous wakeup delivered, `provenance=system`).
- `10:02–10:49` — during that single running tick the agent re-arms the one-shot
  wakeup repeatedly (each `loop_wakeup` call replaces the pending one). Last arm:
  `10:49:55`, `delaySeconds=1500` → scheduled fire `11:14:55`.
- `11:11:36` — my stop message (`provenance=real_user`) is queued, because the tick
  is still running.
- `11:14:55` — the pending wakeup fires while the tick is still running; its prompt
  is enqueued.
- `11:20:18.263` — the stop turn completes: the agent writes the checkpoint and
  states (translated) "I will not set a wake-up".
- `11:20:18.306` — **43 ms later** the enqueued wakeup prompt is delivered as a
  user-role record (`provenance=system`). The session treats it as a fresh loop
  iteration: it resumes work and re-arms new wakeups (1800 s, then 3600 s at
  `11:34:33`/`11:35:16`).

So the loop came back to life 43 ms after the agent had explicitly reported the loop
stopped. Nothing was cancelled: no `cron_delete` call appears anywhere in the
transcript, and the delivered prompt carries no indication that a user stop was
processed while it was pending.

## What did you expect to happen?

An explicit user stop should end the self-paced loop, the same way Esc already does.
Since the product cannot interpret the semantics of an arbitrary message, at minimum:

1. A delivered wakeup prompt should be annotated with staleness when a user message
   was queued/processed after the wakeup was scheduled (e.g. "this wakeup was armed
   at T1; a user message was processed at T2 > T1 before this delivery — if the user
   asked to stop the loop, do not resume").
2. The `/loop` skill (agent side) should instruct: on an explicit stop, cancel the
   pending wakeup first (`cron_delete` covers "a pending loop wakeup scheduled with
   LoopWakeup"), then write the checkpoint.
3. Discoverability: `/loop clear` exists as the user-side cancel, but at the moment
   of typing a plain stop it is not surfaced or hinted.

## Client information

Qwen Code 0.26.1, Qwen Code Desktop (daemon session), macOS (Apple Silicon).

<details>
<summary>Client Information</summary>

```console
$ qwen /about
Qwen Code v0.26.1
Model: llm
Fast Model: anthropic:llm
Auth: openai
Platform: darwin arm64 (25.6.0)
Node.js: v22.23.3
Session: 0a760e3c-2ba0-4d20-8d3d-6191e66a9c64
Git commit: b475278c4a
LSP: disabled
```

</details>

## Login information

API Config: a custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint with an API key from the user
settings file (no OAuth or browser login).

## Anything else we need to know?

Prior art: **#5806** ("[loop] User abort (Esc) does not cancel pending self-paced
loop wakeups") was closed COMPLETED by **PR #5808** (merged 2026-06-25), which
wires `cancelAllWakeups()` into `cancelOngoingRequest` — i.e. the **Esc** path only.
Its stated scope: "Only the tick-in-flight case — Esc is only active while
Responding. Idle pending wakeups remain cancellable via `/loop clear`." A stop sent
as a **message** is not an abort: the tick completes normally, the stop turn runs,
and the armed (already-fired) wakeup is then delivered unconditionally.

Two gaps observed:

1. **No invalidation on message stop.** An agent's declaration "I will not set a
   wake-up" only prevents arming a new timer; it does not cancel the one already
   armed, and nothing in the product ties a user stop to pending wakeups.
2. **No staleness signal at delivery.** A wakeup that fired while the stop was being
   processed is delivered byte-identical to a regular tick prompt, so the agent has
   no way to tell it is stale. (Whether `cancelAllWakeups()` on the Esc path would
   also drop a fired-but-not-yet-delivered prompt is unclear from the outside.)

This is not a rare race: the self-paced pattern ("end every turn with loop_wakeup",
optionally re-armed mid-tick) is the normal shape of autonomous loops, so any
mid-tick stop message can be shadowed by the pending fire.

Workarounds I use: send `/loop clear` (or "cancel the pending wakeup via
cron_delete") together with the stop; and add a line to the loop prompt: "on stop —
cancel the pending wakeup first, then write the checkpoint".

Related sibling failures of the same one-shot mechanism: #15576 (scheduled fire
silently lost — the opposite direction) and an unfiled duplicate-delivery
observation (~1 in 3 wakeups also deliver a copy 40–60 s early).

I have the full transcript forensics (record-level timestamps and provenance) and
can share it on request.

issues.body:
The `Managed Agent gate` is red on main, so it is red for every PR that triggers the full tier. It is not caused by any one PR: two separate main runs fail the same job with the same test, and the failing measurement changes shape between runs.

## What fails

Job **`Hosted process fault gates / MySQL 8.4 / Java 21`**, test **`HostedProcessCrashIT.processCrashesNeverReplayHostedToolsOnMySql`** (`HostedProcessCrashIT.java:82`, assertion surfaced from `:427`), plus `HostedShellLifecycleRecoveryIT.publicDeletionRecoversOriginalResources(String)[2]`.

The assertion is in the crash driver (`integration-tests/helpers/hosted-process-crash-driver.ts:682-685`):

```
assert(report.postFailureLoads.length > 0);
assert(report.postFailureLoads.every(Boolean), 'replacement must use cancellation-only loads');
```

`postFailureLoads` is appended at `:160` as `fields.cancellationTakeover === true` for every `/load` the CLI issues after the injected crash. So a `false` entry means a post-failure load did not carry cancellation-only semantics.

## It reproduces on main

| Run | Branch | Job result |
|---|---|---|
| 40943334546 (main, 19:48) | main | failure — same job |
| 40885888315 (main, 13:51) | main | failure — same job |
| 40925586760 | PR #15882 | failure — same job |

Same job name, same test name, in all three.

## The measurement is not stable, which is the part that matters

The recorded load sequence differs run to run, in both length and position:

```
main 19:48 : [true,true,false,false,false,false,false,false,false]          (9)
main 13:51 : [true,true,false,false,false,false,false,false,false,true]     (10)
PR #15882  : [true,false,true,false,false,false,false,false,false]          (9)
```

A fixed product defect would give a fixed position; here the count of loads after the crash itself changes. That points at ordering between the crash injection and the load handling rather than at a deterministic code path — but I want to be explicit that I have **not** proven the loads are correct, only that the assertion's input is non-deterministic, so "flaky test" and "real race in recovery" are both still open.

## Why it is not #15882

That PR converts the fixtures' unnamed `getBean(JdbcTemplate.class)` to `getBean("managedJdbcTemplate", ...)`. On its run the `[B cannot be cast to class java.lang.String` symptom drops to **0** occurrences, against **8** in the same job on main. So the change does what it says, and the `postFailureLoads` failure is untouched by it because it was already failing on main.

## What would settle it

1. Re-run the job on `main` unmodified a few times and record `postFailureLoads` — if the pattern keeps changing, the test needs to pin the ordering it actually requires (or the driver needs to attribute loads to the crash phase deterministically) instead of asserting a positional list.
2. If instead it is a real recovery race, the ordering to look at is which `/load` paths can be issued between the crash and the `recovery-pending` control call (`hosted-process-crash-driver.ts:678-685`).

I am not loosening the assertion, because "no tool replay after a crash" is exactly the property it exists to protect, and its own message says so.

prs.title: refactor(managed-agent): Split server into Maven modules
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Split the Managed Agent Server into six production Maven modules and one unpublished verification module, built and versioned together. Framework-neutral contracts define the boundaries; control-plane orchestration, Runtime Broker orchestration, persistence and adapters depend only on those contracts, while the server assembles the implementations and remains the single executable service.

Migrate the existing tests, resources, embedded-host integration, launchers, packaging, publication configuration and CI consumers together. Preserve the current main branch's bounded-history queries, live message paging, Hosted cleanup retries and upgrade preflight within the new boundaries. The server retains its published coordinate and executable/operator classifiers. Server configuration uses compile-time Lombok accessors for 349 simple getters/setters while retaining custom normalization, copying and fallback logic. Repeated SDK exception conversion is shared by typed helpers; deferred submissions and stream operations retain their conversion boundaries. Shared settings and Broker contracts expose only operations needed across module boundaries; private forwarding methods and unused test factories are removed.

## Why it's needed

The single-module layout permits models, orchestration, storage and external clients to depend on one another, so directory names alone cannot enforce ownership. Separate Maven compilation and bytecode architecture checks make those dependencies explicit while keeping deployment and release coordination unchanged. The migration also preserves the original transaction, identity, fencing and recovery boundaries instead of splitting atomic work into independent repository calls.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Verify that the production modules compile using only their declared dependencies, that contracts expose no framework or client implementation types, and that implementation modules do not depend on one another. Confirm that embedding, public/internal HTTP surfaces, configuration binding, resource ownership and packaged service behavior match main.

### How to verify

1. Install the Java SDK from the same source into an isolated Maven repository, then run the parent reactor's complete verification. Expect all production modules, architecture checks and original test families to execute; a missing test tree or report must fail rather than pass empty.
2. Exercise all seven former default transaction entry points through the dedicated Spring transaction manager. Verify whole-operation rollback and preserved locking, then check configuration units/defaults, host Bean isolation, internal endpoint opt-in and single-instance/pooled Harness wiring. Standalone session creation must publish configured skills and inherited extension resources and include their references in the SDK request.
3. Verify native CSI capability refusal for memory repositories, JDBC admission and generation fencing, SDK error conversion, and recovery/retirement behavior after response loss. Run the existing MySQL, Hosted, fault, MQ and OSS gates without weakening their selectors or report completeness checks.
4. Inspect ordinary, executable and operator JARs from the server output directory. Verify unique nested resources, maintenance entry points, an independent embedding host and the reference distribution; no database migration is expected. Confirm that Lombok is absent from executable and operator runtime libraries.

After merging `main@8457254f75`, repository build and typecheck passed. Twelve selected workflow/E2E runner meta-test suites passed 873 cases with 19 existing skips; the CI failure workflow suite initially failed under macOS Bash 3.2, then passed all 150 cases under the already-installed Bash 5. Four WebShell message-paging consumer suites passed 322 cases. The generated API matches the relocated OpenAPI byte for byte. Two clean merge audits and source comparisons preserve the upstream paging SQL, cursors, transaction boundaries, authorization checks and test cases while adapting package references, error status values and the test constructor to the module boundaries. Java compilation and runtime acceptance remain pending CI under the unchanged shared budget.

Earlier local Java evidence, before that integration: all six production modules compiled and passed production Checkstyle/SpotBugs; architecture, transaction-proxy, configuration, embedding, SDK conversion and packaging checks passed, alongside 199 Broker, 44 lock-order, 33 retirement and 47 cancellation/command/automation cases. These results do not establish a passing final integrated Java revision. The final bounded reactor verification timed out, and the shared ten-minute Java budget was not reset for PR preparation.

The accessor/SDK-wrapper simplification, contract narrowing and revised composition test have source-level comparison, formatting and two clean self-audit passes as local evidence. Source comparison preserves configuration behavior, authorization/input call order and existing ACK test cases. The new configuration, deferred-call, stream-failure, composition and packaging regressions have not run locally because the same Java budget remains exhausted. The previously inspected Java CI failed, including moved-fixture path and test-context Bean failures; those broader failures are not claimed resolved, and final-revision Java acceptance remains pending.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — structural refactor with no intended UI change.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ tested, with the scope and limits above |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
|  🐧 Linux  | ⚠️ not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS; JDK 21; Maven 3.9.14 with an isolated local repository; Node 26.12.1; Bash 5 for workflow shell fixtures. Earlier Java verification consumed approximately 598 seconds of the shared local budget.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: This is a broad ownership migration across transaction, Spring assembly, SDK exception and classpath-resource boundaries. Final-revision Java and CI acceptance remains incomplete; this is not a deployment-ready claim. The server build now requires Lombok annotation processing, without adding it to the deployed runtime.
- Not validated / out of scope: The integrated Java revision still needs compilation, Checkstyle/SpotBugs, the full reactor, aggregate coverage, independent Maven embedding-host validation and the complete MySQL/Hosted/fault/MQ/OSS gates. Earlier intermediate JARs are not final deliverables. An unchanged 600 ms script timing case failed in a broader earlier run and passed only in isolation; that is not a claim that the entire broader run passed. No publication, deployment, independent module versioning or unrelated feature work is included.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: Java packages, selected types/constructors and the parent artifact coordinate change. The existing server coordinate remains, its internal dependencies publish at the same version, and executable output moves to `server/target`. Repository consumers migrate together. HTTP/configuration keys, database schema and persisted formats remain those of the integrated main revision; rollback replaces application artifacts without rewriting data.

The complete, synchronized design and local evidence are available in [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-agent-maven-modules/docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-agent-maven-modules.md) and [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-agent-maven-modules/docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-agent-maven-modules.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本次变更

将 Managed Agent Server 拆为六个生产 Maven 模块和一个不发布的验证模块，统一构建和版本。框架无关的契约定义边界；控制面编排、Runtime Broker 编排、持久化和适配器仅依赖契约，server 装配各实现，并继续作为单个可执行服务交付。

同时迁移现有测试、资源、嵌入宿主集成、启动器、打包、发布配置及 CI 使用方。在新边界内保留当前主干的有界历史查询、实时消息分页、Hosted 清理重试和升级预检。服务保持现有发布坐标及可执行/运维 classifier。server 配置使用编译期 Lombok 注解替代 349 个简单 getter/setter，保留自定义规范化、复制和回退逻辑。重复的 SDK 异常转换集中到带类型的辅助方法，延迟提交和流操作仍保留各自的转换边界。共享配置和 Broker 契约仅暴露跨模块需要的操作，删除私有转发方法及未使用的测试工厂。

## 为什么需要

单模块布局允许模型、编排、存储和外部客户端相互依赖，目录名称无法单独约束职责。独立 Maven 编译和字节码架构检查使依赖关系明确，同时保持部署和发布协调方式不变。迁移还保留原有事务、身份、隔离栅栏及恢复边界，不把原子操作拆成相互独立的仓储调用。

## 评审测试计划

确认生产模块仅按声明依赖编译，契约不暴露框架或客户端实现类型，各实现模块不相互依赖。核对嵌入、公共/内部 HTTP 接口、配置绑定、资源归属及服务包行为与主干一致。

### 如何验证

1. 将同一源码的 Java SDK 安装到隔离 Maven 仓库，再执行父 reactor 的完整验证。应执行全部生产模块、架构检查和原有测试族；测试树或报告缺失必须失败，不能空通过。
2. 经专用 Spring 事务管理器执行七个原默认事务入口。确认整个操作回滚且锁语义保留，再核对配置单位/默认值、宿主 Bean 隔离、内部接口显式开启以及单实例/池化 Harness 装配。单实例会话创建必须发布已配置的技能和继承扩展资源，并在 SDK 请求中包含其引用。
3. 验证内存仓储对原生 CSI 能力的拒绝、JDBC admission 和 generation 栅栏、SDK 异常转换，以及响应丢失后的恢复/退休行为。执行现有 MySQL、Hosted、故障、MQ 和 OSS 门禁，不削弱选择条件或报告完整性检查。
4. 检查 server 输出目录中的普通、可执行和运维 JAR。验证嵌套资源唯一性、维护入口、独立嵌入宿主和参考分发包；不应需要数据库迁移。确认可执行包及运维包的运行时依赖中不含 Lombok。

合入 `main@8457254f75` 后，仓库 build 和 typecheck 通过。十二组定向工作流/E2E 启动器元测试通过 873 项、保留 19 项既有跳过；其中 CI 失败处理工作流测试最初在 macOS Bash 3.2 下失败，切换到已安装的 Bash 5 后全部 150 项通过。四组 WebShell 消息分页调用方测试通过 322 项。生成的 API 与迁移后的 OpenAPI 逐字节一致。两遍连续干净合并自审及源码比对确认，上游分页 SQL、游标、事务边界、授权检查和测试用例保持不变，仅按模块边界适配包引用、错误状态值和测试构造参数。共享预算保持不变，Java 编译及运行时验收仍待 CI。

整合前的本地 Java 证据：六个生产模块均已编译并通过生产 Checkstyle/SpotBugs；架构、事务代理、配置、嵌入、SDK 转换和打包检查通过，另有 199 个 Broker、44 个锁顺序、33 个退休及 47 个取消/命令/自动化用例通过。这些结果不能证明最终整合后的 Java 版本通过。最后一次限定时长的 reactor 验证超时，准备 PR 时没有重置共享十分钟 Java 预算。

访问方法/SDK 包装精简、契约收窄和装配测试改写的本地证据为源码比对、格式检查及两遍连续干净自审。源码比对确认配置行为、授权/输入调用顺序和既有 ACK 测试用例保持不变。同一 Java 预算已用尽，因此新增的配置、延迟调用、流异常、装配及打包回归尚未在本地运行。此前查看的 Java CI 失败，包含迁移后的夹具路径和测试上下文 Bean 问题；不宣称这些更广范围的失败已解决，最终版本的 Java 验收仍未完成。

### 变更前后证据

N/A — 结构重构，没有预期的 UI 变化。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试，范围和限制见上文 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未测试 |

### 环境

macOS；JDK 21；Maven 3.9.14，使用隔离本地仓库；Node 26.12.1；工作流 Shell 夹具使用 Bash 5。此前 Java 验证累计使用约 598 秒共享本地预算。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：本次跨事务、Spring 装配、SDK 异常和 classpath 资源边界调整职责归属，范围较大。最终版本的 Java 和 CI 验收仍未完成，不代表可部署交付。server 构建现在需要 Lombok 注解处理，部署运行时不增加该依赖。
- 未验证或范围外：整合后的 Java 版本仍需编译、Checkstyle/SpotBugs、完整 reactor、聚合覆盖率、独立 Maven embedding-host 验证，以及完整 MySQL/Hosted/故障/MQ/OSS 门禁。此前中间 JAR 不是最终交付物。一个未修改的 600 ms 脚本时序用例在早前较广执行中失败，仅在隔离运行时通过，不能据此宣称整个较广执行通过。不包含发布、部署、模块独立版本化或无关功能开发。
- 破坏性变更及迁移说明：Java 包名、部分类型/构造接口和父工程坐标改变。服务保留现有坐标，内部依赖同版本发布，可执行产物移至 `server/target`。仓库内使用方同步迁移。HTTP/配置键、数据库 schema 及持久化格式保持整合后主干的状态；回退替换应用产物，不重写数据。

完整且同步的设计与本地证据见[英文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-agent-maven-modules/docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-agent-maven-modules.md)和[中文版](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/managed-agent-maven-modules/docs/design/2026-10-29-managed-agent-maven-modules.zh-CN.md)。

## 关联问题

无。

prs.title: feat(hooks): add FileChanged notifications for local sessions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `FileChanged` hooks for local, non-managed sessions. Hooks can observe literal filenames in the working directory or register absolute files and recursive directories through successful synchronous `SessionStart` and `FileChanged` output. Notifications carry the listening session, configured absolute path and `add`, `change` or `unlink`, including changes made by external processes.

Registrations follow session ownership, working-directory changes and hook reloads. Initially missing paths and deleted/recreated roots can recover. Explicit symbolic-link files and directory roots observe their targets while preserving the configured alias in notifications; recursive discovery keeps implicit symbolic links, `.git` and `node_modules` subtrees excluded unless explicitly registered.

CI compatibility repairs retain the complete gates while using fresh verification directories and runner-local Java dependency caches. Hosted workflow fault checks distinguish live consumption from a delivery-classification snapshot, and the digest-tamper probe updates its exact resource row by primary key. Attestation-loss injection covers both attempts of the existing bounded read-only EOF retry while preserving recovery-blocking assertions. RocketMQ downloads have bounded connection/transfer/retry windows. The hard-pinned 5.5.1 release first uses a public Apache mirror and falls back to the two official Apache sources; its independent SHA-512 check remains mandatory before extraction. Other versions retain the official-source checksum chain. Cold-resume TUI verification waits for the original assistant reply, then checks the typed user text in the same frame within the existing deadline. The branch also contains the upstream CI history and hosted macOS Intel startup-budget fixes. The self-hosted browser gate prepares missing DejaVu font data in the runner user's font directory, then rechecks that user. Preparation uses private APT lists and package extraction at the runner's existing privilege level; it never elevates or executes the PR-provided host installer.

Commit `be264d0c9f9f9662702f7c7a1a7c4d2a84311441` fixes a CI test that assumed an ordering Git does not guarantee. The preceding Linux run recorded 117,400 passes, one order-only failure and 152 skips: both expected worktree-prune entries were present, but reversed in all three attempts. The assertion now requires exactly the same two complete records without ordering. Production behavior, the 20-second deadline and test selection are unchanged. The original file passes 48/48; a controlled reversal of real Git announcement lines also passes the original case, and ten missing/extra/duplicate/wrong-object controls are rejected.

Commit `1a8b2591` integrates upstream main `4dd7ac7` and resolves the overlapping prune-test repair using the upstream order-normalized, exact two-record assertion. Commit `16a439b6` corrects cache-repair eligibility: only default `_tool` cache candidates invoke the unchanged canonical-path and symlink safeguards. Other configured cache roots retain their provisioned permissions and continue through the original Java installation and tests. No new privileges, test selectors, coverage guards or deadlines were introduced. Commit `16ef4bb269` qualifies the Managed database template in two unit-test fixtures. This preserves their original binding on the branch and selects the same named private template after newer main is integrated; SQL, transaction fields, assertions and test selection are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Memory and other integrations need notifications from editors, shells and external writers, including files outside the working directory. This supplies a general filesystem event while leaving initial reconciliation and durable synchronization to the integration.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Register initially missing literal filenames, then create, atomically replace and delete them. Expect file notifications while unrelated siblings stay silent.
- Register an external directory, add nested files, delete and recreate the root, then write again. Notifications should continue; replacing or clearing dynamic registrations should retain static registrations.
- Register a symbolic-link file or directory, modify its target through the real path, and confirm the hook receives the configured alias. Multiple aliases should each notify. Refresh registration after retargeting a link; implicit child links should remain silent.
- Change the working directory or rotate the session and reload hooks. Only the current owning session should notify; temporary ACP/MCP configurations and managed, remote or sandbox sessions should remain disarmed.
- On a runner with font drift, expect DejaVu font data to be prepared under that runner's XDG/HOME directory, followed by the unchanged font check. Package or remaining-font failures must stop the gate; healthy runners make no preparation requests and PR-provided scripts never gain new privileges.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before the explicit-link repair, real CLI probes on the earlier source received zero notifications for static file links, dynamic file links and dynamic directory links, while the regular-file control notified. The d38 bundle passed all three configured aliases plus the control, preserving exact paths and session identity. Directory recreation produced `change → unlink → add → change`; both probes exited naturally with code 0 and empty stderr. These are historical source-scoped probes. The later main integration changes production Java, schema, SQL and other upstream inputs, so earlier SDK results are not current-tree runtime-equivalence evidence.

The resolved main-integration tree passed a complete build and typecheck, 1,714 core regressions, 912 ACP regressions, 50 Web Shell regressions and the complete 48-case prune file, all without test skips. Twelve strict assertion controls accept both valid report orders and reject missing, duplicate, extra or misattributed records. The subsequent two-file cache fix leaves the entire application package tree, dependency lock and manifests unchanged. Its workflow-contract checks pass 121/121, original cache-safety checks 8/8 and routing checks 92/92. The test engineer also verified 45 cache contexts and nine controlled flows without executing Java or modifying shared directories. Both source audits were clean; normal commit hooks preserved the verified trees.

Local workflow-reader runs retain their failures: the integration run recorded 1,235 passes, 23 failures and 25 conditional skips; the cache-fix reader run recorded 645 passes, 22 failures and 15 conditional skips. The 22 repeated failures reproduce with identical diagnostics on untouched main4dd under macOS Bash 3.2. The other original 90-second autofix timeout has no proven cause; isolated main/candidate controls passed without extending the deadline. The actual [1a8b Linux test job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664712936/job/122736421859) passed 117,940 test executions with zero failures and 152 existing skips, including the complete 150-case failure-reporter file, 339-case autofix file and original timed-out case. Initial local coverage-directory and linter-PATH failures remain recorded; serialization and the correct tool paths subsequently passed. Workflow-size validation also passed with the actual script under isolated Linux Bash 5, and the CI budget check passed.

### Current verification

Verification snapshot: 2026-10-29 09:16 Asia/Shanghai.

Current head is `16ef4bb269b146069d844d6df86cd6bd1cc45957`. The [Managed Agent fast gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250613), TUI, Landlock and reference-distribution workflows have succeeded. [Main CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250502) has also succeeded: required Lint & Static passed all 731 helper checks, Linux passed 117,940 test executions with 152 existing skips, no-AK integration passed 369/369, and browser smoke passed 403/403 plus six transcript cases. Its actual font probe selected DejaVu Sans on the healthy path; this run did not exercise cold font preparation. Serve A/B attempt1 hit the original 60-minute limit during official Node22.23.4 acquisition after a socket hang-up and stalled retry; both product builds/captures and the diff were unexecuted. Its complete failure logs remain preserved. The one same-source job rerun has now succeeded in all 16 workflow steps, including both original build/capture arms, the diff and artifact upload, with unchanged tests and deadlines. It used cached Node22.23.2-x64 under the original22.x setting; this cache-hit result does not verify the failed cold22.23.4-arm64 transfer. Visuals has also succeeded: head/base checks passed85/81, the render outcome and uploaded render-status both report success, and all118 screenshot pairs have zero pixel differences. Zero composed changes therefore produced no published PNG previews. Two raw videos were uploaded; optional GIF conversion was skipped because the host lacked ffmpeg. All eight product workflows have now succeeded. The new Live Host run actually checked out b616 on macOS26.6.2 ARM64 with Node22.23.3:374/374 tests passed without skips, followed by a successful build, ARM64 package, explicit ad-hoc signing and strict verification. These checks do not represent identity signing or notarization. The new-head automatic CR has now completed successfully and published a partial COMMENT review; formal approval remains separate from these completed product checks.

The preceding [Managed fast gate](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669147407) recorded two SQL type errors after newer main made the Managed JDBC template private: two unit fixtures selected the unqualified host template. Commit `16ef4bb269` changes only those two field qualifiers and imports. The new fast job actually checked out `b61688f5` (main `11ef1988` + `16ef4bb2`) and recorded 5,834 Managed tests: 5,815 passed, 19 existing skips, and zero failures/errors. The two changed fixture classes executed all 57 integration and nine creation-skills cases with zero skips/errors, preserving the original SQL and transaction assertions. SDK tests recorded 421 total with nine existing skips; Java 11 daemon checks passed 4/4. Actual SDK, Managed and Broker Checkstyle goals reported zero violations. Fast runs test/package rather than verify, so it does not itself certify SpotBugs. Successful fast runs do not upload Surefire XML/TXT under the existing failure-only upload policy; the acceptance evidence is the complete raw console and exact-source class roster.

The [complete SDK run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669464577) has succeeded in all13 original lanes at immutable source `16a439b6`; all13 terminal consoles confirm that checkout. MariaDB10.11.18 and MySQL8.4.6 each completed all1,192 integration cases with zero skips/failures/errors, matching each66-class source roster and all four reclamation cuts and two reuse-concurrency methods. Hosted recorded165 total:161 passed and four conditional skips; fault45/45, admission2/2 and O4 recovery59/59 passed without skips. Both original PROVISIONER/SERVICE fault contexts and their blocking, lease and relaunch assertions remain intact. The single-broker7, multi-node10 and all20 CLI/database failover commands also passed. macOS recorded SDK412 passes/9 skips and Runtime Broker1,245 passes/13 skips, including the ownership-revision case.

Commit16ef changes only two unit-fixture injection fields/imports; production, dependencies, schemas, integration-profile tests and workflow inputs remain identical to16a. The13-lane result supplies qualified evidence for those unchanged inputs; it did not execute16ef's changed fixtures, whose acceptance is separately established by the newer b616 fast run. It also does not certify the whole later b616 integration, which contains144 additional paths, including74 Managed Java production paths. The approval-triggered full gate remains the maintainer acceptance stage for that integration. Test trees, Git stamps and compiled outputs are not claimed byte-identical.

The four current Hosted skips remain explicit: three public-workspace cases require macOS, and one method containing12 media scenarios needs the manual bundle-ready property. The SDK macOS lane does not execute that separate Hosted profile. Successful SQL and fault/admission XML are not uploaded by the existing policies; source-scoped proof uses complete console summaries, exact class/selector checks and the Hosted/O4 XML artifacts that were actually uploaded. Original failed/cancelled attempts and acquisition failures remain preserved.

Real HZ jobs now skip only optional permission repair, complete Java installation and execute verification; HK jobs still execute the unchanged local-cache safeguards. The preceding [1a8b SDK run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664899184) failed four jobs before Java setup because a configured shared cache was mistaken for a repairable local cache. Once the corrected 13-lane replacement was accepted, its remaining obsolete work was stopped; completed results and all four failure logs remain preserved. Stopped or unexecuted work is not counted as passing. Upstream now runs installed npm acceptance on schedule or manual dispatch, so the PR's skipped installation jobs are not new 9/9 or 96/96 results.

The [round-17 review](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#pullrequestreview-5688241194) reviewed the current16ef head, rechecked historical blockers and published no new inline blocker. It explicitly disclosed partial-review gaps and was COMMENTED, not APPROVED;14 nonblocking Suggestions are recorded as deferred in the review body. The [automatic CR workflow](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250268) succeeded. A separate check of the artifact-only, low-confidence R17-9 reproduced the missing-helper exit127 on an older source tree, but found no existing sdk-java tags or Java SDK release runs on October29; no currently blocked resumed release was established. This conditional old-ref compatibility risk remains recorded for follow-up. Current checks have no failures or pending jobs. The branch has no merge conflict; the two required formal approvals remain outstanding.

### Historical evidence and boundaries

The [be264 main CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40579375100) and its other seven product workflows succeeded, including 117,401 Linux passes with 152 existing skips, 372 browser plus six transcript cases, TUI installation 96/96 and Live Host 374/374. Those results belong to be264 or their recorded integration checkout37daa, not the latest head. The [d38 full SDK recovery](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40526188684/attempts/3) succeeded in all 13 lanes. It retains four pre-existing Hosted conditional skips: one method containing 12 provider-media scenarios needs the manual bundle-ready property, and three public-workspace checks require macOS; admission checks do not replace those scenarios. New Java/schema inputs invalidate reuse of that old run as full acceptance of the merged tree.

The R15 font repair retains all 20 regressions, four independent controls and two real Ubuntu UID1000 cold-font controls, with unchanged system fonts/configuration and no Chromium-metric claim for those containers. The actual font-repair shell remains unchanged through both new commits. Earlier local application and metadata failures remain recorded separately, including core 2,493/one failure, CLI 3,651/two failures and the 269-pass/43-failure Node metadata baseline. No local control erases those wider failures. Java, Maven and SQL verification stays in CI because the original shared local budget is exhausted.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | Complete SDK lane succeeded at16a for unchanged runtime inputs; new Live Host374/374 plus ARM64 packaging and ad-hoc verification succeeded atb616 |
| Windows | Unchanged-input SDK lane succeeded at16a; current Landlock boundary6/6 passed, while the main Windows suite remains an original policy skip |
| Linux | Current16ef Main/fast and other completed products pass; full SDK succeeded at16a for unchanged runtime inputs |

## Risk & Scope

- Filesystem notifications are best effort; integrations remain responsible for initial scans, reconciliation and self-trigger loops. Retargeted links require a registration refresh.
- Managed/remote filesystem producers, memory enable/disable events and durable synchronization remain outside this change.
- Design and user contracts are synchronized in [English](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.md) and [Chinese](https://github.com/samuelhsin/qwen-code/blob/codex/file-changed-hook/docs/design/file-changed-hooks.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Refs #12558. Supersedes #12561; its separate memory-toggle requirement remains follow-up work.

## 改动

为本地非托管会话添加 `FileChanged` hook。Hook 可观察工作目录中的字面文件名，也可通过执行成功的同步 `SessionStart` 和 `FileChanged` 输出注册绝对文件或递归目录。通知携带监听会话、配置中的绝对路径及 `add`、`change` 或 `unlink`，覆盖外部进程的写入。

注册跟随会话归属、工作目录变化和 hook 重载；初始缺失路径和删除后重建的根可以恢复。显式符号链接文件和目录根观察其目标，通知保留配置中的别名；递归发现仍排除未显式注册的符号链接、`.git` 和 `node_modules` 子树。

CI 兼容修复保留完整门禁，并使用新的验证目录和 runner 本地 Java 依赖缓存。Hosted workflow 故障检查分别验证实时消费与投递分类快照，digest 篡改探针按资源主键更新精确一行。Attestation 丢失注入覆盖既有有界只读 EOF 重试的两次尝试，同时保留恢复阻断断言。RocketMQ 下载有连接、传输和重试时限。已固定摘要的 5.5.1 优先使用公共 Apache 镜像，并回退到原两个 Apache 官方来源；解包前仍必须通过独立固定 SHA-512 校验，其他版本保留官方来源的摘要链。冷恢复 TUI 验证在原时限内等待原助手回答，再检查同一帧中的用户原文。分支也已同步上游 CI 历史处理和托管 macOS Intel 启动预算修复。 自托管浏览器检查现在会在 runner 用户自己的字体目录准备缺失的 DejaVu 字体数据，并以同一用户重新校验。准备过程使用私有 APT 索引和软件包解包，保持 runner 原有权限，不提权，也不执行 PR 中的宿主安装脚本。

提交 `be264d0c9f9f9662702f7c7a1a7c4d2a84311441` 修复一条假定 Git 返回固定顺序的 CI 测试。此前 Linux 记录为 117400 项通过、一项仅顺序不同的失败及 152 项跳过；三次尝试均完整返回原两条 worktree-prune 记录，但顺序相反。新断言仍严格要求相同的两条完整记录和精确总数，仅不约束顺序；生产行为、20 秒时限和测试选择均未变。原文件 48/48 通过，真实 Git 公告行的受控反序也通过原用例，十项缺失、额外、重复或错误对象负控均被拒绝。

提交 `1a8b2591` 同步上游 main `4dd7ac7`，用上游排序后精确匹配原两条记录的等价断言解决测试修复重叠。提交 `16a439b6` 修正缓存权限修复的适用范围：只有默认 `_tool` 候选目录进入原有规范路径和符号链接检查；其他配置缓存保留部署时的权限，继续原 Java 安装与测试。未新增权限，也未改变测试选择、覆盖守卫或时限。

提交 `16ef4bb269` 为两个单元测试 fixture 明确限定 Managed 数据库模板：当前分支保持原绑定，集成新版 main 后选择同名私有模板。SQL、事务字段、断言和测试筛选均未改变。

## 原因

Memory 等集成需要观察编辑器、shell 和外部进程的写入，包括工作目录之外的文件。本改动提供通用文件系统事件，初始对账和持久同步仍由集成负责。

## 评审验证

- 注册初始缺失的字面文件名，再创建、原子替换和删除；应收到文件通知，无关兄弟路径保持静默。
- 注册外部目录，新增嵌套文件，删除并重建根后再次写入；通知应持续。替换或清空动态注册时保留静态注册。
- 注册符号链接文件或目录，通过真实路径修改目标；hook 应收到配置的别名。多个别名各自通知，链接改指后刷新注册；隐式子链接保持静默。
- 改变工作目录，或轮换会话后重载 hook；只有当前归属会话收到通知，ACP/MCP 临时配置及托管、远程、沙箱会话保持禁用。
- runner 字体漂移时，应在其 XDG/HOME 目录准备 DejaVu 字体数据，再执行原字体校验；包获取或字体仍异常时必须停止门禁。健康 runner 不发起准备请求，PR 脚本不获得新增权限。

## 修前与修后证据

显式链接修复前，真实 CLI 对静态文件链接、动态文件链接和动态目录链接均收到零条通知，普通文件对照正常。d38 的 bundle 通过了三种配置别名和普通文件对照，精确路径及会话身份保留；目录重建完整收到 `change → unlink → add → change`，两条探针自然退出 0、stderr 为空。这些是对应历史源码的探针。后来的 main 同步改变了 Java 生产代码、schema、SQL 等上游输入，因此旧 SDK 结果不能作为当前整棵树运行逻辑等价的证据。

解决冲突后的合并树通过完整构建、类型检查、1714 项核心回归、912 项 ACP 回归、50 项 Web Shell 回归和原完整 48 项 prune 测试，测试均零跳过。12 项严格断言对照接受两种合法顺序，拒绝缺失、重复、额外或错误归属记录。之后的两文件缓存修复未改变应用 packages 树、依赖锁或 manifests；工作流契约测试 121/121、原缓存安全测试 8/8、路由检查 92/92 均通过。测试工程师另验证了 45 个缓存上下文和 9 个受控流程，未运行 Java，也未改变共享目录；两轮源码审查干净，正常提交钩子保留了所验证代码树。

本地工作流元测试失败继续保留：合并验证为 1235 项通过、23 项失败、25 项条件跳过；缓存修复验证为 645 项通过、22 项失败、15 项条件跳过。重复的 22 项在未修改的 main4dd、macOS Bash3.2 上以完全相同诊断复现。另一项原 90 秒 autofix 超时原因仍未查明，main/候选单独对照通过，未延长时限。真实 [1a8b Linux 测试任务](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664712936/job/122736421859) 已通过 117940 次执行、零失败，保留 152 项既有跳过；包含完整 150 项失败报告器、339 项 autofix 和原先超时的用例。本地最初的覆盖率目录冲突和 linter PATH 错误记录也保留，串行运行和正确工具路径随后通过。原工作流大小脚本在隔离 Linux Bash5 环境通过，CI 预算检查也通过。

## 当前验证

验证快照：2026-10-29 09:16 北京时间。

当前提交为 `16ef4bb269b146069d844d6df86cd6bd1cc45957`。[Managed Agent fast门禁](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250613)、TUI、Landlock和参考分发工作流均已成功。[主CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250502)也已整轮成功：必需Lint & Static的731项辅助检查通过，Linux117940次执行通过并保留152项既有跳过，无AK集成369/369通过，浏览器smoke403/403和transcript6项通过。实际字体探针在健康路径选中DejaVu Sans，本轮未执行缺字体准备分支。Serve A/B的attempt1在官方Node22.23.4获取出现socket hang-up、重试停留后，达到原60分钟上限；两臂产品构建、采集和diff均未执行，完整失败日志保留。仅对原任务进行的一次同源码重跑现已完成全部16个工作流步骤，两臂原构建/采集、diff和artifact上传均成功，测试和时限不变。它在原22.x设置下命中Node22.23.2-x64缓存，此缓存命中结果不能证明首轮失败的22.23.4-arm64冷获取路径成功。Visuals也已成功：head/base检查85/81全部通过，实际render outcome和上传的render-status均为success，118对截图逐一零像素差异；因此compose零变动，没有发布PNG预览。两条原始视频已上传，主机缺少ffmpeg导致可选GIF转换跳过。全部八条产品工作流现均成功。新Live Host实际检出b616，macOS26.6.2 ARM64、Node22.23.3环境的374/374测试零跳过通过，后续构建、ARM64打包、显式ad-hoc签名和strict verify也成功；这些检查不代表身份签名或公证。新提交自动CR现已整轮成功，发布了披露审查缺口的COMMENT评审；正式批准与已完成的产品检查分别记录。

此前 [Managed fast门禁](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669147407)的两项SQL类型错误，来自main将Managed JDBC模板改为私有后、两个测试字段选中未限定的宿主模板。提交16ef只改变这两个字段限定及import。新fast任务实际检出b61688f5（main11ef +16ef），整套Managed5834项零失败、零错误，保留19项既有跳过。两个改动测试类的57项集成和9项创建技能用例全部执行，零跳过、零错误，原SQL与事务断言保留。SDK共421项、9项既有跳过，Java11 daemon4/4通过；实际SDK、Managed和Broker Checkstyle目标均零违规。fast运行test/package而非verify，本身不能证明SpotBugs通过。按原有仅失败时上传的政策，成功fast不上传Surefire XML/TXT；接受证据来自完整原始console和准确源码的完整类方法清单。

[完整SDK CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40669464577)在固定版本16a439b6的原全部13条lane均已成功，13份终态console都确认该检出版本。MariaDB10.11.18和MySQL8.4.6各完成全部1192项集成用例，零跳过、零失败、零错误；各自66类源码清单及4个回收切点、2个复用并发方法完整执行。Hosted共165项：161通过、4项条件跳过；fault45/45、准入2/2、O4恢复59/59均零跳过通过，原PROVISIONER/SERVICE两种故障上下文及blocking、lease、relaunch断言完整保留。单节点7项、多节点10项和全部20条CLI/数据库failover命令也通过。macOS的SDK412通过/9跳过，Runtime Broker1245通过/13跳过，含ownership revision用例。

提交16ef只改变两个单元fixture字段限定及import，生产代码、依赖、schema、集成profile测试和工作流输入均与16a相同。13条lane结果提供这些不变输入的限定证据，没有执行16ef的改动fixture；新fixture的接受由后续b616 fast单独证明。它也不冒称接受整棵后续b616集成树，后者多144个路径、含74个Managed Java生产路径；该集成树的正式完整门禁仍按维护者批准触发。测试树、Git stamp和编译输出不声称逐字节相同。

当前Hosted四项跳过继续明确保留：三项公共工作区用例需要macOS，一项包含12个媒体场景的方法需要手工bundle-ready属性。SDK macOS任务不执行该独立Hosted profile。成功SQL以及fault/admission XML按原政策没有上传；源码限定的证据来自完整console摘要、准确类/selector核对和实际已上传的Hosted/O4 XML。原有失败、取消和获取失败记录均保留。

真实HZ任务现仅跳过可选权限修复，成功安装Java并执行验证；HK任务仍运行原本地缓存安全检查。此前 [1a8b SDK CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40664899184)的四项任务在Java安装前失败，原因是把配置的共享缓存当成本地可修复缓存。确认新的完整13项替代运行已接受后，停止了旧版本剩余任务；已完成结果和四份失败日志均保留，未执行或停止的任务不算通过。上游现将npm安装验收放在定时或手动运行，因此PR中跳过的安装任务不能算新的9/9或96/96通过。

[第17轮评审](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13969#pullrequestreview-5688241194)针对当前16ef提交复核了历史阻断项，没有发布新增行内阻断项。该轮明确披露部分审查缺口，状态为COMMENTED，并非APPROVED；14条非阻断建议已在评审正文记录延期。[自动CR工作流](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40677250268)整轮成功。对附件中未公开的低置信度R17-9另作核实：旧源码缺脚本时退出127可复现，但10月29日仓库没有sdk-java标签或Java SDK发布运行，尚未证明存在当前被阻断的恢复发布；这项有条件的旧提交兼容风险保留为后续事项。当前检查没有失败或待运行任务，分支没有合并冲突，所需两项正式批准仍未满足。

R15字体修复保留20项回归、4项独立对照和两项真实Ubuntu UID1000缺字体对照；系统字体与配置不变，不声称容器测量了Chromium指标。两次新提交均未改变实际字体修复shell。本地此前的应用和元测试失败也单独保留，包括core2493通过/1失败、CLI3651通过/2失败、Node元测试269通过/43失败，局部对照不抹除较宽失败。原共享本地预算已耗尽，Java、Maven、SQL验证均留在CI。

prs.title: refactor(web-shell): share session view reset state
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR consolidates the shared transcript-view reset used by session changes and `/clear`. It also makes the component contract explicit: when a consumer keeps the same transcript component mounted across a session-key change, a reading pause from the previous session is cleared. A reconnect within the same session continues to preserve that pause.

## Why it's needed

The two reset paths maintained overlapping state independently. Sharing their common reset keeps those paths consistent and covers the component's mount-stable session-switch contract. The shipped routes already remount the transcript or render an empty transcript when switching sessions, so this is component-level hardening, not a demonstrated user-visible fix on those routes.

The main-CI failure tracked in #15038 is an unhandled rejection in the hosted workspace tool-turn tests. This Web Shell change does not fix that failure and must not close its tracker.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Keep one transcript component mounted, pause following, and change its session key while supplying the next session's non-empty transcript. Following should resume, both with and without a replay transition.
- Reconnect within the same session after pausing. The reading position should remain paused.
- Clear the transcript within the same session. The existing clear/reset behavior should remain intact.
- Treat the session-switch DOM cases as component-contract coverage; the shipped routes' remount/empty-first behavior is not a before/after reproduction of this change.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Earlier review reports establish that the added DOM cases fail without the session-switch pause reset and pass with it. The same reports establish that shipped-route-shaped cases already pass on the base. Those historical results support the component contract only; they are not new validation of the current head.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Windows | No local checks run in this closeout |
| Linux | Earlier DOM evidence is recorded in the PR discussion; the previous head's smoke check failed and checks for this closeout are pending |

## Risk & Scope

- The shared reset clears reading-pause, pagination-snapshot and expansion state. Each caller retains its additional resets; the settled-stale latch is cleared by `/clear`, not by the render-phase session switch.
- This PR changes no shipped route's mounting or empty-transcript behavior and does not repair the hosted workspace tool-turn failure.
- No local tests, build, lint or typecheck were run during this closeout, as requested. The previous smoke failure is reported separately and checks for the new head are pending; no passing browser result is claimed.
- No public API or migration change.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15038; this PR does not resolve it.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

合并会话切换与 `/clear` 共用的视图重置逻辑，并明确组件契约：调用方若在切换 session key 时保留同一个消息列表实例，上一会话的阅读暂停状态会被清除。同一会话重连仍保留阅读暂停。

## 为什么需要

两条路径原先分别维护重叠的重置状态。共用重置逻辑可以保持行为一致，并补全不重建组件时的会话切换契约。当前已发布页面在切换会话时会重建消息列表，或先渲染空记录，因此本 PR 是组件层加固，不是已证实的现有页面可见缺陷修复。

#15038 跟踪的是 hosted workspace tool-turn 测试中的未处理拒绝。该 Web Shell 改动不能修复此 CI 故障，也不应自动关闭它。

## Reviewer 测试计划

- 保持消息列表实例不变，暂停跟随后，改变 session key 并传入下一会话的非空记录。有回放与无回放两种情况下都应恢复跟随。
- 同一会话暂停后重连，应继续保持阅读位置。
- 在同一会话清空记录，原有清空和重置行为应保持。
- 新增 DOM 用例验证组件契约；已发布页面重建组件或先清空记录的路径不能作为本改动的前后对照复现。

## 已有证据与验证边界

此前评审记录表明，移除会话切换时的暂停重置会使新增 DOM 用例失败，保留时通过；按已发布页面形态编写的对照用例在 base 上原本就通过。这些历史结果只支撑组件契约，不代表本轮重新验证了当前 head。

本轮按用户要求未运行本地测试、构建、lint 或 typecheck。上一 head 的 Web Shell smoke 失败另行记录，新 head 的检查尚未完成；未声称浏览器验证通过。macOS 与 Windows 本轮均未验证，Linux 既有 DOM 证据见 PR 讨论。

## 风险与范围

公共重置处理阅读暂停、分页快照和展开状态；调用方保留各自额外的重置。settled-stale 状态只在 `/clear` 路径清除，不在渲染期会话切换路径清除。本 PR 不改变页面挂载方式，也不修复 hosted workspace tool-turn 故障。无公共 API 或迁移变更。

## 关联 Issue

Refs #15038；本 PR 不解决该 issue。

</details>


### Latest repair

The latest repair also cancels old-session follow/animation callbacks and strengthens continued-follow assertions. It carries the two smoke selector corrections already landed in #15860. These new cases were not run locally; current-head CI remains pending.

auto_merge.commit_title: fix(web-shell): reset follow pause when the session changes (#15038) (#15060)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* fix(web-shell): reset follow pause when the session changes (#15038)

Preserving a reading pause across reconnects also preserved it across a
session switch, because the pause lives in a ref that outlives the
displayed transcript. Switching sessions while paused then left the new
transcript stranded above the latest content even though the reader never
paused it. Drop the pause in the existing session-scoped reset.

Add a DOM test that pauses session A, switches to session B mid-replay,
and asserts B lands at the bottom once catch-up completes.

* test(web-shell): pin the no-replay session switch and share the reset (#15038)

* test(ci): exempt the TUI parity suites from the no-AK gate (#15038)

The no-AK wiring meta-test requires every runnable integration test to be selected or explicitly exempted. The OpenTUI parity suites added by #14964 run in the tui-parity workflow, so list them in the exemption map with the same runtime-budget reason as the neighboring interactive suites.
