prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR hardens the SDK Java Maven cache path after the suite/write-back lock split. Failed MySQL integration suites can still publish downloaded artifacts while preserving the original suite status, cache setup failures preserve the already-known suite result, and the final error annotation identifies the failed Maven stage. Cache seeds report copy failures, tolerate an unavailable cache or failed best-effort prune, and detach mutable resolver metadata before Maven runs. Write-back excludes the same metadata and partial-download files.

## Why it's needed

The lock relocation associated with #15262 already landed on main through #15128 and #15254. This branch is the remaining hardening delta: a failed suite should not throw away reusable downloads, a best-effort cache operation should not replace the suite result, and mutable resolver state should not be published as an immutable shared artifact. The test repair in 11c0f4b2fb12c also includes the deferred-status reporter in extracted shell snippets so those tests can exercise their intended paths.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Fail either Maven stage in the self-hosted MySQL integration lane. Reusable downloaded artifacts should reach write-back, later suites should not run, and the step should retain the failed stage's status and annotation.
- Run a green and a failed suite with an unusable cache or missing job-local repository. The cache fault should produce a warning and preserve the suite result.
- Seed a warm cache containing resolver markers and version metadata. Mutable hardlinks should be detached before Maven runs; write-back should publish artifacts while excluding resolver markers, metadata and partial-download files.
- Exercise a cold cache and a seed prune failure. Both should still reach Maven; an actual copy failure should remain visible in the log.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The current base already runs Maven before acquiring the cache lock. On the remaining delta, the prior Linux A/B report found that failed integration runs publish their download delta and retain failure, and that write-back excludes resolver markers. Its seed-prune regression was repaired by restoring best-effort pruning. The latest closeout comment records verification against the exact current head and distinguishes macOS tests from Linux shell witnesses and CI.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Focused workflow guard tests; Linux-only cases skip |
| Linux | See the exact-head closeout evidence and CI links; macOS results are not Linux verification |
| Windows | Not run locally |

## Current closeout

The branch now incorporates main's MySQL-only integration scope. The unusable-cache fixture uses a regular file in place of the cache directory, so it exercises the failure path regardless of root permission capabilities. This closeout received static source review only; no local tests, build, lint or typecheck were run, and CI was not awaited. Earlier test reports below remain historical evidence.

## Risk & Scope

The host cache remains best-effort. Failure to seed can increase network resolution. An unexpected bare-flock failure remains fatal. Real Maven resolver behavior and contention on the self-hosted pool require CI evidence beyond shell fixtures.

#15286 contains distinct follow-up work: existing-destination seed nesting, removal of old in-house artifacts from the host cache, self-hosted Checkstyle repository selection, and reference-release cache isolation. Those changes remain separately owned. Shared-helper and test-fixture extraction are deferred rather than widening this repair.

Related to #15262; the original lock relocation is already on main.



### Latest repair

The latest repair caps failed MySQL cache waits at 300 seconds and excludes metadata checksum sidecars plus older Resolver partial-download residue. Regression fixtures were updated but not executed; details and version attribution are in the closeout comment.

prs.title: fix(ci): keep sdk-java resolver bookkeeping and in-house jars out of the host cache (#15281)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The job-local Maven repository that the sdk-java suites resolve from no longer shares mutable inodes with the host cache:

- Every seed site drops `maven-metadata-local.xml` together with the other resolver bookkeeping names (`_remote.repositories`, `resolver-status.properties`, `*.lastUpdated`, `*.tmp`), so the unlocked Maven runs cannot rewrite a host-cache file through a seeded hardlink.
- The locked write-back removes the two in-house fixed-release coordinates from the host cache, prunes them at any depth rather than only at the repository root, publishes only job-produced files (the same five names stay job-local), and downgrades a failed cache-directory creation to a warning instead of reddening a green suite.
- The self-hosted Managed Agent Checkstyle leg resolves the SDK from the job-local repository the suite installed it into.
- The release builder's seed copies into the job-local repository instead of nesting a second `repository/` inside it, and drops the same bookkeeping names.
- The workflow meta-tests pin the five exclusions at every seed and both prunes, the write-back's children and their fd 9 closure, the host-side removal, the warning path, and the Checkstyle repository.

## Why it's needed

Moving Maven above the per-host lock is only safe while the job-local repository has no inode in common with the host cache. Maven's resolver rewrites its bookkeeping files in place, and the suites `install` two fixed-release in-house artifacts: seeded as hardlinks, both let an unlocked run mutate state that every sibling job on the host reads.

Correction to the earlier description: the lock-scope change itself ("only the write-back takes the lock") landed through #15128 and #15254 and is already on main. #15274 remains open with overlapping cache and deferred-status changes. This PR is the cache-isolation half that makes that scope safe, and it is judged on that, not on the lock wait from #15281.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open the `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job of a PR that touches a managed-agent path. The self-hosted step should show the `cp -aln` seed and all three Maven invocations before any `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock` line; the lock wait should appear only at the cache write-back, and the write-back should remove the in-house coordinates before copying. Grep the job-local repository for `maven-metadata-local.xml` after the suite: it should hold only job-produced files.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: a seeded `maven-metadata-local.xml` and a seeded `qwencode-sdk` jar were the same inode as the host cache, so the unlocked `mvn install` changed the host file (same inode, SHA and mtime both moved). After: the host file is byte- and mtime-identical while the job-local copy is still written, the write-back publishes zero bookkeeping files and never the in-house coordinates, and the host cache loses the pre-PR in-house trees. N/A for UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     |                       Status                        |
| :--------: | :-------------------------------------------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
| 🪟 Windows |                   ⚠️ not tested                    |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ meta-tests, size baseline, lint, Prettier        |

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests only: `scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js` (129 passed), `scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js` (239 passed, 1 skipped), `scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js` (14 passed). No JDK 21 / Maven in this container, so the real Java suite is left to CI.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a cold host pays the seed cost once, and the write-back is best-effort and capped at 300 seconds, matching the MariaDB lane. The write-back also deletes pre-existing in-house copies from the host cache — intended, because they are the stale fixed-release jars the in-house prune exists to stop publishing.
- Not validated / out of scope: the real ECS pool and its ticketed lock queue; the full JDK 21 Maven suite; the MySQL / MariaDB integration lanes; the hosted legs.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design documents: [English](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.md) | [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-20-sdk-java-fair-lock-queue.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Related to #15281 (the lock-scope change landed through #15128 and #15254; this PR closes the cache-isolation gap that the smaller lock scope depends on).

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

sdk-java 套件解析所使用的 job 本地 Maven 仓库，不再与宿主缓存共享可写 inode：

- 每个播种站点在删除其他解析器记账文件（`_remote.repositories`、`resolver-status.properties`、`*.lastUpdated`、`*.tmp`）的同时也删除 `maven-metadata-local.xml`，因此不持锁的 Maven 运行无法穿透播种的硬链接改写宿主缓存。
- 持锁的写回会在宿主缓存中删除两个内部固定发布坐标，按任意深度 prune 而不只匹配仓库根，只发布本 job 产生的文件（同样五个名字留在 job 本地），并把缓存目录创建失败降级为警告，而不是让绿色套件变红。
- self-hosted 的 Managed Agent Checkstyle leg 从套件安装到的 job 本地仓库解析 SDK。
- 发布构建的播种改为向 job 本地仓库内复制，而不是在其中再嵌套一个 `repository/`，并删除同样的记账文件。
- 工作流元测试钉住每个播种点与两处 prune 的五个排除名、写回子进程及其 fd 9 关闭、宿主侧删除、警告路径，以及 Checkstyle 的仓库。

## 为什么需要

把 Maven 移到池级锁之外，只有在 job 本地仓库与宿主缓存没有共同 inode 时才是安全的。Maven 解析器会原地重写记账文件，而套件会 `install` 两个固定发布坐标的内部构件：一旦以硬链接播种，二者都会让不持锁的运行改写同宿主上所有兄弟 job 都读取的状态。

对早先描述的更正：持锁范围的改动本身（“只有写回取锁”）已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地并在 main 上。#15274 仍然开放，其中缓存和延后状态处理的改动与本 PR 有重叠。本 PR 是让该范围安全成立的缓存隔离部分，评审应以这一点为准，而不是 #15281 的锁等待。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

打开一个触及 managed-agent 路径的 PR 的 `SDK Java (fast) / ubuntu-latest / Java 21` job。self-hosted step 应先出现 `cp -aln` 播种和三次 Maven 调用，之后才可能出现 `Waiting for the sdk-java host lock`；锁等待只应出现在缓存写回处，且写回会先删除内部坐标再复制。套件结束后在 job 本地仓库里 grep `maven-metadata-local.xml`，应当只剩本 job 产生的文件。

### 证据（Before & After）

Before：播种出的 `maven-metadata-local.xml` 与 `qwencode-sdk` jar 与宿主缓存是同一 inode，不持锁的 `mvn install` 会改写宿主文件（inode 相同，SHA 与 mtime 都变化）。After：宿主文件字节与 mtime 完全不变，同时 job 本地副本仍被写入；写回不发布任何记账文件、也从不发布内部坐标；宿主缓存中遗留的内部目录被删除。UI 不适用。

### 测试环境

仅元测试：`scripts/tests/sdk-java-workflow.test.js`（129 通过）、`scripts/tests/workflow-size.test.js`（239 通过、1 跳过）、`scripts/tests/sdk-java-lock.test.js`（14 通过）。容器内没有 JDK 21 / Maven，真实 Java 套件交给 CI。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险与取舍：冷宿主要付一次播种成本；写回是尽力而为且上限 300 秒，与 MariaDB 通道一致。写回还会删除宿主缓存中遗留的内部坐标副本——这是有意为之，因为它们正是内部坐标 prune 要阻止继续发布的过期固定发布 jar。
- 未验证 / 范围外：真实 ECS 池及其票据化锁队列；完整 JDK 21 Maven 套件；MySQL / MariaDB 集成通道；hosted leg。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

## 关联 issue

与 #15281 相关（持锁范围的改动已通过 #15128 和 #15254 落地；本 PR 补上更小持锁范围所依赖的缓存隔离缺口）。

</details>

prs.title: fix(qqbot): forward bot-authored messages with a [bot] tag
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The QQ channel now delivers bot-authored group and direct messages to the agent instead of discarding them. Such a message reaches the model with a `[bot]` prefix on the sender line, and the channel's group prompt explains that prefix and leaves the reply decision to the model. User-supplied `[bot]` text is still stripped, so a member cannot impersonate a bot.

## Why it's needed

Three `author.bot` guards drop bot traffic before the message can be formatted. They were added as an infinite-loop defense, but bot-to-bot conversation is an intentional operator configuration, and silently dropping the messages makes the bot deaf in multi-bot groups with no way to opt in. The formatter right behind those guards already says the design is to tag, not drop, so the two paths contradicted each other and the drop side won. Delivering the message with a `[bot]` marker keeps the loop risk manageable: the model is told what the prefix means, its existing wake/silence rules still apply, and `<noreply>` remains available for anything it does not want to answer.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Configure a QQ channel with `groupAllPolicy: "all"` and `groups: {"*": {"requireMention": false}}`.
2. Have a second bot post a message in the group.
3. Before: stderr shows `[QQ:<name>] Bot message dropped in group <group_openid>` and the message never reaches the session.
4. After: no drop line is logged; the session transcript shows the message with `[bot]` before the sender bracket, and the model answers or emits `<noreply>` on its own judgment.
5. Write `[bot] hello` as a human member: the text reaches the model with that literal token removed.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, on a live group deployment receiving traffic from another bot, the channel logged 55 `Bot message dropped` lines in one hour:

```
Oct 30 12:33:35 pi node[237732]: [QQ:qq] Bot message dropped in group 075EE1924E998DC89D8C2350C2C298DB
Oct 30 12:34:41 pi node[237732]: [QQ:qq] Bot message dropped in group 075EE1924E998DC89D8C2350C2C298DB
```

After the same deployment was rebuilt and restarted with the same patch, the period since the restart contains 0 drop lines (the local build is ahead of `main`, so this is a runtime check of the patch's behavior, not of the PR branch itself), and the rebuilt bundle contains the `[bot]` prompt line and no drop log. Unit coverage: the full `packages/channels/qqbot` suite is 716 passed across 8 files, including the rewritten forwarding tests and a new test that a human member cannot forge the `[bot]` tag. `tsc --build`, ESLint and Prettier are clean on the touched files.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests plus a local daemon deployment of the QQ channel on Linux (aarch64). No platform-specific code is touched.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: two bots in the same group can now keep answering each other. The model's silence rules, `<noreply>`, and the operator's group policy are the only brakes — this PR does not add a platform-level cycle cap, because that is the defense this change exists to remove.
- Not validated / out of scope: live delivery was verified against a deployment that receives other bots' messages; other QQ intents beyond group all-message mode were not separately exercised.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. No configuration change; operators who relied on silent filtering lose it, which is the point of the fix.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15903

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

QQ channel 现在会把其他机器人发来的群消息和私聊消息交给 agent，而不是丢弃。这类消息到达模型时，发送者行前会带 `[bot]` 前缀；channel 的群聊提示词会解释这个前缀，是否回复由模型自行判断。用户自己写的 `[bot]` 文本仍会被剥离，因此群成员无法伪装成机器人。

## 为什么需要

三处 `author.bot` 守卫在消息进入格式化之前就把机器人消息丢掉了。它们本来是作为无限循环的防御加的，但 bot-to-bot 对话是运营者有意的配置，静默丢弃会让机器人在多机器人群里完全失聪，而且没有任何开关可以打开。紧挨着这些守卫的格式化代码本身就写明了设计是打标签而不是丢弃，两条路径互相矛盾，最终丢弃那一侧赢了。带上 `[bot]` 标记把消息交给模型，循环风险仍然可控：模型知道前缀的含义，原有唤醒/静默规则照常生效，不想回答时仍可输出 `<noreply>`。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

1. 配置 QQ channel：`groupAllPolicy: "all"`，并在 `groups` 里设 `{"*": {"requireMention": false}}`。
2. 让另一个机器人在群里发一条消息。
3. 改动前：stderr 出现 `[QQ:<name>] Bot message dropped in group <group_openid>`，消息不会进入会话。
4. 改动后：不再出现 drop 日志；会话记录里该消息的发送者括号前带 `[bot]`，模型自行决定回复或输出 `<noreply>`。
5. 由人类成员发送 `[bot] hello`：到达模型时该字面前缀已被移除。

### 证据（Before & After）

改动前，一个持续收到其他机器人消息的线上群部署在一小时内记录了 55 条 `Bot message dropped`：

```
Oct 30 12:33:35 pi node[237732]: [QQ:qq] Bot message dropped in group 075EE1924E998DC89D8C2350C2C298DB
Oct 30 12:34:41 pi node[237732]: [QQ:qq] Bot message dropped in group 075EE1924E998DC89D8C2350C2C298DB
```

用同一补丁重新构建并重启同一部署后，重启以来的窗口内 drop 记录为 0 条（本地构建领先于 `main`，所以这是对补丁行为的运行期验证，而非对 PR 分支本身）；重新打包的产物里包含 `[bot]` 提示词行，不再包含 drop 日志。单测覆盖：`packages/channels/qqbot` 全量 8 个文件 716 通过，包含改写后的转发测试，以及新增的“人类成员无法伪造 `[bot]` 标签”测试。改动文件的 `tsc --build`、ESLint、Prettier 均干净。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

单测，加一台 Linux（aarch64）上的 QQ channel 本地 daemon 部署。未触碰平台相关代码。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：同一个群里的两个机器人现在可能互相接话。刹车只有模型的静默规则、`<noreply>` 以及运营者的群策略——本 PR 不引入平台级循环上限，因为那正是本次要移除的防御。
- 未验证/超出范围：线上投递是在一个确实会收到其他机器人消息的部署上验证的；群全量消息模式之外的其他 QQ intent 没有单独覆盖。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。没有配置变更；依赖静默过滤的运营者会失去该行为，这正是本次修复的目的。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #15903

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): align No-workspace sessions header with peer categories
prs.body:
## What this PR does

The No-workspace sessions group is a peer of Pinned, Workspaces and Recent in the Web Shell sidebar, but it still rendered with the header borrowed from an individual workspace entry. This PR switches that group to the shared category header so all four categories present the same height, indent, icon treatment, vertical spacing and right-side chevron behaviour.

## Why it's needed

When the four categories were collapsed, No-workspace sessions kept an extra bottom margin, sat at a slightly different indent, carried a dashed-circle workspace icon, and had no expand/collapse indicator. That made a category look like a single workspace row and left the collapsed stack visually uneven. The inconsistency is a follow-up to the promotion of this group to a peer category, and it is fixed by using the presentation the other three categories already share instead of introducing a new variant.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Open Web Shell with standalone session support and at least one no-workspace session, with Pinned, Workspaces and Recent also visible.
2. Compare the four category headers while expanded: height, left padding, text alignment, leading icon treatment and the trailing chevron should match.
3. Collapse all four categories: the vertical spacing between them should now be uniform, with no extra gap under No-workspace sessions.
4. Hover and focus each header: the chevron and the New session action fade in the same way as the other categories.
5. Toggle No-workspace sessions with the mouse and the keyboard, reload the page, and confirm the collapsed state persists and aria-expanded stays accurate.
6. Type in session search and confirm the group toggle is still disabled while searching.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before — the dashed-circle icon, the deeper indent and the extra gap under the group:

![before expanded](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2SinceJuly/qwen-code/assets/15867-sidebar-header/before-expanded.png)

After — same header treatment as the other categories:

![after expanded](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2SinceJuly/qwen-code/assets/15867-sidebar-header/after-expanded.png)

Collapsed before — hover background borrowed from a workspace row, no chevron, uneven spacing:

![before collapsed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2SinceJuly/qwen-code/assets/15867-sidebar-header/before-collapsed.png)

Collapsed after — uniform stack, chevron on the focused header like its peers:

![after collapsed](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2SinceJuly/qwen-code/assets/15867-sidebar-header/after-collapsed.png)

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Windows was not run locally. Linux was verified in a Docker `node:22-bookworm` arm64 container with a clean dependency install, where the affected sidebar unit tests and the web-shell type check pass.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and Playwright chromium e2e ran against `npm run dev`; Linux checks ran in Docker.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the New session action now uses the shared category reveal rules (opacity-based) instead of being fully hidden, so on hover-capable devices it fades in on hover/focus like Pinned, Workspaces and Recent, and it is always present in the accessibility tree. One e2e assertion that counted New session buttons across the whole sidebar was narrowed to the workspace row it actually targets.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows rendering. The archived settings view uses the same component and receives the same header, but that view is outside the visual scope of this report.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Closes #15867

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

Web Shell 侧边栏里，「无工作区会话」与「置顶」「工作区」「最近」是同级的可折叠分类，但它一直沿用单个工作区条目的标题样式。本 PR 把该分组切换到共享的分类标题，使四个分类在高度、缩进、图标处理、纵向间距和右侧展开箭头的表现上完全一致。

## 为什么需要

四项分类全部折叠时，「无工作区会话」多出一段底部间距、缩进略有偏差、左侧带虚线圆的工作区图标，且缺少展开/折叠指示。这让一个分类看起来像单条工作区记录，也让折叠后的列表间距参差不齐。该不一致是「无工作区会话」被提升为同级分类后的遗留问题；修复方式是复用另外三个分类已有的标题表现，而不是新增一种变体。

## 评审验证步骤

### 如何验证

1. 打开支持无工作区会话、且至少存在一个无工作区会话的 Web Shell，并让置顶、工作区、最近同时可见。
2. 展开状态下比较四个分类标题：高度、左内边距、文字对齐、左侧图标处理、右侧箭头应保持一致。
3. 折叠全部四项分类：分类之间的纵向间距应当均匀，「无工作区会话」下方不再多出间距。
4. 悬停和键盘聚焦每个标题：箭头与「新建会话」动作的显隐方式应与其他分类一致。
5. 用鼠标和键盘切换「无工作区会话」，刷新页面，确认折叠状态持久化且 aria-expanded 准确。
6. 在会话搜索框输入内容，确认搜索期间该分组的切换按钮仍被禁用。

### 证据（修改前后）

修改前：虚线圆图标、更深的缩进、分组下方多余的间距（截图见上方 before 图）。修改后：与其他分类相同的标题处理（截图见上方 after 图）。折叠状态下，修改前沿用工作区行的悬停背景、没有箭头且间距不均；修改后间距均匀，聚焦时箭头与其他分类一致。

### 测试环境

|    系统    | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Windows 未在本地运行。Linux 在 Docker `node:22-bookworm` arm64 容器中完成干净依赖安装后验证：相关侧边栏单测与 web-shell 类型检查均通过。

### 环境（可选）

单测与 Playwright chromium e2e 基于 `npm run dev`；Linux 检查在 Docker 中运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：「新建会话」动作改为使用共享分类的显隐规则（基于透明度），因此在支持悬停的设备上会像「置顶」「工作区」「最近」一样在悬停/聚焦时淡入，并常驻无障碍树。原先统计整个侧边栏「新建会话」按钮数量的一个 e2e 断言已收窄到它真正定位的工作区行。
- 未验证/范围外：Windows 渲染。设置中的归档视图复用了同一组件，也会得到相同的标题样式，但该视图不在本次报告的视觉范围内。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。

## 关联 Issue

Closes #15867

</details>

prs.title: perf(release): reuse verified native audio prebuilds across releases
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Reuses native audio prebuilds from a successful official main release when their build inputs match. A validated cache hit skips the native build matrix; lookup, trial download or payload validation failures fall back to rebuilding all five targets.

The fingerprint includes the audio package contents, dependency lock, package-manager pin and producing workflow/helper. Package versions are excluded because version bumps do not change native build inputs. Candidates must have the exact keyed artifact name and come from a successful main release in this repository. Selection requires 48 hours of remaining retention; consumption checks that the artifact has not expired.

This integrates with the ECS build/hosted npm publisher split already merged in #15832. Both consumers independently recheck provenance and payloads. A skipped native matrix is accepted only with a validated reuse ID. Linux builds use the same Node 22.22.3 Bookworm container and frozen dependencies on hosted and ECS runners, so changing the runner switch does not change the Linux build recipe under the same fingerprint. macOS and Windows keep their native builds.

The collector retains fixed-name and fingerprint-keyed artifacts with overwrite enabled and validates all five targets. The keyed upload is optional, so failure to seed a future release does not block the current release; its required fixed-name upload remains fatal. It uses main's existing shared runner preflight, including contained workspace cleanup, isolated tool state, Node 22 and disk checks. npm publication remains GitHub-hosted.

## Why it's needed

The v0.26.3 Linux x64 prebuild waited 74 minutes to perform about 50 seconds of work, followed by another collector queue. Reusing unchanged binaries removes those jobs from the release critical path. Cache misses still build normally, using the release-labelled ECS slots when the existing switch is enabled.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- A trusted, complete artifact with matching inputs skips the native matrix and allows both the ECS builder and hosted publisher to proceed. A skipped matrix without a reuse ID blocks them.
- Changed native inputs invalidate the key; version-only changes preserve it; refs without a lock never reuse.
- Fork/PR/other-workflow producers, failed runs, expired artifacts and incomplete payloads cannot seed reuse. Once reuse is accepted, downstream verification failures stop publication.
- Selection at just over 48 hours remains consumable minutes later; actually expired artifacts are rejected.
- Both Linux runner routes execute the same pinned container recipe. Collector cleanup preserves external symlink targets, and both uploads overwrite safely on rerun.

### Evidence (Before & After)

No visual UI surface. Release outputs, gates and filesystem effects are the observable contracts.

- [Local verification at 72d68b9b37](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15854#issuecomment-6503028031): 468 tests passed / 4 skipped; 20 runtime scenarios / 76 assertions passed; three relevant mutations detected. This is historical evidence, not a test pass for the integration commit.
- [Hosted miss-path dry-run](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40893890917) succeeded at 1b624d8e, including collection, download/validation, packaging and archive verification. It does not validate the newly combined Linux container path.
- [Integration verification at 77c92eb848](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15854#issuecomment-6503887899): 429 focused tests passed / 2 platform skips; 28 runtime records / 84 assertions passed, using real Git/HTTP/ZIP with controlled API fixtures. Removing the builder cache-hit condition in a scratch copy triggered the expected test failure. Both consumers, handoff and shared cleanup were covered.
- The exact Linux Docker command compiled on ECS ARM64 in 138 seconds, and the actual consumer loaded the generated prebuild with all seven exports available. No microphone recording or publication was attempted. The first probe exhausted shared `/tmp` inodes; its fixture was cleaned, the successful retry used the data disk, and [the affected lint rerun passed](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40920102749/job/123634212157).
- [Native Actions run at 77c92eb848](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40920395435): all four build jobs passed (macOS ARM64 plus x64 cross-build, Linux ARM64, Linux x64, Windows x64); collection also passed. The actual combined artifact was downloaded and passed the payload validator at `113629027f9f`, with all five platform files present. This run produced artifacts at `77c92eb848`; the native build recipe remains unchanged in the current head.

- [Current-head verification at cf6f39a183](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/15854#issuecomment-6513181162): merged main `619a601b39`, resolving the transcript fixture conflict by using main's complete file (no Web Shell file remains in this PR's diff). Made only the keyed cache-seed upload non-fatal, with mandatory-upload protection retained. Four focused suites: 378 passed / 2 environment skips / 0 failed. Removing the setting in a scratch copy triggered the intended assertion; five local condition/status cases passed. Formatting and independent correctness/simplicity reviews passed. Current CI and fresh approvals are pending.

### Tested on

Current-head focused verification: macOS ARM64 / Node 22.22.3. Historical integration/native evidence is explicitly attributed above. Native compile and real module load: ECS Linux ARM64 / Node 22.22.3 / glibc 2.36. Hosted native matrix builds also passed as linked above. End-to-end main-to-main reuse and real publication remain unverified.

## Risk & Scope

- Audio reuse works with the ECS switch enabled or unset. #15832 is already merged; activation remains a separate operational step using labelled runner processes on existing machines, without dedicating or reinstalling a host.
- A branch run cannot seed a trusted main-to-main hit. That acceptance requires successful main runs and remains outstanding.
- Container tags and macOS/Windows runner images can change without changing their names. The Linux version tag makes the hosted/ECS recipes consistent but is not an immutable image digest. Full environment reproducibility is outside this change.
- No real publication or production switch activation is performed by this PR. Failed selection rebuilds; failed verification after accepted reuse stops the release.
- Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/audio-prebuild-reuse/docs/design/2026-10-29-audio-prebuild-reuse.md) / [中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/fix/audio-prebuild-reuse/docs/design/2026-10-29-audio-prebuild-reuse.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

References #15461 and #15465. Complements merged #15832.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

输入不变时复用成功 main 发布的音频产物，跳过五目标原生构建；查询、试下载或载荷校验失败则完整重建。来源与保留期检查不变，ECS 构建方和 hosted npm 发布方都独立复核来源与载荷。#15832 已合并，本 PR 保留其发布边界和共享清理保护；hosted 与 ECS 的 Linux 构建使用同一个 Node 22.22.3 Bookworm 容器，避免同一个指纹对应两种构建环境。

最新提交 cf6f39a183 已合并 main 619a601，采用上游完整测试文件解决冲突，Web Shell 文件不再出现在本 PR 差异中。复用缓存上传失败现在不会阻断当前发布，当次必需的产物上传和校验仍然失败即阻断。当前版本定向测试 378 通过、2 条环境跳过；移除保护的反例准确失败，格式和独立复审通过，新 CI 与批准仍待完成。77c92eb848 的原生构建和汇总整轮成功，113629027f9f 实际下载的五目标产物校验通过，均为明确归属版本的历史证据；原生构建配方没有变化。main→main 命中、真实发布和 ECS 开关启用尚未完成。

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): materialize inert external workspaces
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds an operator-only way to materialize an already registered external storage alias as a discoverable Workspace with an explicitly delegated owner. The operation creates only metadata and an idempotent receipt in one transaction. It does not allocate storage, start a worker, or enable Session execution.

An owner can discover the new Workspace, but its Session-creation and directory-selection capabilities remain unavailable. Replaying a completed request returns the original creation receipt without restoring revoked access, changing a renamed Workspace, or reactivating removed metadata.

## Why it's needed

#15512 needs a durable link between registered external storage and the Workspace a Session will eventually select. Registration alone creates storage records, not a Workspace or owner grant. This is a deliberately inert prerequisite: later execution admission, tools, recovery and exact-worker close must become usable together rather than allowing partially wired Sessions.

This increment is independent of #15654's provisioning prerequisite and does not copy its changes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

On an isolated fresh catalog, register external storage using the loopback operator credential, then materialize its alias with an owner. Confirm the owner can discover it on the public and WebShell surfaces, an unrelated actor cannot, and neither Session creation nor directory selection is advertised. Requests without operator authorization must fail.

Replay the request and confirm its receipt is stable and rows are not duplicated. Change the owner or display name under the same key and confirm a conflict. Revoke access or rename/remove the Workspace, then replay: the original receipt returns, but current state must not be restored. Concurrent attempts must produce one Workspace, grant and completed receipt. A receipt-write failure must roll back the preceding Workspace and grant writes.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The baseline has external registration but no materialization operation. The candidate was exercised through actual Spring HTTP and an isolated MySQL 8.4 instance on the designated Linux development machine: registration/materialization/replay succeeded, owner-only discovery remained non-executable, and empty public/WebShell Session creation was rejected before execution state was created. Raw SQL readback found no Sessions, Turns or Runtime bindings.

Prompted creation in the live Harness-disabled configuration was rejected at the deployment availability gate; this is not claimed as live EXTERNAL-specific prompt admission proof. Separate focused service tests exercise the storage-kind gate with Harness availability supplied. No browser screenshot or running Hosted worker is claimed for this inert slice.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :--- | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ source review only; no heavy runtime execution |
| Windows | ⚠️ not tested |
| Linux | ✅ focused Java/MySQL and real HTTP validation on development host |

### Environment (optional)

Remote JDK 21.0.12.1, Maven 3.9.11, task-isolated dependency repository and MySQL 8.4.13 in a capped Podman container. Existing services and databases were preserved. The application ran from compiled production classes and cached dependencies, without test fixture classes.

Validation: 110 focused Java tests and both Checkstyle executions passed. The first nine-case MySQL run had eight passes and one test exception-wrapper mismatch; after a test-only correction, the affected rollback method passed on both H2 and MySQL. Original failed evidence is retained; these results are not presented as a second full nine-case run. The CLI inventory suite passed 204 tests after correcting its generated digest header; scoped formatting and the CLI dependency build/bundle passed. The full local review engine exited before model execution because its isolated operator-policy configuration could not be read; that gate is unverified. Independent source reviews found no remaining issue in this slice. This PR is **ready for review**; full CI and final acceptance remain pending.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the authenticated operator may delegate ownership to the specified actor. That field is a grant target, not proof of authenticated user identity or tenant membership. Existing loopback and bearer checks remain required; public authentication is unchanged.
- Not validated / out of scope: full external Hosted execution, real worker/tool effects, available-Harness prompted Session flow, drain/ACK safety, recovery, shell/capture and full CI. This PR does not complete #15512.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: the new receipt namespace extends the shared V1 catalog CHECK under the repository's pre-release fresh-catalog policy. A source revert is not a guarantee that an old binary can open the changed database catalog. No V2 migration or schema-version bump is introduced.

Design: [English](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.md) · [简体中文](docs/design/2026-10-25-external-hosted-workspace.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Part of #15512. Related prerequisite: #15654. Neither this PR nor the provisioning prerequisite closes the full feature issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增仅限 operator 的入口，将已注册的外部存储别名物化为可发现的 Workspace，并显式授予 owner。整个操作在单事务中创建元数据和幂等回执，不分配存储、不启动 worker，也不开放 Session 执行。

owner 可以发现 Workspace，但创建 Session 和选择目录的能力仍不可用。完成请求的重放只返回原创建回执，不恢复已撤销的权限、不覆盖重命名，也不重新激活已移除的元数据。

## 为什么需要

#15512 需要把已注册外部存储与将来 Session 选择的 Workspace 建立持久关联。注册只有存储记录，没有 Workspace 和 owner 授权。这是刻意保持惰性的前置阶段；后续执行准入、工具、恢复和精确 worker 关闭必须配套打通，不能先暴露半接线 Session。

本增量独立于 #15654 的 provisioning 前置能力，不复制其改动。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

在隔离的新 catalog 上，使用 loopback operator 凭据注册外部存储，再指定 owner 物化别名。确认 public 和 WebShell 两个接口均只有 owner 能发现该 Workspace；不能创建 Session，不允许目录选择。缺少 operator 授权的请求必须失败。

重放同一请求，确认回执稳定、无重复记录。同键更换 owner 或名称必须冲突。撤销权限或重命名/移除 Workspace 后重放，应返回原回执，但不得恢复当前状态。并发调用只能产生一个 Workspace、一条授权和一条完成回执。回执写入失败时，先前 Workspace 和授权必须回滚。

### 修改前后证据

基线已有 external registration，但没有 materialization 操作。候选已在指定 Linux 开发机通过真实 Spring HTTP 和隔离 MySQL 8.4 验证：注册、物化和重放成功；owner-only 发现仍不可执行；public/WebShell 的空 Session 创建在产生执行记录前被拒绝。SQL 读回确认 Session、Turn、Runtime binding 均为零。

真实环境禁用了 Harness，因此非空输入创建被更早的部署可用性门禁拒绝；不冒充真实 EXTERNAL 专属 prompt 准入证据。另有聚焦 service 测试在提供 Harness 可用性的前提下覆盖存储类型门禁。本惰性阶段没有声称运行 Hosted worker 或提供浏览器截图。

### 测试环境

| OS | 状态 |
| :--- | :---: |
| macOS | ⚠️ 只做源码审查，未执行重型运行时 |
| Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| Linux | ✅ 开发机聚焦 Java/MySQL 与真实 HTTP 验证 |

### 环境补充

开发机 JDK 21.0.12.1、Maven 3.9.11、任务隔离依赖仓库和受资源限制的 MySQL 8.4.13 Podman 容器。现有服务和数据库未改动。应用使用编译的生产类和缓存依赖启动，不加载测试 fixture 类。

110 个聚焦 Java 测试和两项 Checkstyle 通过。首次九用例 MySQL 执行八通过、一项测试异常包装类型不匹配；仅修正测试后，该回滚方法在 H2 和 MySQL 均通过。保留原失败，不说成重新跑过完整九用例。CLI inventory 的生成摘要头修正后，204 个测试通过；范围内格式与 CLI 依赖构建/bundle 通过。完整本地评审引擎因无法读取隔离的 operator-policy 配置而在模型调用前退出，该门禁仍未验证；独立源码审查未发现此切片的剩余问题。此 PR 现已 **Ready for review**；完整 CI 和最终验收仍待完成。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：经过授权的 operator 可向指定 actor 授予 owner。请求体字段是授权目标，不证明调用者身份或租户成员关系；原 loopback 和 bearer 限制必须满足，公开认证保持不变。
- 未验证/范围外：完整 external Hosted 执行、真实 worker 文件效果、可用 Harness 的非空 Session 流程、drain/ACK、恢复、shell/capture 和完整 CI。本 PR 不完成 #15512。
- 兼容/迁移：新回执 namespace 按项目预发布 fresh-catalog 策略扩展共享 V1 CHECK；源码可回退不等于旧二进制能读取新 catalog。没有 V2 migration 或 schema 版本提升。

设计文档为上方链接的英中两份，保持同步。

## 关联问题

属于 #15512；相关前置为 #15654。本 PR 和 provisioning 前置都不关闭完整功能 issue。

</details>


## Scope note (updated 2026-10-29)

The opening paragraphs still describe the materialization step as a "deliberately inert prerequisite". That was true of the commit they were written for, and it is no longer true of this branch as a whole: subsequent commits here add the live `EXTERNAL_FILES` behaviour — the input-attachment gate in the session capability row, the external-files branch of `mayChangeContextShape`, and the receipt-backed `LOST` release in `WorkspaceRuntimeTransport.releaseRetired` (R2-1).

So, precisely: the **materialization operation** remains metadata-only, allocating no storage and starting no worker; the **capability gates and the close-path release in this same branch are not inert** and do change what a live Session is offered and how a stranded external binding is released.

Raised as R2-11 in review and corrected here rather than left standing, because a description that calls the change inert while the code enables the profile misleads the next reader.

prs.title: feat(cli): support exact-version updates without npm discovery
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds `qwen update --target-version <version>` for standalone installations. An explicit target skips npm version discovery and installs that exact release through the existing download and verification flow, including `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`. Omitting the option preserves normal update discovery.

Concrete stable and prerelease versions accept an optional leading `v`. Explicit requests allow same-version reinstalls and downgrades. Invalid targets are rejected before downloading, and a downloaded executable reporting a different version is rejected before activation. Unsupported installation methods return an actionable error instead of suggesting an unpinned upgrade. Help and error text are localized.

## Why it's needed

Operators may already have selected a release while npm registry access is unavailable. Configuring a reachable artifact source alone does not help because the current update command performs registry discovery first. Explicit selection makes that dependency unnecessary and prevents discovery from choosing a different release.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run an explicit-version update with a custom HTTPS release root while npm registry access is unavailable. It should install exactly the selected version without invoking npm or contacting a registry.
- Try a concrete prerelease, a same-version reinstall and an explicit downgrade. Each should use the specified version and retain the previous installation for rollback.
- Try a mutable tag, malformed version, missing argument, unavailable archive, incorrect checksum or an archive whose executable reports a different version. Failures must preserve the original installation and clean up update locks and temporary files.
- For a non-standalone installation, expect a nonzero exit and instructions to install the selected version manually, without an unpinned package-manager command.
- Omit the target option and confirm that normal version discovery remains in use.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the installed CLI's update help has no target-version option; source always runs version discovery before downloading.

After: focused unit tests pass, and isolated CLI tests use a local HTTPS release source with registry access unavailable to verify exact installation and failure preservation. Detailed E2E evidence is posted separately.

Validation: full build, workspace typecheck, bundle, 170 focused tests, changed-file ESLint and Prettier checks passed. The npm lockfile was used for final validation; the optional pnpm layout exceeded an unrelated document-export asset budget, while the npm build passed that gate.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Tested: build, typecheck, unit tests and isolated CLI E2E |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Baseline update help only; new implementation not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node.js 22.23.1. E2E runs use isolated home directories and disposable installations, a local HTTPS server with a temporary trusted CA, and network/subprocess guards. Downloaded fixtures contain a real Node runtime and a small version-reporting CLI; this verifies updater behavior, not the functionality of a complete new release. No real installation was updated.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: explicit requests intentionally permit reinstalls and downgrades. Version equality is now checked before activation for all standalone update entrypoints.
- Not validated / out of scope: Windows deferred replacement, full release-package acceptance, daemon/UI upgrade orchestration and release approval policies.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: existing calls without the option retain version discovery; malformed versions are rejected more strictly.

## Linked Issues

Closes #11484

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

为独立安装新增 `qwen update --target-version <version>`。指定目标时跳过 npm 版本查询，通过现有下载与校验流程安装该精确版本，并继续支持 `QWEN_UPDATE_BASE_URL`。不指定参数时保留原有版本查询行为。

支持具体稳定版和预发布版本，以及可选的 `v` 前缀。显式请求允许同版本重装和降级。非法目标在下载前拒绝；下载后若程序报告的版本与目标不一致，则在激活前拒绝。不支持的安装方式返回可操作的错误提示，避免建议一个未固定版本的升级命令。帮助与错误文案已本地化。

## 需求背景

用户可能已经确定要安装的版本，但无法访问 npm registry。仅配置可访问的制品源仍然不够，因为当前升级命令会先查询 registry。指定版本可以移除这个依赖，并避免版本发现选择另一个版本。

## 审查者验证计划

### 验证方法

- 在 npm registry 不可用时，结合自定义 HTTPS 下载源执行指定版本升级。应准确安装目标版本，不调用 npm，也不访问 registry。
- 验证具体预发布版本、同版本重装和显式降级。每种情况均应使用指定版本，并保留旧安装以供回退。

- 不提供目标参数时，应继续执行原有版本查询。

### 修改前后证据

修改前：已安装 CLI 的升级帮助中没有指定版本参数；源码在下载前始终查询版本。

修改后：相关单测通过；隔离 CLI 测试使用本地 HTTPS 制品源，在 registry 不可用的条件下验证准确安装及失败保护。详细 E2E 证据单独评论发布。

### 测试平台

- macOS：构建、类型检查、单测和隔离 CLI E2E 已验证。
- Windows：未在本地验证。
- Linux：仅检查基线升级帮助，未在本地验证新实现。

### 验证环境

Node.js 22.23.1。E2E 使用隔离 HOME、临时安装、本地 HTTPS 服务、临时受信 CA，以及网络和子进程监测。下载制品由真实 Node 运行时和精简的版本输出 CLI 组成，证明的是升级器行为，而非完整新版本的功能验收。未升级任何真实安装。

## 风险与范围

关联并关闭 #11484。

prs.title: test(managed): record which load path produced each post-crash entry
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the hosted process-crash fixture records a post-crash `/load` that was not cancellation-only, it now also records which caller sent it, and both assertions print that attribution instead of a bare boolean list.

The recorded discriminator is taken from the request body the driver already holds: whether `cancellationTakeover` was set, and the neighbouring flags that distinguish the connector's load paths (`passiveManagedRuntimeRecovery`, `driveRuntimeRecovery`, `mcpManagementOnly`, and whether `cancellationPromptId` was present). Entries are formatted as one line each, so a failing run reads `takeover=false passive=true drive=false mcpOnly=false promptId=true` rather than `false`.

The assertion itself is unchanged.

## Why it's needed

`HostedProcessCrashIT.processCrashesNeverReplayHostedToolsOnMySql` fails on main, and its failure message cannot say why. The test asserts that every `/load` the replacement session issues after the injected crash carries cancellation-only semantics, but the sequence it records does not hold still across runs:

| Run | Branch | `postFailureLoads` |
|---|---|---|
| 40943334546 | main | 9 entries, `[T,T,F,F,F,F,F,F,F]` |
| 40885888315 | main | 10 entries, `[T,T,F,F,F,F,F,F,F,T]` |
| 40925586760 | PR #15882 | 9 entries, `[T,F,T,F,F,F,F,F,F]` |
| 40917409010 | codex/hosted-fault-managed-jdbc | 9 entries, `[T,F,F,F,T,F,F,F,F]` |
| 40879717089 | feat/managed-live-message-pages | 10 entries, `[T,F,F,F,F,F,T,F,F,T]` |
| 40841759553 | feat/managed-sql-authority-window | 0 entries |

Different lengths, independently moving positions, and one run that recorded no loads at all — which fails the preceding `length > 0` assertion with no context whatsoever. A deterministic defect would hold the shape, so the useful next question is which of the connector's load paths produced the offending entries, and today's report cannot answer it.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Read the three changed expressions in `integration-tests/helpers/hosted-process-crash-driver.ts`: the new `postFailureLoadOrigins` field, the recording site inside the existing `injected && pathname.endsWith('/load')` branch, and the two assertion messages. Confirm the booleans in `postFailureLoads` are produced by exactly the same condition as before, so no assertion semantics moved.

Confirm the added key is additive: the Java side reads the results file with a Jackson tree read and `path(...)` lookups only, with no schema validation, so an extra array cannot fail an existing assertion.

**What confirmation looks like for a diagnostics-only change.** This PR is correct if the *next failing* full-tier run prints one origin line per recorded load, so the failure names its own caller. A passing run proves nothing about this change: the suite would go green for the same reason it goes green today on a lucky ordering, and none of the new text is on that path. The observable difference is therefore only in the failure message, and the before/after below shows it.

**How to judge whether an origin line is right.** Each line reports the five flags the connector actually serialises: `cancellationTakeover`, `passiveManagedRuntimeRecovery`, `driveRuntimeRecovery` and `cancellationPromptId` on `LoadHarnessSession`, and `mcpManagementOnly` on `HostedHarnessClient`. They are written omitempty, which is why the recorder tests `=== true` and `typeof === 'string'` rather than truthiness — an absent key must read as absent, not as `false`-because-undefined-coerced. Two checks make a line falsifiable: the `takeover=` field must agree with the boolean recorded in the same position (they are computed from the identical expression, so any disagreement means the recording site is broken), and a line that is `takeover=false` with `promptId=true` names a targeted-cancellation load rather than the cancel-only takeover path, which is the distinction the report previously could not express.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before, a failing run reported only:

```
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: replacement must use cancellation-only loads
```

After, the same failure names its own origins:

```
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: replacement must use cancellation-only loads: takeover=true passive=false drive=false mcpOnly=false promptId=false | takeover=false passive=true drive=false mcpOnly=false promptId=true | …
```

and the zero-load case gains its own message instead of a bare `false !== true`.

N/A for screenshots: this is test-instrumentation output, not a user-visible surface.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |  N/A   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

Linux is marked ⚠️ rather than N/A: the code path runs in the Linux MySQL job in CI, and I did not execute it locally. See Risk & Scope.

### Environment (optional)

Local checks ran against the shared `node_modules` of the main checkout from a dedicated worktree. N/A for runtime: no daemon, sandbox or MySQL was started for this change.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the results array is larger, and a reviewer might read the new lines as if they changed the assertion. They do not — the boolean and its condition are byte-identical, and both new lines are only message text and one appended array.
- Not validated / out of scope: the diagnostics have never been exercised end to end, because the only lane that runs this fixture is the full-tier MySQL job, and that job is red on main for the underlying reason (#15898). I did not loosen the assertion to make the lane green, and I did not attempt a product-side ordering fix without knowing which caller is at fault — that is what this change is meant to reveal.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. The results file gains one field, read by Jackson tree access with no schema; no API, CLI or protocol surface changes.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15898 — this does not close it. It makes the next failing run answer the question the issue currently has to guess at.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当托管进程崩溃夹具记录到一次「崩溃后发生的、非 cancellation-only 的 `/load`」时，现在会同时记录**是哪个调用方发出的**，并且两条断言都会打印这份归因，而不是只给一串布尔值。

记录的判别信息取自 driver 本来就持有的请求体：`cancellationTakeover` 是否置位，以及用于区分 connector 各条 load 路径的相邻标志（`passiveManagedRuntimeRecovery`、`driveRuntimeRecovery`、`mcpManagementOnly`，以及是否带 `cancellationPromptId`）。每条记录格式化成一行，因此失败时会读作 `takeover=false passive=true drive=false mcpOnly=false promptId=true`，而不是一个 `false`。

断言本身没有改动。

## 为什么需要它

`HostedProcessCrashIT.processCrashesNeverReplayHostedToolsOnMySql` 在 main 上是红的，而它的失败信息说不清原因。该测试断言：注入崩溃之后，替换会话发出的每一次 `/load` 都必须带 cancellation-only 语义；但它记录到的序列**在不同运行之间并不稳定**：

| 运行 | 分支 | `postFailureLoads` |
|---|---|---|
| 40943334546 | main | 9 项 `[T,T,F,F,F,F,F,F,F]` |
| 40885888315 | main | 10 项 `[T,T,F,F,F,F,F,F,F,T]` |
| 40925586760 | PR #15882 | 9 项 `[T,F,T,F,F,F,F,F,F]` |
| 40917409010 | codex/hosted-fault-managed-jdbc | 9 项 `[T,F,F,F,T,F,F,F,F]` |
| 40879717089 | feat/managed-live-message-pages | 10 项 `[T,F,F,F,F,F,T,F,F,T]` |
| 40841759553 | feat/managed-sql-authority-window | 0 项 |

长度不同、`true` 的位置各自漂移，还有一次**完全没有记录到任何 load**——那会先撞上前面那条 `length > 0` 断言，而且同样没有上下文。确定性缺陷不会这样变形状，所以下一步该问的是「connector 的哪条 load 路径产生了这些项」，而当前的报告回答不了。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

阅读 `integration-tests/helpers/hosted-process-crash-driver.ts` 中改动的三处：新增的 `postFailureLoadOrigins` 字段、既有 `injected && pathname.endsWith('/load')` 分支内的记录点，以及两条断言的消息。确认 `postFailureLoads` 中的布尔值仍由**完全相同的条件**产生，即断言语义没有移动。

确认新增键是纯增量的：Java 侧用 Jackson 树读取加 `path(...)` 取值、没有 schema 校验，因此多一个数组不会让既有断言失败。

**纯诊断改动的「验证通过」长什么样。** 本 PR 正确的判据是：**下一次跑红**时，full-tier 的失败信息会为每条记录打印一行 origin，从而自己指出调用方。**一次跑绿并不能证明这个改动**——套件会变绿的原因是今天偶尔顺序凑巧时它也会绿，而新加的文字根本不在那条路径上。因此可观察的差异只存在于失败消息里，下面的改动前后对照就是它。

**如何判断一行 origin 是否正确。** 每一行报告的是 connector 真实序列化的五个字段：`LoadHarnessSession` 上的 `cancellationTakeover`、`passiveManagedRuntimeRecovery`、`driveRuntimeRecovery`、`cancellationPromptId`，以及 `HostedHarnessClient` 上的 `mcpManagementOnly`。它们以 omitempty 写出，这正是记录端用 `=== true` 与 `typeof === 'string'`（而不是真值判断）的原因——字段缺失必须读作缺失，而不是因为 undefined 被强制转换而读成 `false`。两条检查让每一行可被证伪：其一，`takeover=` 必须与同一位置记录的布尔值一致（两者由完全相同的表达式计算，任何不一致都说明记录点坏了）；其二，`takeover=false` 且 `promptId=true` 的行指向的是「定向取消」的 load，而不是 cancel-only 接管路径，而这正是旧报告无法表达的区分。

### 证据（改动前后）

改动前，失败只报告：

```
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: replacement must use cancellation-only loads
```

改动后，同一次失败会自己说明来源：

```
AssertionError [ERR_ASSERTION]: replacement must use cancellation-only loads: takeover=true passive=false drive=false mcpOnly=false promptId=false | takeover=false passive=true drive=false mcpOnly=false promptId=true | …
```

而「零次 load」这种情况也有了独立消息，不再只是一个没有上下文的 `false !== true`。

截图部分为 N/A：这是测试诊断输出，不是用户可见界面。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows | N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

Linux 标 ⚠️ 而非 N/A：该代码路径在 CI 的 Linux MySQL job 中运行，我本地没有执行它。详见风险章节。

### 环境（可选）

本地检查在独立 worktree 中使用主检出共享的 `node_modules` 完成。运行时为 N/A：本次改动没有启动 daemon、sandbox 或 MySQL。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：结果数组变长；评审可能误以为新增行改动了断言。实际没有——布尔值及其条件完全一致，新增的两处只是消息文本和一个追加的数组。
- 未验证／超出范围：这份诊断从未端到端跑过，因为只有 full-tier 的 MySQL job 会执行该夹具，而它在 main 上因底层原因（#15898）是红的。我**没有**为了让它转绿而放宽断言，也**没有**在不知道是哪个调用方出错的情况下直接改产品侧顺序——而这正是本次改动要揭示的东西。
- 破坏性变更／迁移说明：无。结果文件新增一个字段，由 Jackson 树读取，无 schema；API、CLI 与协议面均无改动。

## 关联 Issue

引用 #15898，但**不关闭**它。本次改动只是让下一次失败能回答 issue 目前只能靠猜的问题。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Selects the inserted radio through keyboard focus and Space before the Generated UI virtual-unmount test records its retained state. It explicitly checks the selection before parking the card and preserves all existing runtime-identity and post-return value assertions.

## Why it's needed

The [hosted smoke job on #15886](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40934997305/job/123663599880) failed this setup action in all three attempts: `locator.check: Clicking the checkbox did not change its state`. In the retained retry trace, nested-frame pointer coordinates changed from `(435.5, 630)` to `(435.5, 755)` and the first click was intercepted by `html`; the failure screenshot places the radios around y=614. The retention test should establish an edited value without depending on a moving nested iframe's pointer coordinates.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

The inserted second radio should become selected through its normal keyboard interaction. After the card is hidden and restored, the same App and Worker identities, radio selection, select value and text value must remain. Applying the restored values must still produce the second-round answer. This change does not waive or verify production pointer behavior.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the linked CI log and its `web-shell-e2e-smoke` retry trace show the failed pointer action. After: static review confirms that setup uses focus and Space, with an added precondition assertion and all existing retention assertions intact. The repaired browser interaction has not been executed locally.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Static source/diff review and `git diff --check` only |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux | Existing hosted CI log, trace and screenshot inspected; repaired CI pending |

No local tests, builds, lint, typecheck, dependency installation or browser probes ran, as requested. CI is not awaited.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: this retention scenario establishes the radio value through keyboard input rather than a pointer; pointer hit testing is outside its retained-state contract.
- Not validated / out of scope: runtime success of the repair, production pointer behavior and the separate recovery-fixture failure handled in #15883.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; one E2E setup action changes, with no product code, timeout or retry change.

## Linked Issues

Found during #15886 closeout, alongside the separately owned #15883 fixture correction.

prs.title: test(managed-agent): select managed JDBC in Hosted fault fixtures
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Make Hosted fault-test fixtures explicitly select the Managed JDBC bean, including their custom publication stores and recovery probe. The fixtures then use the same identity encoding and row decoding as production Managed stores.

## Why it's needed

The default JDBC bean returns VARBINARY identity columns as byte arrays. Hosted fault tests compare them with strings, cast them to strings, or turn them into `[B@...` values and query for nonexistent identities. The Managed JDBC bean already handles these columns, but it is not the default candidate. The affected standalone Spring fixtures still selected JDBC by type after the production persistence split.

The repair changes only fixture bean selection. All SQL, failure injection, physical-effect checks, recovery assertions, deadlines, and test selectors remain unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the full Hosted process fault gate. Confirm channel admission queries find the original session, automation publication rows expose their actual identity strings, and workspace/recovery probes preserve the original execution identity across retries and restarts. Genuine replay, recovery, and physical-settlement failures must still fail their existing assertions.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: [the full Hosted fault job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40885888315/job/123489365339) reports 34 failures and 7 errors. Concrete examples include a string execution ID compared with its byte array, channel input counts of zero after successful admission, and byte-array-to-string casts in automation checks. After: explicit bean selection now uses the existing Managed identity adapter. CI is pending; this patch is not a claim that all 41 failures share one cause.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | No local tests, build, or lint; static source/log review and diff whitespace check only |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Existing full CI failure inspected; repaired full gate pending |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: fixture SQL now follows the same Managed identity conversions as production, so CI must check fault-injection behavior as well as assertions.
- Not validated / out of scope: remaining unrelated Hosted failures and runner disk/Windows environment problems are not declared fixed. No production, schema, release tag, or test-filter changes.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Relates to #15820 and the Managed runtime 0.26.3 recovery.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的修改

让 Hosted 故障测试夹具显式选择 Managed JDBC bean，包括自定义发布存储和恢复探针。夹具将使用与生产 Managed 存储一致的身份编码和行解码。

## 为什么需要

默认 JDBC bean 将 VARBINARY 身份列返回为字节数组。Hosted 故障测试将这些值与字符串比较、强制转换成字符串，或者转成 `[B@...` 后查询不存在的身份。Managed JDBC bean 已处理这些列，但它不是默认候选；生产持久化拆分后，这些独立 Spring 夹具仍按类型获取 JDBC。

修复只改变夹具选择的 bean。所有 SQL、故障注入、物理副作用检查、恢复断言、截止时间和测试选择保持不变。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

执行完整 Hosted process fault 门禁。确认通道准入查询能找到原会话，自动化发布记录返回实际身份字符串，工作区与恢复探针在重试和重启后仍保持原始执行身份。真实的重复执行、恢复和物理结束失败仍必须触发原有断言。

### 前后证据

prs.title: feat(serve): add user-scope Skill activation routes
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds two daemon routes that enable or disable Skills in the **user** settings scope, which every workspace merges: `PUT /skills/:name/activation` and `PUT /skills/activation` (batch, up to 100 names). Like `PUT /extensions/activation`, they take no workspace selector. The body is `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`; `mode` applies to disables only. Each request leaves the name in exactly one user list: a `hard` disable (the default) writes `skills.disabled`, a `default` disable writes `skills.defaultDisabled`, and an enable writes `skills.enabled`; the name is removed from the other two.

An enable is refused without writing, answering `200` with `changed: false` and a `block` naming the entry, when the merged config would still keep the Skill disabled: a System/SystemDefaults `skills.disabled` entry under either spelling, a User entry in the other spelling, or a `skills.defaultDisabled` entry no identically spelled grant cancels. Workspace entries never refuse a user write; they keep gating only their own workspace. Batch enables recheck refused names until the batch converges, so the outcome does not depend on request order.

After a change, every registered workspace runtime is reconciled and each changed key emits `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"` and the existing `skill_toggle` mutation object on every workspace event stream. To make the change reach live sessions, `workspaceSkillsRefresh` gains an optional `settingsScopes` parameter: user writes ask the ACP child and its sessions to re-read the user file as well, while every other refresh keeps re-reading only the workspace file. The runtime coordinator keeps that user reload pending until a refresh carrying it succeeds.

The routes are advertised as `user_skill_activation`, with `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation` in the TypeScript SDK and documentation in the serve protocol and capabilities docs.

## Why it's needed

The daemon could only toggle Skills in workspace settings. Hosts that manage Skills across workspaces (for example an embedding product that centrally enables or disables Skills for a user) had no API for the user settings file: the generic `/workspace/settings` route rejects `skills.*`, so they wrote `~/.qwen/settings.json` directly. That bypasses the daemon's settings lock (risking lost updates against other user-scope writers), duplicates the block/spelling rules, and never reaches running sessions, because the Skills refresh only re-read the workspace file. These routes give a supported, locked, consistently validated write path that also applies to live sessions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Start `qwen serve` and check `GET /capabilities` lists `user_skill_activation`.
2. `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` with `{"state":"disabled"}`: `~/.qwen/settings.json` gains `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`; a live session's command list drops the Skill; every workspace stream receives `settings_changed` with `scope: "user"`.
3. Repeat with `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`: the name moves to `skills.defaultDisabled`; a workspace `skills.enabled` entry with the same spelling re-enables it in that workspace only.
4. `{"state":"enabled"}`: the name moves to `skills.enabled`. Add `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` to System settings and repeat: the response is `changed: false` with `block.scope: "System"` and the file is untouched.
5. Unit tests:
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts -t skill`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "serve capability registry"`
   - `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`

Locally all of the above pass, along with `tsc --noEmit` for `packages/cli` and `packages/sdk-typescript`, eslint, and prettier. A full `src/serve/server.test.ts` run shows one or two different unrelated failures per run under load; the same happens on an unmodified `origin/main`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (daemon API; covered by the unit tests above).

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only (vitest) on macOS, Node 26.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a `hard` user disable cannot be lifted by any workspace, which is the existing meaning of a user `skills.disabled` entry; callers that want per-workspace opt-in use `mode: "default"`. Re-reading the user file in live sessions now happens only when a user Skill write requests it, so other user settings edited behind those sessions are picked up at the same time.
- Not validated / out of scope: no read route for user-scope Skill lists (reads stay workspace-scoped); `skills.disabledLevels` and `skills.directories` are not writable through these routes; no Managed Agent equivalent (recorded in the capability parity matrix).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. New routes and an optional refresh parameter; existing routes and refresh behavior are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

None.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增两个 daemon 路由，用于在**用户级** settings（所有工作区都会合并的那一层）中启用或禁用 Skill：`PUT /skills/:name/activation` 和 `PUT /skills/activation`（批量，最多 100 个名字）。与 `PUT /extensions/activation` 一样，它们不带工作区选择器。请求体为 `{ state: "enabled" | "disabled", mode?: "hard" | "default" }`，`mode` 只对禁用生效。每次请求后该名字只会出现在一个用户级名单中：`hard` 禁用（默认）写入 `skills.disabled`，`default` 禁用写入 `skills.defaultDisabled`，启用写入 `skills.enabled`，并从另外两个名单中移除。

当合并后的配置仍会让该 Skill 保持禁用时，启用请求会被拒绝且不写文件，返回 `200`、`changed: false` 以及指明具体条目的 `block`：System/SystemDefaults 中任一拼写的 `skills.disabled` 条目、User 中另一种拼写的条目，或没有同拼写授权可以抵消的 `skills.defaultDisabled` 条目。工作区条目从不拒绝用户级写入，它们只继续约束各自的工作区。批量启用会对被拒绝的名字反复重查直到收敛，因此结果与请求顺序无关。

发生变更后，所有已注册的工作区 runtime 都会 reconcile，每个变更的 key 会在每个工作区的事件流上发出带 `scope: "user"` 和现有 `skill_toggle` mutation 对象的 `settings_changed`。为了让变更作用到运行中的会话，`workspaceSkillsRefresh` 新增可选参数 `settingsScopes`：用户级写入会要求 ACP 子进程及其会话同时重读用户级文件，其他刷新仍然只重读工作区文件。runtime coordinator 会一直保留这次用户级重读请求，直到某次携带它的刷新成功。

这些路由以 `user_skill_activation` 能力标签发布，TypeScript SDK 提供 `DaemonClient.setUserSkillActivation` / `setUserSkillsActivation`，并更新了 serve 协议文档与 capabilities 文档。

## 为什么需要

此前 daemon 只能在工作区 settings 中切换 Skill。需要跨工作区管理 Skill 的宿主（例如为用户统一启停 Skill 的嵌入式产品）没有操作用户级 settings 文件的 API：通用的 `/workspace/settings` 路由会拒绝 `skills.*`，于是它们只能直接写 `~/.qwen/settings.json`。这样绕过了 daemon 的 settings 锁（可能与其他用户级写入互相覆盖），重复实现了锁定与拼写规则，而且永远不会作用到运行中的会话，因为 Skill 刷新只重读工作区文件。这两个路由提供了受支持、加锁、校验一致，并且能作用到运行中会话的写入路径。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 启动 `qwen serve`，确认 `GET /capabilities` 包含 `user_skill_activation`。
2. 对 `PUT /skills/<name>/activation` 发送 `{"state":"disabled"}`：`~/.qwen/settings.json` 中出现 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]`；运行中会话的命令列表不再包含该 Skill；每个工作区的事件流都收到 `scope: "user"` 的 `settings_changed`。
3. 改为发送 `{"state":"disabled","mode":"default"}`：该名字移到 `skills.defaultDisabled`；某个工作区中同拼写的 `skills.enabled` 条目只会在该工作区重新启用它。
4. 发送 `{"state":"enabled"}`：该名字移到 `skills.enabled`。在 System settings 中加入 `skills.disabled: ["<name>"]` 后重复：响应为 `changed: false` 且 `block.scope: "System"`，文件不变。
5. 单元测试：
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/config/skill-settings.test.ts src/serve/routes/workspace-skills.test.ts src/serve/workspace-runtime-coordinator.test.ts src/serve/run-qwen-serve.test.ts src/serve/capability-parity.test.ts`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/acpAgent.test.ts -t skill`
   - `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/serve/server.test.ts -t "serve capability registry"`
   - `cd packages/sdk-typescript && npx vitest run test/unit/DaemonClient.test.ts`

本地以上全部通过，`packages/cli` 与 `packages/sdk-typescript` 的 `tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 也通过。完整运行 `src/serve/server.test.ts` 时，在负载下每次会出现一到两条不同的无关失败；在未修改的 `origin/main` 上同样如此。

### 证据（前后对比）

N/A（daemon API，由上述单元测试覆盖）。

### 测试平台

|     系统     | 状态 |
| :----------: | :--: |
|   🍏 macOS   |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows  |  ⚠️  |
|   🐧 Linux   |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

仅在 macOS、Node 26 上运行单元测试（vitest）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：`hard` 用户级禁用无法被任何工作区解除，这本就是用户级 `skills.disabled` 条目的既有含义；需要按工作区单独开启的调用方应使用 `mode: "default"`。运行中会话重读用户级文件只在用户级 Skill 写入请求时发生，因此在这些会话背后编辑的其他用户级设置也会同时生效。
- 未验证或范围外：没有读取用户级 Skill 名单的路由（读取仍按工作区）；`skills.disabledLevels` 与 `skills.directories` 不能通过这些路由写入；没有 Managed Agent 对应能力（已记录在 capability parity 矩阵中）。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。仅新增路由和一个可选的刷新参数，现有路由与刷新行为不变。

prs.title: fix(cli): report pre-send refusals instead of replaying answers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

When the client refuses a turn before sending it — the session token limit or a UserPromptSubmit hook block — the stream carries no content, and the shared result builder fell back to the previous turn's assistant message. A persistent stream-json session therefore reported the refused message as a success carrying the earlier answer. This records the refusal on the adapter that stream-json, json, and text output share, and turns that would-be success into an error result with the refusal text and no `result` field. An error the caller already classified keeps its own subtype and message, and starting a new turn clears the latch. The error reuses the existing `error_during_execution` subtype, so all three SDK protocol definitions stay unchanged and this does not depend on #15358.

## Why it's needed

Consumers branch on the result envelope (`is_error` / `subtype`), so a refused message currently looks answered and silently repeats stale content — a shell wrapper that only checks the status proceeds with the previous answer. The issue reproduces it with a two-message stream-json session, where the refused turn returned `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the adapter suite from `packages/cli`: `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`. The two added cases feed each refusal event after a previous assistant message exists, then assert `is_error: true`, `subtype: "error_during_execution"`, the refusal text in `error.message`, and the absence of a `result` field. Both cases fail before the change and pass after it.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the refused turn emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<previous answer>"}`. After: it emits `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}` with no `result`. This is a non-user-visible protocol change in headless output, so there is no TUI before/after.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified inside a `node:22-bookworm` container; Windows was not exercised, and the change has no platform-specific code.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the latch is cleared when a turn starts and consumed when a result is built, so it cannot relabel a later turn's result. Refusals still end the turn; in a single-shot `-p` run both refusals now exit with code 1 so the process status agrees with the error envelope, while a persistent `--input-format stream-json` session ignores the per-turn status and keeps its existing behavior.
- Not validated / out of scope: the max-turns sibling refusal stays with #15358.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none — no new subtype, no configuration, no SDK type change. Single-shot `-p` exit status for these two refusals changes from 0 to 1 for scripts that relied on the old value.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15704

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

当客户端在发送前拒绝一轮请求（会话 token 上限，或 UserPromptSubmit hook 拦截）时，流里没有任何内容，而共用的 result 构建逻辑会回退到上一轮的助手消息。持久化的 stream-json 会话因此把被拒绝的消息报告成一次成功，并带上之前的答案。本改动在 stream-json、json、text 三种输出共用的适配器上记录拒绝原因，把原本会生成的成功结果转换成错误结果：带拒绝原因、不带 `result` 字段。调用方已经判定为错误的结果保持原有 subtype 和文案，新回合开始时会清空记录。错误复用现有的 `error_during_execution` subtype，因此三套 SDK 的协议定义都不需要改，也不依赖 #15358。

## 为什么需要

调用方根据 result 信封（`is_error` / `subtype`）分支处理，现在被拒绝的消息看起来像已回答，并且静默重复旧内容——只判断退出码的 shell 包装脚本会拿着上一轮答案继续执行。issue 里用两条消息的 stream-json 会话复现：被拒绝的一轮返回 `{"subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"answer 1"}`。

## 评审验证方式

在 `packages/cli` 下运行 `npx vitest run src/nonInteractive/io/StreamJsonOutputAdapter.test.ts`。新增的两个用例在已有上一轮助手消息的前提下依次注入两种拒绝事件，断言 `is_error: true`、`subtype: "error_during_execution"`、`error.message` 为拒绝原因，且没有 `result` 字段；改动前为红，改动后为绿。

## 改动前后

改动前被拒绝的一轮输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"success","is_error":false,"result":"<上一轮答案>"}`；改动后输出 `{"type":"result","subtype":"error_during_execution","is_error":true,"error":{"message":"Session token limit exceeded: ..."}}`，且不含 `result`。这是无头输出的协议行为变化，不涉及 TUI，因此没有界面前后对比。

## 测试环境

macOS 通过；Linux 在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器内通过；Windows 未验证，改动不含平台相关代码。

## 风险与范围

记录在回合开始时清空、在构建 result 时消费，不会污染后续回合；拒绝仍然结束回合，单次 `-p` 运行下这两种拒绝现在以退出码 1 结束、与错误信封一致，而持久 `--input-format stream-json` 会话丢弃每轮状态、行为不变。max-session-turns 的同类处理仍归 #15358。没有新增 subtype、配置或 SDK 类型变更。单次 `-p` 下这两种拒绝的退出码由 0 变为 1，依赖旧值的脚本需要留意。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15704

</details>

prs.title: feat(managed-agent): add an E2B Cloud runtime provider
prs.body:
## What this PR does Adds opt-in external Workspace profiles for Hosted file tools and foreground Shell execution in E2B Cloud, while keeping the Harness, model access, approvals and journals in the central deployment. An operator publishes a registered Workspace with its OWNER grant; clients then select that Workspace through the existing Session API. A standalone provider owns Cloud credentials, a private durable placement journal and protected worker ingress. Closing a Session requires committed results and an identity-checked durable drain proof before stopping the original sandbox, retaining the Volume and replaying the physical-stop receipt after a lost response. The new external worker profiles accept up to 64 request headers on both listeners to accommodate Cloud proxy forwarding headers while retaining the byte limit and application authentication. The previous external profiles keep their existing behavior and 32-header limit. Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2382bcce7d6bb40316b69251ccbc4470fa357359/docs/design/2026-10-28-e2b-managed-runtime.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2382bcce7d6bb40316b69251ccbc4470fa357359/docs/design/2026-10-28-e2b-managed-runtime.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same boundaries and acceptance requirements. ## Why it's needed Registered external storage currently has provisioning prerequisites but cannot provide the Hosted Workspace tools or qualify Session close. This connects remote execution to the existing Workspace authorization, tool, publication and retirement contracts so that a central Agent can use persistent remote files without treating an expired sandbox as a clean close. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify 1. With matching central/worker builds, a protected ingress and a real existing E2B Volume, register the external storage and publish its Workspace/OWNER grant through the operator listener. A Session selecting that Workspace should support Read/Write/Edit; tools mode should also support foreground Shell with output in the central publication store. 2. Confirm that unbound/local-storage Sessions, foreign owners, paths outside the Workspace, background Shell, PTY, Monitor, MCP, Hooks, child Workspaces and file rewind are refused. Rewind must fail before a pending undo is journaled. 3. Close after committed ACKs and released tool Sessions. The exact original sandbox must disappear, the Volume must remain, and published Shell artifacts must remain readable. Repeat a lost retire response and confirm that the saved proof and original physical-stop receipt replay without launching a replacement worker. 4. Replay provisioning with the same request and reject conflicting input. A lost create response without saved traffic credentials must remain UNKNOWN, with no second create or resume operation. Require the affected Java/SDK, MySQL, Hosted/fault and Cloud acceptance gates before marking this draft ready. The current increment passed the root build, typecheck and bundle, 72 focused worker tests, and 15 independent compiled-worker header-count, byte-limit and authentication boundary checks. The final 19-test publication subset was rerun after assertion cleanup, and the commit hook passed formatting and ESLint. A real macOS protocol client completed 80 protected HTTPS worker requests against Linux x64 in an existing AgentSandbox template, covering files, foreground Shell, replay, ACK and retirement proofs; the original sandbox was killed and confirmed absent. The Shell publication producer remained inside the sandbox. These scoped results do not qualify the complete Hosted deployment; see the separate E2E report for boundaries and retained failed attempts. ### Evidence (Before & After) N/A — no UI/TUI change. Backend protocol evidence is in the separate E2E report comment. ### Tested on | OS | Status | | :--------: | :----: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ tested: focused TypeScript and real worker HTTP checks | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ not tested | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested: temporary Linux worker over protected HTTPS; provider/Hosted deployment pending | ### Environment (optional) macOS arm64, Node.js v26.12.1, repository-pinned pnpm 11.24.0, E2B SDK 2.61.0. Provider fixtures use private SQLite and injected Cloud calls. Remote worker checks use an existing AgentSandbox template, temporary checksum-verified Linux x64 Node.js v22.23.4 and matching JavaScript output, with the protocol client on macOS and publication producer inside the sandbox. No Linux-built worker image or real E2B Volume has been qualified. ## Risk & Scope - Main risk or tradeoff: the change spans Node/Java storage admission, lease/generation fencing and retirement. Ambiguous creates preserve identity and require operator investigation; automatic API-key rotation is outside scope. - Not validated / out of scope: this remains a draft. Earlier local Java attempts were not green; a registration/claim fixture correction was not rerun, and later Java/SDK changes remain uncompiled and untested locally after the module's shared ten-minute budget was exhausted. Checkstyle, real MySQL, public Hosted/fault integration, Linux image, real E2B Volume/Cloud loss cases and required CI remain pending. Formal review is also pending because its required foreground workflow tool is unavailable. Alibaba Cloud AgentSandbox native persistent-storage adaptation is outside this E2B Cloud implementation. - Breaking changes / migration notes: existing profiles keep their contracts; the new profiles require explicit operator registration/publication, matching central/worker artifacts, a durable private provider journal and protected ingress. The external Hosted surface is foreground-only and does not support rewind, extensions or Workspace browsing/query/read. ## Linked Issues None.
中文说明 ## 本 PR 做了什么 新增显式启用的外部 Workspace profile，在 E2B Cloud 执行 Hosted 文件工具和前台 Shell，同时将 Harness、模型访问、审批和日志保留在中央部署。操作员发布已登记的 Workspace 及其 OWNER 授权，客户端随后通过现有 Session API 选择该 Workspace。 独立 provider 管理 Cloud 凭据、私有持久放置日志和受保护的 worker 入口。Session 关闭必须先满足结果提交和身份校验后的持久排空证明，再停止原 sandbox、保留 Volume，并在响应丢失后重放物理停止回执。新 external worker profile 的两个监听端口最多接收 64 个请求头字段，以容纳 Cloud 代理转发头，同时保留字节上限和应用鉴权。原有 external profile 保持既有行为和 32 个头字段上限。 设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2382bcce7d6bb40316b69251ccbc4470fa357359/docs/design/2026-10-28-e2b-managed-runtime.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/2382bcce7d6bb40316b69251ccbc4470fa357359/docs/design/2026-10-28-e2b-managed-runtime.zh-CN.md)。两个版本包含一致的边界和验收要求。 ## 为什么需要 已登记的外部存储目前只有创建前置能力，无法提供 Hosted Workspace 工具或完成合格的 Session 关闭。本改动将远程执行接入现有 Workspace 授权、工具、输出发布和退休契约，使中央 Agent 能使用持久远程文件，并避免将 sandbox 到期视为正常关闭。 ## 审阅者测试计划 ### 如何验证 1. 准备匹配的中央/worker 构建、受保护入口和真实已有 E2B Volume，通过操作员监听器登记外部存储并发布 Workspace/OWNER 授权。选择该 Workspace 的 Session 应支持 Read/Write/Edit；tools 模式还应支持前台 Shell，并将输出保存在中央 publication 存储中。 2. 确认拒绝未绑定/本地存储 Session、其他 owner、Workspace 外路径、后台 Shell、PTY、Monitor、MCP、Hooks、子 Workspace 和文件 rewind。Rewind 必须在记录 pending undo 之前失败。 3. 在 committed ACK 和工具 Session 释放后关闭。必须确认原始 sandbox 消失、Volume 保留，且已发布的 Shell 产物仍可读取。重放丢失的 retire 响应，确认返回原证明和物理停止回执，不启动替代 worker。 4. 使用相同请求重放创建，并拒绝冲突输入。创建响应丢失且未保存流量凭据时必须保持 UNKNOWN，不得再次创建或恢复实例。将 Draft 标记为 ready 前，完成受影响的 Java/SDK、MySQL、Hosted/fault 和 Cloud 验收。 本次增量通过根目录 build、typecheck 和 bundle、72 项定向 worker 测试，以及 15 项独立的编译后 worker 头字段数量、字节上限和鉴权边界检查。断言正文简化后重新执行了最终 19 项 publication 子集，commit hook 的格式与 ESLint 检查通过。真实 macOS 协议客户端向现有 AgentSandbox 模板中的 Linux x64 worker 完成 80 次受保护 HTTPS 请求，覆盖文件、前台 Shell、重放、ACK 和退休证明；原始 sandbox 已销毁并确认不存在。Shell publication 接收端仍位于沙箱内。这些有范围限制的结果不能代表完整 Hosted 部署验收，边界和保留的失败尝试见独立 E2E 报告。 ### 证据（修改前后） N/A — 无 UI/TUI 改动。后端协议证据见独立 E2E 报告评论。 ### 测试平台 | 操作系统 | 状态 | | :------: | :--: | | 🍏 macOS | ✅ 已测试：定向 TypeScript 和真实 worker HTTP 检查 | | 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试 | | 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试：经受保护 HTTPS 访问临时 Linux worker；provider/Hosted 部署待验证 | ### 环境（可选） macOS arm64、Node.js v26.12.1、仓库固定的 pnpm 11.24.0、E2B SDK 2.61.0。Provider 夹具使用私有 SQLite 和注入的 Cloud 调用。远程 worker 检查使用现成 AgentSandbox 模板、临时上传且校验过哈希的 Linux x64 Node.js v22.23.4 和匹配的 JavaScript 产物，协议客户端位于 macOS，publication 接收端位于沙箱内。从 Linux 源码构建的 worker 镜像和真实 E2B Volume 尚未通过验收。 ##
