prs.title: feat: add hybrid code mode
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a Codex-aligned `tools.mode` enum with `direct`, `code_mode`, and `code_mode_only`. `code_mode` keeps ordinary tools directly callable while also exposing the isolated `exec` JavaScript tool; each visible ordinary tool carries its nested JavaScript declaration, while `exec` retains compact `ALL_TOOLS` metadata. `code_mode_only` preserves the strict exec-only ordinary-tool surface, and `direct` remains the default.

Updates filtered subagent tool surfaces so direct declarations and nested exec bindings honor the same allowlists, exposes the enum in Settings as Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only, regenerates the settings JSON schema, and removes the former `tools.codeModeOnly` boolean setting entirely.

Adds synchronized [English](docs/design/code-mode.md) and [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md) design documents, and brings the existing CodeModeOnly design up to the repository's bilingual documentation standard ([English](docs/design/code-mode-only.md), [Chinese](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)).

## Why it's needed

Qwen Code previously offered only the default direct tool surface or the strict CodeModeOnly surface. Models could not combine direct calls for simple operations with `exec` orchestration for multi-tool workflows. A three-value enum matches Codex's `ToolMode` naming and gives users one explicit setting for all supported exposure modes.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Leave `tools.mode` unset or set it to `direct`, restart Qwen Code, and confirm ordinary tools remain available while `exec` is absent.
2. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode`, restart, and confirm both ordinary tools and `exec` are available. Confirm ordinary tool descriptions include their `tools.<name>(args)` declaration and deferred tools remain discoverable through `tool_search`.
3. Set `tools.mode` to `code_mode_only`, restart, and confirm ordinary tools are available through `exec` rather than as top-level calls, while direct control tools remain available.
4. Open Settings and confirm Tool Mode cycles among Default, Code Mode, and Code Mode Only. Confirm `tools.codeModeOnly` is no longer present in the settings schema.
5. Start with `--safe-mode` or `--bare` while either code mode is configured and confirm the effective mode is `direct`.

Automated verification completed: focused Core tests (121 tests), focused CLI tests (585 tests), a repeated settings-schema regression run (60 tests), full build, full typecheck, full lint, and both installed and branch-built CLI version smoke checks.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Settings exposed `Code Mode Only (Experimental)` as a boolean with `false` / `true`.

After: Settings exposes `Tool Mode (Experimental)` as an enum displaying Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only. Updated TUI snapshots cover the default display.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js v24.18.0; local source build and package-level Vitest suites.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Hybrid mode adds a short nested-call declaration to each ordinary tool description, increasing prompt size slightly; complete schemas are not duplicated in the `exec` description.
- Not validated / out of scope: Live-provider interactive runs and Windows/Linux local execution were not tested; CI covers supported platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: `tools.codeModeOnly` is removed. Replace `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` with `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`.

## Linked Issues

Related to #10377.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

新增与 Codex 对齐的 `tools.mode` 枚举，支持 `direct`、`code_mode` 和 `code_mode_only`。`code_mode` 在保留普通工具直接调用能力的同时提供隔离的 `exec` JavaScript 工具；每个可见普通工具会携带自己的嵌套 JavaScript 声明，而 `exec` 保留精简的 `ALL_TOOLS` 元数据。`code_mode_only` 保持严格的普通工具仅经 `exec` 调用模式，`direct` 仍为默认值。

更新经过过滤的子智能体工具面，使直接声明和 `exec` 嵌套 binding 遵守同一组 allowlist；在设置界面中将该枚举显示为 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only；重新生成 settings JSON schema；并彻底移除原来的 `tools.codeModeOnly` 布尔设置。

新增同步的[英文](docs/design/code-mode.md)和[中文](docs/design/code-mode.zh-CN.md)设计文档，并将现有 CodeModeOnly 设计补齐为仓库要求的双语文档（[英文](docs/design/code-mode-only.md)、[中文](docs/design/code-mode-only.zh-CN.md)）。

## 为什么需要

Qwen Code 此前只提供默认的直接工具面或严格的 CodeModeOnly 工具面。模型无法在简单操作中使用直接调用，同时在多工具工作流中使用 `exec` 编排。三值枚举与 Codex 的 `ToolMode` 命名一致，并为所有支持的暴露模式提供一个明确的统一设置项。

## Reviewer 测试计划

### 如何验证

1. 不设置 `tools.mode` 或将其设为 `direct`，重启 Qwen Code，确认普通工具仍可用且不存在 `exec`。
2. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode` 并重启，确认普通工具和 `exec` 同时可用；确认普通工具描述包含各自的 `tools.<name>(args)` 声明，延迟工具仍可通过 `tool_search` 发现。
3. 将 `tools.mode` 设为 `code_mode_only` 并重启，确认普通工具通过 `exec` 而不是顶层调用使用，同时直接控制工具仍然可用。
4. 打开设置界面，确认 Tool Mode 可在 Default、Code Mode 和 Code Mode Only 之间切换，并确认 settings schema 中不再存在 `tools.codeModeOnly`。
5. 配置任一 code mode 后用 `--safe-mode` 或 `--bare` 启动，确认有效模式为 `direct`。

已完成自动化验证：Core 相关测试（121 个）、CLI 相关测试（585 个）、再次运行的 settings schema 回归测试（60 个）、完整 build、完整 typecheck、完整 lint，以及已安装版本和分支构建版本的 CLI 版本 smoke 检查。

### 前后对比证据

之前：设置界面以 `false` / `true` 布尔值展示 `Code Mode Only (Experimental)`。

之后：设置界面以枚举展示 `Tool Mode (Experimental)`，可选 Default / Code Mode / Code Mode Only。更新后的 TUI snapshot 覆盖默认显示。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ⚠️  |

### 环境（可选）

macOS、Node.js v24.18.0；本地源码构建和 package 级 Vitest 测试套件。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：混合模式会在每个普通工具描述中增加一段简短的嵌套调用声明，使 prompt 略微增大；完整 schema 不会在 `exec` 描述中重复。
- 未验证 / 范围外：未进行真实 provider 的交互式运行，也未在 Windows/Linux 本地执行；支持平台由 CI 覆盖。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：`tools.codeModeOnly` 已移除。请将 `{ "tools": { "codeModeOnly": true } }` 替换为 `{ "tools": { "mode": "code_mode_only" } }`。

## 关联 Issue

关联 #10377。

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): do not read a Ctrl modifier on a named key as Ctrl + a letter
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Require a single-letter name before converting Ctrl keys into C0 bytes. Mapped named keys keep their existing escape-sequence mapping; Ctrl+A/C/Z are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

Multi-character key names such as `down` satisfy the old string range check. Ctrl+Down/Delete then send `0x04` (EOF), and Ctrl+Up sends `0x15`, instead of their cursor/key sequences. The terminal parser produces these named-key shapes from real input.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/cli`: `pnpm exec vitest run src/ui/hooks/keyToAnsi.test.ts`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

At `d6957df56a` (main `415925cbdab` merged): 21 key-conversion tests and 133 related keypress/context tests passed (154 total). The CLI/dependency-workspace build, core/CLI typechecks, and two-file ESLint/Prettier passed with Node 22.23.3 and frozen pnpm 11.24.0 dependencies.

The three added printable/Alt/Kitty cases each fail under their corresponding faulty implementation and pass after restoration. Earlier maintainer A/B evidence at `f53553cb` found 15 named-key failures on its base and 18 passing on that head; it is separate from the validation above. These earlier mutation and A/B runs were not repeated for this merge.

### Tested on

macOS unit tests. Windows and Linux were not tested locally.

### Environment (optional)

Frozen pnpm lockfile and the repository's Ink patch. No live terminal or full-app E2E run in this validation.

Review follow-up `160128873c`: the two F1/Insert regressions fail on the previous head (2 failed, 21 passed) and all 23 conversion tests pass after the one-line fallback change. The existing named-key table now carries real CSI modifier sequences, and Ctrl+letter asserts both Shift and Meta behavior. Scoped ESLint/Prettier pass.

## Risk & Scope

The Ctrl+Return follow-up in `e0b3560e57` suppresses that chord in embedded shell focus instead of sending CR and submitting the current command. Ordinary Return still sends CR. The revised existing test fails on the previous head (1 failed, 22 passed); the fix passes all 189 conversion/parser/matcher tests, scoped ESLint/Prettier, the CLI build, and CLI type-check. Interactive shell E2E and full preflight were not run.

Except for suppressed Ctrl+Return, mapped Ctrl-modified named keys use their plain escape sequences. Unmapped named keys such as Ctrl+F1–F12 and Ctrl+Insert now forward their decoded sequence instead of being dropped. Mapped keys keep switch-table priority, so general modifier forwarding remains outside this change. Ctrl+Backspace now reaches the existing DEL mapping. Ctrl+Tab and Ctrl+Shift+Tab reach the existing bare TAB mapping, which can trigger shell completion; preserving those modifiers is also outside this change. The update adds tests for printable passthrough, meta-only suppression, and Kitty Ctrl-letter priority while retaining the existing mappings. No API migration. Full preflight was not run.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13068.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

只有单字母名称才按 Ctrl 算术转换成 C0 字节。已有映射的命名键继续使用原有转义序列映射；Ctrl+A/C/Z 不变。

## 为什么需要

`down` 等多字符键名也满足旧的字符串范围比较。Ctrl+Down/Delete 因而发出 `0x04`（EOF），Ctrl+Up 发出 `0x15`，而不是光标或按键序列。真实终端输入解析会产生这些命名键形状。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

从 `packages/cli` 运行 `pnpm exec vitest run src/ui/hooks/keyToAnsi.test.ts`。

### 前后证据

在 `d6957df56a`（已合入 main `415925cbdab`）上，21 项按键转换测试和133项相关 keypress/context 测试通过，共154项。使用 Node 22.23.3 和冻结的 pnpm 11.24.0 依赖，CLI及依赖工作包构建、core/CLI 类型检查及两文件 ESLint/Prettier 检查通过。

此前新增的 printable/Alt/Kitty 三例各自在相应错误实现下失败、恢复后通过。维护者在 `f53553cb` 的早期 A/B 验证发现 base 有15项命名键失败、该 head 有18项通过；这是独立于上述验证的历史证据，本次合 main 未重跑这些变异和 A/B 对照。

### 已测试平台

macOS 单元测试；未在本地测试 Windows 或 Linux。

### 环境

冻结的 pnpm 锁文件以及仓库的 Ink 补丁。本次未运行真实终端或完整应用 E2E。

## 风险与范围

`e0b3560e57` 补充修复 Ctrl+Return：在内嵌 shell 中抑制该组合键，避免发送 CR 后提交当前命令；普通 Return 仍发送 CR。改过的既有测试在上一 head 为 1 failed、22 passed；修复后 189 项转换、解析和匹配测试及定向 ESLint/Prettier、CLI 构建和类型检查通过。未运行真实 shell E2E 和完整 preflight。

除被抑制的 Ctrl+Return 外，已有映射的 Ctrl 命名键使用不带修饰键的转义序列。没有现有映射的 Ctrl+F1–F12、Ctrl+Insert 现在透传解码后的序列；已有映射的命名键仍优先使用 switch，不扩大为通用修饰键转发。Ctrl+Backspace 使用现有 DEL 映射。Ctrl+Tab 和 Ctrl+Shift+Tab 使用现有的裸 TAB 映射，可能触发 shell 补全；保留修饰键也不在此次改动内。此前更新补充了 printable 透传、meta-only 抑制和 Kitty Ctrl 字母优先级测试，保留原有映射。没有 API 迁移；未运行完整 preflight。

Fixes #13068。

prs.title: feat(channels): deliver injected messages into the running turn
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds a fourth channel `dispatchMode`, `inject`: a message that arrives while the agent is already working in a channel session is handed to the running turn's mid-turn queue and read by the agent at its next tool-batch boundary, instead of being buffered until the turn ends (`collect`) or queued as a new turn (`followup`).

The queue lives in the bridge (`AcpBridge`), is bounded at 20 messages / 20,000 characters, and is drained in batches the ACP child can actually consume (10 per response; the remainder stays queued for the next drain). A message is reported as injected only when the bridge accepted it. Everything the running turn cannot represent falls back to the existing collect buffer and is replayed as its own turn, in arrival order: a rejected or over-bound message, another chat's/thread's message under a collapsed session scope, an unauthorized member in a shared session, a recognized slash command, an image message (refused visibly — mid-turn injection is text-only), and any message on a bridge without the capability. When a turn ends before the agent drained, its unread messages are taken back at the turn boundary and replayed as a new turn instead of leaking into the next one; `/cancel`, `/clear` and session teardown drop them with the same buffer-drop notification the collect path uses.

The round-1 review's 10 Critical and 9 Suggestion findings are addressed in the same commits: drain batching against the consumer cap, turn-scoped settlement, a collect-replay marker (not `alreadyPrefixed`), the shared-session authorization gate, the per-message `onPromptInjected` hook, arrival-order sequencing once the fallback is open, the aggregate/depth char bound, text-only media handling, the email dispatch-mode guard, and the daemon-bridge fallback diagnostic.

## Why it's needed

Closes #15630. Today a user who sees the bot going the wrong way mid-task has only bad options: `steer` cancels the turn, `collect` makes them wait for it to finish, `followup` queues a new turn that may answer a stale question. `inject` lets the correction reach the work in progress, which is what a mid-task correction is for.

The guarantees above are part of the feature, not polish: the failure mode of a wrong delivery receipt is silently lost user input, and a message accepted for someone else's turn executes work under permissions approved for that turn's owner.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Unit/integration level with mocked bridge and child; no live channel platform is needed. From the repo root:

```bash
cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/wecom && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/email && npx vitest run
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/serve/channel-settings-store.test.ts
npx tsc --build packages/channels/base packages/cli
```

Behaviour to confirm, all named cases in `ChannelBase.test.ts`'s "mid-turn message injection (inject dispatch mode)" block unless noted:

- accepted injection calls `queueMidTurnMessage` only, logs delivered, fires `onPromptInjected` and does not buffer;
- a bridge rejection parks the message in the bounded fallback and every later message of that turn follows it in arrival order;
- both fallback bounds (20 messages / 20,000 chars) refuse visibly and tell the sender rather than dropping;
- a collect-buffer replay is never re-injected (`collectReplay`), so a parked message always becomes its own turn;
- undrained injections are replayed at the turn boundary (`ChannelBase.test.ts` "replays injections the running turn never drained as a new turn"; `AcpBridge.test.ts` "settles undrained mid-turn messages at the turn boundary instead of leaking them");
- a shared-session member who is not an operator is denied and buffered; another chat's message under `sessionScope: 'single'` is not injected;
- an image message is refused in-thread (text-only), a file attachment is buffered so its `saved to:` path reaches a turn (`WeComAdapter.test.ts` too);
- a recognized slash command is buffered, and the group-history backfill is composed into the injected text;
- `AcpBridge.test.ts` "caps one drain response at the ACP consumer batch and keeps the remainder queued" (queue 11 → drain 10 → drain the 11th);
- `/cancel` and `/clear` drop queued injections with a drop notification (`AcpBridge.test.ts` and `ChannelBase.test.ts`);
- the email adapter rejects `inject` (`packages/channels/email/src/config.test.ts`), and a bridge without the capability logs one diagnostic and buffers.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Unauthorized member injects into an operator's shared session | text reaches the running turn and executes under the turn owner's permissions | denied, falls through to collect buffering as its own turn |
| Turn ends with 15 queued messages the agent never drained | text stays queued and is injected into whatever turn runs next | taken back at the turn boundary and replayed as a new turn |
| 11 messages queued, one drain | one response carries 11, child keeps 10, the 11th is lost while the channel logged it delivered | first 10 delivered, the 11th delivered by the next drain |
| Collect-buffer replay while another turn registers | replay re-enters the inject arm and folds into someone else's turn | marked `collectReplay`, becomes its own turn |
| Image sent under `inject` | `[Alice] (image)` injected; the picture is invisible to the model | visible in-thread refusal (text-only path) |
| Chat-B message under `sessionScope: 'single'` | injected into chat A's running turn; the answer goes to A | buffered and replayed as its own turn in B |
| Email channel with `dispatchMode: 'inject'` | accepted by config, silently behaved as collect | rejected at config with the durable-claim reason |
| Bounded fallback full | message discarded with one stderr line | sender is told, stderr records the refusal |

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit and integration tests with a mocked bridge/child (Node 22).

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `inject` widens what a mid-turn message can do. The injected text enters a turn whose tool approvals belong to that turn's owner, so the arm now requires `isAuthorizedForSharedSession` (non-operators buffer instead) and never crosses a chat/thread boundary the running turn does not own. The degradation contract is deliberate: anything the turn cannot represent becomes a normal buffered turn rather than lost input.
- Semantics: nothing is reported delivered unless the bridge accepted it; the queue is settled at the turn boundary; ordering between injected and parked messages follows arrival order; the fallback is bounded (20 messages / 20,000 chars) and refuses visibly.
- Behaviour changes: the adapter-facing `dispatchMode` contract gains `inject` (email now whitelists `followup`/`steer` and rejects the rest), and `inject` on a daemon-managed (`qwen serve`) channel falls back to collect with a one-time operator diagnostic because `DaemonChannelBridge` cannot hand messages to a running turn — promoting them needs a channel-visible promotion contract and is out of scope here.
- Not validated / out of scope: no end-to-end run against a live agent child for drain timing (the tests drive a mocked child and bridge); the daemon promotion path is deliberately not implemented; queue capacity is the operator-facing global 20/20,000 bound, not a per-sender quota; images are refused rather than described to the model.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none for existing modes — `collect` stays the default and the new mode is opt-in per channel; no config format change.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15630.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

新增第四个 channel `dispatchMode`：`inject`。当 agent 已在某个 channel 会话中工作时到达的消息，不再等回合结束（`collect`）或排成新回合（`followup`），而是交给正在运行回合的 mid-turn 队列，由 agent 在下一个工具批次边界读到。

队列位于桥接层（`AcpBridge`），上限 20 条 / 20,000 字符，并按 ACP 子进程真正能消费的批量出队（每次响应 10 条，剩余留在队列中等待下一次 drain）。只有桥接层真正接受的消息才记为已注入；运行中回合无法表示的消息一律回退到既有 collect 缓冲，并按到达顺序作为自己的新回合重放：被拒绝或超出上限的消息、session scope 折叠后来自其它 chat/thread 的消息、共享会话中无权限的成员消息、可识别的 slash 命令、图片消息（明确拒绝——mid-turn 注入只支持文本），以及桥接层没有该能力的消息。回合结束时 agent 尚未读取的消息会在回合边界收回并作为新回合重放，不会泄漏到下一个回合；`/cancel`、`/clear` 和会话销毁会丢弃它们，并走与 collect 相同的 buffer-drop 通知。

第一轮 review 的 10 个 Critical + 9 个 Suggestion 在同一批提交中修复：按消费端上限分批 drain、队列与回合绑定并在回合边界结算、collect 重放标记（不用 `alreadyPrefixed`）、共享会话权限门禁、逐条 `onPromptInjected` 生命周期 hook、fallback 打开后的到达顺序、聚合/深度字符上限、纯文本媒体处理、email 的 dispatchMode 守卫、daemon bridge 的一次性诊断。

## 为什么需要

关闭 #15630。现在用户看到 bot 中途走偏时只有坏选择：`steer` 取消整个回合，`collect` 让他们等回合结束，`followup` 排一个新回合、可能回答的是过期问题。`inject` 让纠正能进入正在进行的工作——这正是「中途纠正」的用途。

上面那些保证属于功能本身而非润色：回执不实的失败模式是用户输入被静默丢失；而替别人回合接受消息，会让工作在「该回合所有者」的权限下执行。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

单元/集成层面，桥与子进程都是 mock，不需要真实 channel 平台。在仓库根目录执行：

```bash
cd packages/channels/base && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/wecom && npx vitest run
cd packages/channels/email && npx vitest run
cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/acp-integration/session/Session.test.ts src/serve/channel-settings-store.test.ts
npx tsc --build packages/channels/base packages/cli
```

需要确认的行为（除注明外均为 `ChannelBase.test.ts` 的 "mid-turn message injection (inject dispatch mode)" 块中的具名用例）：

- 注入被接受时只调用 `queueMidTurnMessage`、记录 delivered、触发 `onPromptInjected`，不进入缓冲；
- 桥接层拒绝后，本条消息停入有界 fallback，本回合后续消息按到达顺序跟随其后；
- fallback 的两个上限（20 条 / 20,000 字符）都会明确拒绝并告知发送者，而不是丢弃；
- collect 缓冲重放不会被再次注入（`collectReplay`），被 park 的消息一定成为自己的回合；
- 回合结束时未被 drain 的注入会在回合边界被重放（`ChannelBase.test.ts` "replays injections the running turn never drained as a new turn"；`AcpBridge.test.ts` "settles undrained mid-turn messages at the turn boundary instead of leaking them"）；
- 共享会话中非 operator 成员被拒绝并进入缓冲；`sessionScope: 'single'` 下来自另一个 chat 的消息不会被注入；
- 图片消息在会话中明确拒绝（仅文本），文件附件则被缓冲，使其 `saved to:` 路径能在自己的回合被读到（`WeComAdapter.test.ts` 同上）；
- 可识别的 slash 命令进入缓冲；group-history 补全会拼入注入文本；
- `AcpBridge.test.ts` "caps one drain response at the ACP consumer batch and keeps the remainder queued"（队列 11 条 → 第一次 drain 10 条 → 第二次 drain 第 11 条）；
- `/cancel` 与 `/clear` 会丢弃排队中的注入并发出 drop 通知（`AcpBridge.test.ts` 与 `ChannelBase.test.ts`）；
- email 适配器拒绝 `inject`（`packages/channels/email/src/config.test.ts`），没有该能力的桥只记录一次诊断并进入缓冲。

### 证据（修改前 / 修改后）

| 场景 | 修改前 | 修改后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 无权限成员向 operator 的共享会话注入 | 文本进入运行中回合，按回合所有者权限执行 | 被拒绝，回退为 collect 缓冲并成为自己的回合 |
| 回合结束时队列里还有 15 条未被读取 | 文本留在队列，被注入到之后任意回合 | 回合边界收回，作为新回合重放 |
| 队列 11 条、执行一次 drain | 一次响应带出 11 条，子进程只保留 10 条，第 11 条丢失且日志记为已投递 | 前 10 条投递，第 11 条由下一次 drain 投递 |
| collect 缓冲重放期间又有回合注册 | 重放重新进入 inject 分支，被折进别人的回合 | 标记 `collectReplay`，成为自己的回合 |
| 在 `inject` 模式下发图片 | 注入 `[Alice] (image)`，模型看不到图 | 会话内明确拒绝（仅文本） |
| `sessionScope: 'single'` 下 chat-B 的消息 | 被注入 chat A 的运行中回合，回答也发到 A | 进入缓冲，作为 B 的新回合重放 |
| email 频道配置 `dispatchMode: 'inject'` | 配置接受，实际静默按 collect 处理 | 配置阶段拒绝，并给出 durable-claim 原因 |
| 有界 fallback 已满 | 消息被丢弃，只写一行 stderr | 告知发送者，stderr 记录拒绝 |

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

N/A —— 使用 mock 的桥/子进程的单元与集成测试（Node 22）。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/权衡：`inject` 扩大了中途消息能做的事。注入的文本会进入「工具审批属于该回合所有者」的回合，因此该分支现在要求 `isAuthorizedForSharedSession`（非 operator 一律进入缓冲），且绝不跨越运行中回合不拥有的 chat/thread 边界。降级契约是有意为之：回合无法表示的消息变成普通缓冲回合，而不是丢失。
- 语义：只有桥接层接受才记为 delivered；队列在回合边界结算；注入与 park 消息之间保持到达顺序；fallback 有界（20 条 / 20,000 字符）并明确拒绝。
- 行为变更：适配器侧的 `dispatchMode` 契约新增 `inject`（email 现在白名单 `followup`/`steer`，其余拒绝）；daemon 管理的（`qwen serve`）频道下 `inject` 会回退到 collect 并记录一次性诊断，因为 `DaemonChannelBridge` 无法把消息交给运行中回合——要做 promotion 需要 channel 可见的契约，不在本 PR 范围。
- 未验证/超出范围：没有对真实 agent 子进程做端到端 drain 时序验证（测试用 mock 子进程与桥）；daemon promotion 路径本 PR 未实现；队列容量是操作者可见的全局 20/20,000 上限，不是按发送者的配额；图片是明确拒绝而不是转述给模型。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：对既有模式无破坏——`collect` 仍是默认，新模式按频道显式开启；配置格式无变化。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #15630。

</details>

prs.title: fix(extension): persist CDP reconnect backoff across service worker restarts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Moves the CDP tunnel's reconnect backoff from in-memory state into `chrome.storage.session`, so the ladder survives MV3 service-worker restarts, and consults it from all three reconnect entry points: the live timer, the 30s keepalive alarm, and a cold `start()`. The backoff cap goes from 30s to 5 minutes.

## Why it's needed

The old ladder was in-memory only, but Chrome kills an idle MV3 worker after ~30s and the pending timer and delay state die with it. Each keepalive alarm then woke a fresh worker whose top-level `start()` retried immediately. Against a daemon that rejects the WebSocket upgrade, e.g. an extension origin missing from `--allow-origin`, that loop fired every 10–30s forever and logged ~4,000–6,000 rejection lines per day in the user's journal (#13966). With the ladder persisted, repeated rejections now space out exponentially up to one attempt per 5 minutes, and recovery is still instant once the daemon accepts a handshake (the state clears on the first successful `onopen`).

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. `cd packages/chrome-extension && npm test`: 149/149 pass, including the new `src/daemon/reconnect-backoff.test.ts` (5 cases: ladder doubling and cap, escalation across calls, config-change reset, `isBackingOff` expiry, clear-on-success).
2. `npm run typecheck` is clean and `npm run build` bundles the new module into `dist/extension/background/service-worker.js`.
3. Manual sanity (optional): load the unpacked extension with a `qwen serve` daemon that lacks the extension origin in `--allow-origin`, watch `chrome://extensions` service-worker logs. Reconnect attempts should space 1s, 2s, 4s … rather than a flat retry every alarm tick. I did not run the real-Chrome pass myself; see below.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (no UI change). Before, from the issue: daemon logs a `WebSocket upgrade rejected` line every ~10–30s indefinitely. After: attempts double from 1s up to a 5-minute cap, persisted across worker restarts.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: unit tests, typecheck, and production build all run. Windows/Linux: not run locally; the change uses only cross-platform extension APIs (`chrome.storage.session`, `chrome.alarms`).

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests and build under the repo's Node/npm workspace. No live daemon used.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a dropped *healthy* tunnel now shares the same persisted ladder, so a long-unreachable daemon is retried at most every 5 minutes instead of every 30s. That is the intended spam reduction; a freshly fixed daemon is picked up within minutes, and any successful open resets the ladder to 1s.
- Not validated / out of scope: no real-Chrome run against a rejecting daemon (no Chrome on this machine with the extension sideloaded); the reporter's other ask, a settings toggle to disable autoconnect entirely, is left for a follow-up since the 5-minute cap already removes the log-spam harm.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. `chrome.storage.session` needs no new permission (`storage` is already declared) and clears on browser restart.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13966

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

把 CDP 隧道的重连退避从内存状态挪到 `chrome.storage.session`，让退避阶梯在 MV3 service worker 重启后仍然保留，并在全部三个重连入口（存活 worker 的定时器、30 秒 keepalive 闹钟、冷启动的 `start()`）统一查询它。退避上限从 30 秒提高到 5 分钟。

## 为什么需要

旧的退避阶梯只存在于内存，但 Chrome 会在 MV3 worker 空闲约 30 秒后把它杀掉，挂起的定时器和延迟状态一起丢失。之后每次 keepalive 闹钟唤醒一个全新的 worker，其顶层 `start()` 会立即重试。当 daemon 拒绝 WebSocket 升级时（例如扩展 origin 不在 `--allow-origin` 里），这个循环每 10–30 秒触发一次、永不停止，每天在用户 journal 里刷约 4000–6000 行拒绝日志（见 #13966）。阶梯持久化之后，连续被拒绝时重试间隔按指数拉大，封顶每 5 分钟一次；而一旦 daemon 正常接受握手，恢复仍然是即时的（第一次成功 `onopen` 就清空状态）。

## Reviewer 验证计划

### 如何验证

1. `cd packages/chrome-extension && npm test`：149/149 通过，包括新增的 `src/daemon/reconnect-backoff.test.ts`（5 个用例：阶梯倍增与封顶、跨调用递增、配置变更重置、`isBackingOff` 过期语义、成功后清零）。
2. `npm run typecheck` 干净，`npm run build` 能把新模块打进 `dist/extension/background/service-worker.js`。
3. 手动抽查（可选）：以未加 `--allow-origin` 的 `qwen serve` 加载未打包扩展，观察 `chrome://extensions` 的 service worker 日志，重连间隔应为 1s、2s、4s…… 而不是每个闹钟周期平铺一次。我本人没跑真实 Chrome 环节，见下。

### 前后对比证据

无（无 UI 改动）。修复前（来自 issue）：daemon 每约 10–30 秒打一行 `WebSocket upgrade rejected`，永不停止。修复后：重试间隔从 1 秒指数倍增到 5 分钟封顶，且跨 worker 重启保持。

### 测试平台

macOS 已跑单测、typecheck、生产构建；Windows/Linux 未本地跑，但改动只用跨平台扩展 API（`chrome.storage.session`、`chrome.alarms`）。

### 环境（可选）

仓库自带 Node/npm workspace 下跑单测与构建，未使用真实 daemon。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险/取舍：原本健康的隧道掉线后也共用同一条持久化阶梯，daemon 长期不可达时最多每 5 分钟重试一次（原来是 30 秒）。这正是本 PR 要的降噪效果；daemon 恢复后几分钟内就会被接上，任何一次成功 open 都会把阶梯重置回 1 秒。
- 未验证/不在范围：没有对着拒绝握手的 daemon 做真实 Chrome 验证（本机没有 sideload 该扩展的 Chrome）；issue 里另一个诉求（提供彻底关闭自动连接的开关）留待后续，因为 5 分钟封顶已经消除了日志刷屏的实际伤害。
- 破坏性变更/迁移说明：无。`chrome.storage.session` 不需要新权限（`storage` 已声明），浏览器重启即清空。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13966

</details>

prs.title: fix(cli): open the highlighted /mcp server when grouping reorders rows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

`/mcp` now selects servers by identity instead of by a display index. `ServerListStep` reports the selected server object, and `MCPManagementDialog` stores its name and resolves it against `servers` — the same name-based selection the OpenTUI dialog already uses.

## Why it's needed

Rows are grouped by source while `servers` stays in configured order. Top-tier servers (`--mcp-config`, ACP/IDE session, bundled Mem0) render under "User MCPs" but sit last in `servers`, so passing a row index made the dialog open a different server; Disable, Clear Authentication, Reconnect and Approve then applied to that server. Removing the index means the two orderings can no longer be confused.

Fixes #14651.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

```console
cd packages/cli
../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/ui/components/mcp
```

45 tests pass. The new mixed-source test fails on `9135d45910` because the callback receives the row index, and passes here because it receives `cliSrv`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

- Before: selecting `cliSrv` (row 2) called `onSelect(1)`; the dialog used `servers[1]` = `projectSrv`.
- After: the callback receives the `cliSrv` object; the dialog resolves it by name.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

macOS: `components/mcp` suite 45 passed, `tsc --noEmit`, eslint and prettier on the changed files. No live TUI session was run.

### Environment (optional)

N/A — unit tests only. No screen recording is attached because no live TUI session was run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: `ServerListStepProps.onSelect` changes signature; it is internal to the MCP dialog package (`ServerListStep`, `MCPManagementDialog`, tests).
- Not validated / out of scope: live TUI keypress flow and non-macOS platforms.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none (internal type only).

## Linked Issues

Fixes #14651

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

`/mcp` 原来按行的显示位置传索引，但列表按来源分组后的顺序与配置里的 `servers` 数组顺序不同：`--mcp-config`、ACP/IDE 会话和内置 Mem0 在数组里排在项目服务器之后，显示时却归到 "User MCPs"。选中第二行可能打开另一台服务器。

本 PR 改为按身份选择：`ServerListStep` 把选中的 server 对象交给回调，`MCPManagementDialog` 保存 `selectedServerName` 并用 `servers.find(...)` 解析，与 OpenTUI 版已有的做法一致。新增的混合来源测试在 base 9135d45910 上失败（回调收到行号），分支上 `components/mcp` 套件 45 个测试通过；`tsc --noEmit`、eslint、prettier 均通过。未跑真实 TUI 会话和非 macOS 平台。

</details>

prs.title: test(web-shell): include transcript coverage in recovery fixture
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Complete the recovery event terminal flags and route both Chromium test steps to runner temporary storage. Main now includes transcript coverage; this branch synchronizes that change and preserves all handoff assertions. Remove the unevaluated transcript type guard: E2E specs are excluded from the existing typecheck, so it cannot provide the claimed CI contract check.

## Why it's needed

After #15865, the client rejects transcript responses without a valid coverage sequence. The recovery mock omitted it, so the new-session draft contained an incomplete-history marker instead of the confirmed answer and latest user request. The fixture now reports coverage through sequence 6, matching its supplied history.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Run the Web Shell smoke suite. The recovery handoff should include the confirmed answer and latest request, remain editable, retain the selected workspace, and never send automatically. Existing assertions and timeouts are unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: [the failing smoke job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40917377740/job/123601330627) consistently misses `Confirmed inspection complete` in the recovery draft. Static tracing identifies the missing coverage field and transcript validation added in #15865. The previous revision passed Web Shell smoke and Linux Node CI in run 40926513154. The follow-up adds required event terminal flags and removes the unevaluated type guard; CI for that follow-up is pending.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Static review and diff whitespace check only; no local tests, builds or lint |
| Windows | Not tested locally |
| Linux | Existing failing CI inspected; repaired CI pending |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test-only response correction; all browser assertions remain intact. This does not add an E2E typecheck project.
- Not validated / out of scope: both Chromium steps now avoid the shared /tmp tmpfs; this does not clean other runner files or establish that all environment failures are resolved.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; production code and assertions are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

prs.title: fix(cli): preserve delimiter-shaped markdown table body rows
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserves Markdown table body rows that resemble delimiter lines. Only the delimiter immediately following the header defines column alignment; later hyphen-only or alignment-shaped rows remain visible as data.

## Why it's needed

Rendered terminal output currently drops these valid body rows and can overwrite the original column alignment. This loses table contents, including rows that use `---` as a placeholder for missing values.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### R7 follow-up (2026-10-09)

Current head is `54d19319646cce0100f2aae5d6094e08e453a27d`. This follow-up addresses the small closed-display-math character-rescue regression in [round 7](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13368#pullrequestreview-5465937898). All older sections below describe their named historical heads, including the prior R6 CI snapshot. Truly unclosed/lone/literal math policy (R6-1) remains unresolved; R6-2 stays fixed.

A long paragraph followed by a small closed formula could previously be committed through an internal formula blank. The retained true closer then became an apparent opener, withholding a later completed table until finalization. Rescue now commits the preceding source first and keeps that small formula intact. A zero-offset opener still uses positive hard-cap progress, with a recheck for a later math/code opener; source, ordinary code repair and continuation gutters are preserved. Oversized math still hard-splits and can retain its following table. No timeout, parity or prose/size heuristic predicting whether math will ever close was added.

The exact 17,176-character LF witness previously committed 16,369 characters and retained its completed table. It now commits source lengths 16,361 / 217 / 593 and leaves `Done.` pending. The cap-aligned CRLF witness uses a 16,372-character prefix and commits 16,374 / 224 / 638; naive conversion with the same LF prefix is a passing old-head control. Formal coverage adds 72 cases across nine fixtures, raw/render, both real-stream mode switches, and LF/CRLF. Exact old head `be8d4adc` gives 64 semantic failures and 8 passing CRLF controls, with 368 existing cases excluded by the focused filter; the frozen candidate passes all 72. These mode switches execute on a live stream, but equal mode expectations alone do not discriminate captured from live mode selection.

Independent offline verification passes the same 16 original fixtures and 32 separately constructed edge probes. Deleting only rescue backoff selection causes 8 semantic failures while all 8 no-math controls pass. Positive progress, retained source, partial cap delimiters, actual-code literals and exact continued gutters are checked. Oversized probes establish capped progress and exact source only, and explicitly observe that their following table can remain pending. Two independent source/coverage passes found no new blocker in this narrow repair; this is not approval of the whole PR or resolution of R6-1.

The exact frozen candidate passes all six related suites, **1072/1072**, changed-source lint, formatting, diff checks, fresh build, bundle and full workspace/integration static typechecks on Linux Node.js 22.23.3 / pnpm 11.24.0. The fresh offline CLI version smoke returns `0.25.0`. Native hooks completed during the normal commit; its committed tree and patch match the tested candidate byte-for-byte, with both identities `Jin Long <arowana.java@qq.com>`. The actual committed-head pinned-main proof passes 48 checks with 32 Git-derived API-shaped requests; a separate proof against publicly fetched main `5ddd43815bf141ad448a546aeba768b0bc90820d` verifies all eight latest gate commits/blobs and 16 API-shaped requests. This does not claim full ancestry of the newer main. No full preflight, authenticated interactive CLI, live provider, paid API or local Mac/Windows run is claimed; earlier platform/full-preflight limits remain.

At **2026-10-09 06:56 UTC**, exact-head CI is [Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37894802330) in_progress/null; [tui-parity](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37894802251) completed/success. Overall CI has not passed. Prior head `be8d4adc` main CI and TUI parity both completed successfully; those historical results are not new-head CI evidence.

This increment is three files, 210 additions / 5 deletions. The existing PR against its pinned base is nine files, 1,955 additions / 34 deletions (1,989 changed lines), predominantly regression coverage. It remains on the user-authorized original branch because this repair and its source/fence controls exercise the same streaming-boundary behavior under review. Round-7 scanner/legacy-helper handoff and cap-state capture advisories, and the earlier raw-preview/duplicate-walker suggestions, remain deferred; this change does not claim to fix that broader grammar handoff. No bot reply or thread resolution was published.

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted with implementation, regression coverage, independent offline verification and this evidence update.

### R6 follow-up (2026-10-09)

Current head: [`be8d4adcb78729e2247564abb57739c9bb43a00a`](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/commit/be8d4adcb78729e2247564abb57739c9bb43a00a), normally pushed to the existing PR branch. The earlier dated sections below, including their "current head" and CI statements, remain historical evidence for those revisions.

- R6-1, closed-block case: when the height cap falls inside display math, continue to a safe blank-line boundary after the block closes and commit the complete block in raw and render modes. The policy for a truly unclosed math block is still unresolved; R6-1 is not fully resolved.
- R6-2: restore the repaired fallback for an in-budget blank inside an ordinary code fence that has already closed before the cap. Preserve closing/reopened fences and line-number gutters, exclude Mermaid, and guard the new fallback against cutting into earlier display math.
- Offline verification on the frozen candidate used for this commit: 36/36 new regressions, six related suites with 1000/1000 tests, and 80/80 independent checks passed. Three mechanism-deletion probes triggered 8, 16 and 8 failures respectively. Build, bundle, typecheck, lint/format and the native pre-commit hook passed. Post-commit tree/freshness verification passed and the remote head was read back exactly.
- These are bounded offline/local results. No full green preflight, authenticated interactive CLI, live provider or Windows run is claimed; the earlier macOS full-suite limitations remain unresolved.

CI checked at 2026-10-09 01:19 UTC: [Qwen Code CI 37868674590](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37868674590) and [tui-parity 37868674939](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37868674939) both report `in_progress / null`. Overall CI has not passed.

AI assistance: OpenAI Codex assisted with implementation, regression coverage, offline verification and this evidence update.

### Latest review follow-up (2026-10-08)

Current head: [`a2447ccc5c155fba6880f29f652fd0416d5640a2`](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/commit/a2447ccc5c155fba6880f29f652fd0416d5640a2). This section is the latest evidence; the earlier dated sections below describe their historical revisions and CI runs.

All four deferred findings in [round 5](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13368#pullrequestreview-5453022377) are addressed:
- [`f57a632`](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/commit/f57a632091878869e2e464ee2142a45a5f828c22): the forward boundary scan maintains source offsets and code/display-math state in one forward pass, removing the repeated prefix rescans (R5-1). Blank lines inside display math are excluded (R5-2). Only newline-terminated source blank lines are eligible, so an unterminated trailing fragment cannot suppress the existing fence fallback through an index of `-1` (R5-3). Original source, equations and continuous code gutters are preserved. This is not a claim of linear complexity for every regex or the cumulative stream.
- [`a2447ccc`](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/commit/a2447ccc5c155fba6880f29f652fd0416d5640a2): when a confirmed leading table is pending in raw mode and `keptLines === 0`, render an Ink-wrapped header prefix within the existing height budget (D5). Complete source and whole-table commits remain intact; the estimator, completed output and visual mode are unchanged. Unconfirmed separators and the pre-existing visual-mode wide-header behavior are outside this fix; a one-row budget can show only the leading pipe.

Final-tree verification on Linux, Node.js 22.23.3 / pnpm 11.24.0:
- D5: 48/48 focused checks pass (44 renderer cases plus 4 held-stream/source controls); against the exact previous renderer, 39 fail and 9 controls pass. Six related suites pass 964/964, including the R5 regressions.
- Independent D5 actual-render/layout, held-stream and source-deletion checks pass. Build, bundle, full workspace/integration typechecks, lint/format, offline CLI smoke, 48/48 gate-freshness checks and the native pre-commit hook pass. The final committed tree is byte-identical to the tested candidate.
- The separate R5 18-stream / 4-Ink checks were run on prior head `562365e`, not rerun on the final head. No full preflight, authenticated interactive CLI, live provider or Windows run was performed locally; earlier macOS full-suite limitations remain unresolved.

CI checked at 2026-10-08 18:19 UTC: [Qwen Code CI 37821432264](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37821432264) is still in progress; [tui-parity 37821432480](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37821432480) passed. The no-AK integration job passed; the authenticated CLI integration job is skipped. Overall CI has not yet passed.

### How to verify

Render a table with `| --- | --- |` as its first body row and confirm that the row remains visible. Also render ordinary data followed by `| :---: | ---: |` and another hyphen-only row: all rows should remain visible, and the ordinary data should keep the alignment defined immediately after the header. Verify completed output and complete streaming previews, LF and CRLF, and two tables with different alignment settings.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The same synthetic Markdown was rendered through the actual terminal components before and after the fix. This is a component-level rendering reproduction, not a full interactive CLI test. The global CLI was attempted with isolated configuration but could not reach a model response without authentication; no model service was contacted.

Before, only one of three body rows was displayed:

```text
┌───────┬────────┐
│ Item  │ Status │
├───────┼────────┤
│ build │ passed │
└───────┴────────┘
```

After, all three body rows remain visible:

```text
┌───────┬────────┐
│ Item  │ Status │
├───────┼────────┤
│ ---   │    --- │
├───────┼────────┤
│ build │ passed │
├───────┼────────┤
│ :---: │   ---: │
└───────┴────────┘
```

Validation: all 12 new regression cases fail against the exact unmodified source and pass with the fix. The three focused test files pass all 309 tests. Full repository build, bundle, typecheck, changed-file lint/format checks, and local CLI version/help smoke checks pass. The full preflight passed installation, formatting, repository lint, build and typecheck, then reported failures in serve/review tests during the full CLI suite and was stopped. Targeted reruns of those seven test files produced 10 and 15 failures, with 10 shared failures. None of those tests loaded the edited Markdown renderer, which strongly suggests separate helper/environment issues, but their root causes were not established and a clean historical checkout comparison was not performed. A full green preflight is not claimed. The startup bundle closure check also passes.

### Cloud verification (2026-10-06)

Merged current upstream `main` `ac497aeed956981e817b4301837866730359a65f` into the existing PR branch with a normal merge. New head: `ec9bf778da40a9fc243cf73b9ef1575d5a6ca009`; parents: original PR head `149f26ff8d98d616813bb7a1b200a9beb329e022` and that upstream revision. The PR still changes only the original three files (65 additions / 2 deletions); no CI, hook, or lint policy was weakened.

The failing freshness step in [job 112380501173](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37179968695/job/112380501173) ran before dependency installation and ESLint. Its missing upstream commit was `6b878e1a04ec70a35f8d14125fb3aafea4fb8973` (`scripts/lint.js`). A local harness running the original freshness implementation with Git-derived API-shaped data reproduces exactly that one stale file on the old head and returns none on the new committed head: 34/34 assertions pass. All eight gate files in the new commit are byte-identical to that upstream main. This local proof is not a remote CI result.

Linux cloud execution used Node.js 22.23.3 and pnpm 11.24.0 with this worktree's own frozen installation. Root build, bundle, repository/integration ESLint, repository Prettier check, all-workspace/integration typecheck, and `node dist/cli.js --version` (0.25.0) passed. Five suites passed 633/633 tests: MarkdownDisplay 198, TableRenderer 74, pending-rendered-height 37, markdownUtilities 35, and use-llm-stream 289. The three original table suites therefore pass 309/309 again. No authenticated interactive CLI session, live model API, or full preflight was run in this cloud verification; the original macOS full-suite limitations above remain unresolved.

The real native pre-commit hook completed its Prettier and ESLint tasks, but its application phase reported an ignored `.qwen/e2e-tests` directory inherited from main. lint-staged 16.1.6 returned success despite that error; this is not a clean whole-hook result. The hook backup index tree exactly equals the committed tree and the worktree/index are clean. A separate run of the actual lint-staged configuration over only the three PR files completed every phase successfully without changing the tree.

At the new head, [Qwen Code CI 37512242757](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37512242757) and [tui-parity 37512242838](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37512242838) both report `completed / action_required`. They have not passed; maintainer approval is still required for those workflow runs.

### Regression follow-up (2026-10-07)

Current head: [`605991d32b3569c9a536bad0c358323faf6e9fc4`](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/commit/605991d32b3569c9a536bad0c358323faf6e9fc4). Restores the previous tolerance for extra bare separator-shaped lines inside a confirmed table, retaining the header, subsequent supported body rows and initial alignment. The renderer and pending-height estimator share the skip rule; height accounting preserves source slice boundaries and anchors layout to the first actual body row. Existing outer-pipe row syntax and regex captures remain unchanged.

The [review's four-line final fixture](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13368#discussion_r4201960176) renders raw lines without Item/Status on `b00c0474`; the new head restores the exact boxed header and build/passed body seen on base `ac497ae`. The exact unclosed pending fixture retains the baseline forming-header holdback. A closed pending fixture with a following non-pipe Done line displays the restored table. Outer-pipe delimiter-shaped data remains visible; ordinary pipe-less text still closes the table.

Added 28 focused cases for LF/CRLF, final/pending boundaries, repeated separators, alignment, body syntax, first-body layout and rendered-height agreement. Twenty-four fail on unchanged `b00c0474` source; four negative controls already pass. All five related suites pass **661/661**: MarkdownDisplay 222, pending-rendered-height 41, TableRenderer 74, markdownUtilities 35 and use-llm-stream 289. Independent real base/old/candidate component verification passes **8 comparisons / 24 renderings**.

Linux cloud validation used Node.js 22.23.3 and pnpm 11.24.0. Full build, bundle, workspace/integration typecheck, changed-file lint/format, fresh CLI version smoke, native pre-commit hook and independent review pass. These are offline component and local checks; no authenticated interactive CLI, live model API, Windows or full preflight was run. The earlier macOS full-suite limitations above remain unresolved.

CI checked at 2026-10-07 02:11:12 UTC: [Qwen Code CI 37556907433](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37556907433) is `in_progress / null`; [tui-parity 37556907422](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37556907422) is `completed / success`. Overall CI has not passed.

### Tested on

|     OS     |       Status       |
| :--------: | :----------------: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ✅ Component probe |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested      |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ Cloud unit/build checks |

### Environment (optional)

Original macOS verification: macOS 26.4.1 (arm64), Node.js v24.13.0, based on `main` revision `561b606b197eb239e15e28545ea38400c6a7f50e`.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: preserving the distinction between the initial delimiter and table body rows, including complete streaming previews and consecutive tables.
- Not validated / out of scope: authenticated interactive CLI conversations, external model services, Windows execution, and unrelated Markdown parsing behavior.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13367

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

保留外观类似分隔线的 Markdown 表格正文行。只有紧接表头的分隔线决定列对齐；后面的纯横线行或带对齐冒号的行仍作为数据显示。

## 为什么需要修复

终端渲染目前会丢弃这些有效正文行，并可能覆盖原来的列对齐方式。表格内容因此丢失，包括使用 `---` 表示缺失值的行。

## 评审验证计划

### R7 跟进（2026-10-09）

当前 head 为 `54d19319646cce0100f2aae5d6094e08e453a27d`。本轮处理[第 7 轮](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13368#pullrequestreview-5465937898)的小型已闭合展示公式字符上限切分回归。以下旧章节均是其标注 head 的历史证据，包括先前 R6 的 CI 快照。真正未闭合／孤立／字面量公式政策 R6-1 仍未解决；R6-2 保持已修复。

长段落后的小型已闭合公式此前可能在内部空行处被提交；保留尾部的真实结束符会变成表面上的开始符，使之后已完成的表格一直留到最终提交。现在先提交公式前的原始文本，保留整段小公式。零偏移开始符仍使用正向硬上限进度，并复查上限处是否处于后续公式／代码块；保留源码、普通代码修复和连续行号。超大公式仍会硬切，其后表格仍可能留在 pending。未增加超时、奇偶计数或根据散文／大小预测公式是否永远不会闭合的规则。

准确的 17,176 字符 LF 用例此前只提交 16,369 字符并保留已完成表格；现在依次提交 16,361／217／593 字符，pending 只留 `Done.`。对齐上限的 CRLF 用例使用 16,372 字符前缀，依次提交 16,374／224／638 字符；直接沿用 LF 前缀长度的 CRLF 转换是旧版本已通过的对照。正式新增 72 项，覆盖九类输入、raw／render、真实流中的双向模式切换及 LF／CRLF。精确旧 head `be8d4adc` 有 64 项语义失败和 8 项通过的 CRLF 对照，聚焦筛选未执行原有 368 项；冻结候选 72 项全部通过。这些切换发生在实时流内，但相同模式预期本身不能独立区分捕获模式与实时读取模式。

独立离线验证通过同一批 16 项原始输入及另外构造的 32 项边界探针。只删除新增回退选择后产生 8 项语义失败，8 项无公式对照仍通过。验证正向进度、源码保留、跨上限分隔符、真实代码中的字面量及精确连续行号。超大公式探针只证明上限内进度和源码准确，并明确观测其后表格仍可保持 pending。独立源码／覆盖率两遍审查未发现本轮窄修复的新阻塞，不代表整 PR 通过或 R6-1 已解决。

准确冻结候选在 Linux Node.js 22.23.3／pnpm 11.24.0 上通过六个相关套件 **1072/1072**、改动源码 lint、格式、diff、新 build／bundle 及全 workspace／integration 静态类型检查。新打包离线 CLI 版本检查输出 `0.25.0`。正常提交完整执行原生 hooks，提交 tree 和补丁逐字节匹配已测候选，Author／Committer 均为 `Jin Long <arowana.java@qq.com>`。真实新提交对固定 main 的证明通过 48 项检查、32 个 Git 派生 API 形状请求；另对公开 fetch 的当前 main `5ddd43815bf141ad448a546aeba768b0bc90820d` 验证全部八项最新门禁提交／blob 和 16 个 API 形状请求，不代表完整包含这个更新 main。未声称 full preflight、带认证交互式 CLI、真实 provider、付费 API 或本地 Mac／Windows 验证；此前平台和完整预检限制保持披露。

截至 **2026-10-09 06:56 UTC**，精确新 head 的 CI 为 [Qwen Code CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37894802330) in_progress/null; [tui-parity](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/37894802251) completed/success。整体 CI 尚未通过。此前 `be8d4adc` 的主 CI 和 TUI parity 均成功完成，这些历史结果不作为新 head CI 证据。

本轮增量三文件、增加 210／删除 5 行；既有 PR 对固定 base 为九文件、增加 1,955／删除 34 行，共 1,989 改动行，主要为回归覆盖。按用户授权保留原分支，因为本修复及源码／围栏控制共同验证正在评审的流式边界行为。第 7 轮扫描器交接旧辅助逻辑、cap 状态捕获，以及此前 raw 预览／重复 walker 建议仍延后；不声称解决更广泛的语法交接问题。未发布机器人回复或 resolve 讨论。

AI 辅助说明：OpenAI Codex 协助实现、回归覆盖、独立离线验证及本次证据更新。

prs.title: fix(core): report speculation files that could not be applied
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Report real speculation copy failures with the failed paths and first I/O cause. Keep successfully applied files and their count; if any edit reached disk, report the partial result without resubmitting the same turn. Missing overlay entries and directory placeholders are skipped.

## Why it's needed

Swallowing a copy error lets the UI and model history claim an edit landed. Retrying after a partial copy can apply the edits twice. Both paths need an explicit failure result.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/core`: `pnpm exec vitest run src/followup/overlayFs.test.ts src/followup/accept-speculation.test.ts`. From `packages/cli`: `pnpm exec vitest run src/ui/AppContainer.test.tsx`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

At `46fe6684` (merged main `5122ec9`): core `src/followup` 150 passed (31 in the two changed files); CLI `AppContainer.test.tsx` 252 passed. Tests cover real copy failures, applied/failed counts and cause, missing/directory entries, a real file changed after the snapshot, open-stage vs copy-stage damage, the correction injected for paths that did not land, failed telemetry, and no resubmit after partial writes. Earlier parent-directory red/green evidence remains in the review thread.

Core `tsc --noEmit` and the full `pnpm --filter @qwen-code/qwen-code run build` passed. The standalone CLI `tsc --noEmit` reports four errors in main-side files outside this diff (`acpAgent.ts`, `attach.ts`, `memory-import.ts`, `run-qwen-serve.ts`). ESLint and Prettier are clean on the six changed files. Full preflight, Windows/Linux, and live speculation E2E were not run locally.

### Tested on

macOS. Windows and Linux were not tested locally.

### Environment (optional)

Frozen pnpm dependencies and the repository's Ink patch. Unit tests use local temporary files or test doubles; no live speculation E2E run.

## Risk & Scope

Successful copies remain on disk: this does not make writes atomic. With zero applied files, normal submission remains the fallback. Aggregating all causes remains a separate suggestion. Full preflight and live E2E were not run. No API migration.

## Linked Issues

Related follow-up: #13062.

prs.title: fix(web-shell): batch session deletions at the route limit
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Bulk deletion in Session Overview sends sequential requests of at most 100 session IDs through each owning workspace's client. Successful results remain available for current-session cleanup, and per-session and request failures are retained across batches and workspaces regardless of their order. A rejected request stops the remaining batches in that workspace; other workspace groups continue.

The change adds component regressions, a dark/light browser scenario and behavior documentation. Archive behavior, catalog pagination, server validation, SDK interfaces, permissions and dependencies are unchanged.

## Why it's needed

The previous delete path sends all selected IDs in one request, which fails with `400 invalid_request` above the daemon's 100-ID limit. Archive already batches at this limit. This addresses only the bulk-delete part of item 5 in #14346 and leaves the multi-item issue open.

**Reproduction boundary:** the stock daemon caps a catalog page at 100 sessions, and the overview does not fetch subsequent catalog pages. Creating 101 transcripts therefore does not expose this boundary through the unmodified UI. The >100-selection regressions deliberately use fixture catalogs; the delete request limit remains unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. With 100, 101 and 201 selected deletable sessions from one workspace, expect request sizes `[100]`, `[100, 1]` and `[100, 100, 1]`. Every selected ID is sent exactly once, and each response must settle before the next request starts.
2. Select sessions from a primary and trusted secondary workspace. Hold the primary response pending: the qualified client must not be called yet. Release it and verify the secondary request uses its owning workspace route. Each affected workspace is refreshed.
3. Exercise both cross-workspace error orders: a rejected request followed by a per-session error, and the reverse. Both causes must be visible. Also return multiple per-session errors in one batch and a distinct error in a later batch; all causes must remain visible. A single-error message retains its existing format.
4. With 201 selected sessions, let an earlier batch partially succeed and the second request reject. Expect no third request for that workspace, retained successful current-session cleanup and a visible failure. Other workspace groups must still be processed.
5. Run the included dark/light browser scenario with its synthetic 101-session catalog. Confirm the delete dialog, `[100, 1]` requests, cleared target rows and preserved unrelated current-session control. The mock rejects oversized requests.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Check | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 101 selected sessions, browser fixture | One 101-ID request returns 400; target rows remain | Requests of 100 and 1 succeed; target rows clear |
| Original six component regressions at `402e9590` | 5 fail; the 100-ID control passes | All pass |
| New error regressions at `80a5154` | 2 fail, 1 control passes; later causes are missing | Both cross-workspace orders and multiple batch errors pass |
| Panel and constants suites | — | 134 tests pass, including 133 panel cases |
| Cross-workspace test sensitivity | Concurrent dispatch or per-workspace error reset injected only by an isolated test loader | Each mutation fails both new cross-workspace cases; the existing single-workspace mixed-error control passes |

The repository visual scenario passes in both themes and fails when an isolated Vite loader supplies only the baseline delete branch. This is a scoped negative control, not a complete baseline checkout. These tests use synthetic daemon responses rather than real transcript deletion.

Latest built-UI verification uses Chrome 155 against the Web Shell served by the local CLI with isolated configuration/runtime/workspace directories. Both cross-workspace failure orders and same-batch/subsequent-batch errors pass together, checking owning routes, response gating, visible causes and the unrelated current-session control. A successful 101-session deletion control passes separately after correcting its test-only empty-table expectation from `0 session(s)` to the actual `No data` state. No product code changed for that harness correction. There are no uncaught page errors or model calls; deliberate 409 responses produce only their expected resource error. No real user sessions were deleted, and owned test services were stopped.

Full repository build, bundle, repository typecheck, zero-warning repository lint, changed-file formatting and diff checks pass. The full repository unit suite/preflight was not rerun; upstream CI must run independently. Tests were run on macOS with Node 22.22.3; Windows/Linux runtime verification is not claimed.

| Before: oversized request | After: bounded requests |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before bulk deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jianyx1/qwen-code/82199691bd3c0e8908df82bbaf5d38a98fb44143/before.png) | ![After bulk deletion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jianyx1/qwen-code/82199691bd3c0e8908df82bbaf5d38a98fb44143/after.png) |

### Independent verification

[wenshao's earlier verification](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/14637#issuecomment-6261072360) reports real Chrome, built Web Shell and disposable on-disk transcripts at `1e0edb1`: baseline failure at 101 sessions and successful head runs at 100/101/201. It raised only the catalog list-page cap to 1000 in both isolated trees; the delete validator remained unchanged. These independently reported storage results are separate from the author's synthetic-response evidence above.

## Risk & Scope

Deletion is sequential and can partially succeed; completed batches are not rolled back. The client batch bound is documented next to the constant with a reference to the daemon's existing shared validator. No new cross-package limit export is introduced. Extracting a shared archive/delete loop is deferred to keep the bug fix focused and preserve archive error semantics.

## Linked Issues

Related to #14346, item 5's remaining bulk-delete problem.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

批量删除按所属工作区串行分批，每次最多 100 个会话 ID。成功结果继续用于清理已删除的当前会话；单会话与请求级失败原因跨批次、跨工作区按顺序保留。请求拒绝仅中断所属工作区后续批次，其他工作区继续处理。归档、目录分页、服务端上限、SDK、权限和依赖均保持不变，仅处理 #14346 第 5 项的批量删除问题。

**复现边界：** 原版 daemon 的目录单页上限为 100，概览未跟随下一页游标，因此直接创建 101 条记录无法在原版界面触达此边界。超过 100 条的回归使用合成目录，删除接口的 100-ID 校验未修改。独立协作者的真实磁盘验证仅在两个隔离树提高目录列表上限，与作者的合成响应验证分开披露。

**验证：** 100/101/201 条选择分别发送 `[100]`、`[100, 1]`、`[100, 100, 1]`，每个 ID 恰好一次。新增跨工作区双顺序门控及同批/跨批错误回归，在 `80a5154` 上为 2 个失败、1 个控制通过；修复后面板与常量共 134 项通过（面板 133 项）。模拟工作区并发、按工作区重置错误的两个隔离加载器变异，均使两个跨工作区用例失败，已有单工作区控制仍通过。

构建版 Chrome 155 的三个错误场景通过；101 条全成功控制最初因测试预期空表格文案有误失败，修正测试断言后单独通过，产品代码未变。所属路由、串行门控、错误展示和无关当前会话均符合预期，无未捕获页面异常。响应为合成数据，无模型调用或真实用户会话删除，测试服务已停止。完整构建、bundle、全仓类型检查、零警告 lint、改动文件格式及 diff 检查通过。本轮未重跑全仓单元测试/preflight，未宣称 Windows/Linux 实测，上游 CI 仍需独立运行。

删除可能部分成功，不回滚已完成批次。批量常量直接注释了既有 daemon 校验器来源；跨包常量导出及公共循环抽取不纳入此次修复。

</details>

prs.title: fix(core): preserve Linux shell group ownership during cancellation
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Preserve ordinary Linux Shell cancellation ownership after leader exit and settle after the owned-group cleanup attempt. Child-process and PTY execution share 200 ms TERM grace and post-KILL confirmation timer budgets, with at-most-once KILL escalation. Natural completion and background promotion are preserved. PTY cancellation retains native exit evidence arriving within its existing 200 ms output-drain timer budget; missing evidence remains null at that deadline.

Separate signaling authority from cleanup confirmation: a freshly matching recorded boot/start, group and session identity can authorize TERM/KILL despite incomplete visibility, while incomplete enumeration cannot confirm success. Without a readable unchanged recorded witness, signaling is refused; known non-proc sources also refuse signals. Both TUI processors preserve cancellation status, the cancellation marker, cleanup diagnostics and partial output in display and user-shell LLM-history text, retaining any known result status alongside a diagnostic. The PTY output-drain budget is independent of TERM grace; both remain 200 ms at current defaults.

## Why it's needed

A TERM-responsive leader can exit while a TERM-ignoring descendant remains in its group. Previously, leader exit suppressed escalation and removed ownership. A subsequent visibility guard also suppressed signals to authenticated groups; cleanup diagnostics then took precedence over cancellation in both TUI processors. Later, diagnostic branches still omitted the cancellation marker and known result status, and confirmed PTY cleanup could settle before deferred native exit status arrived.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Cancel a freshly owned Linux group containing a TERM-responsive leader and a TERM-ignoring descendant. The descendant should stop after one group KILL and the result should settle afterward. No-survivor groups need no KILL; repeated cleanup must not dispatch another destructive signal. Natural completion and promotion must preserve transferred descendants.

With restricted mount metadata modeled over real owned processes, cancellation should send one TERM and one KILL; synchronous cleanup should send one KILL. Visibility uncertainty must remain a diagnostic unless termination is otherwise confirmed. Loss of all readable unchanged recorded witnesses and explicit non-proc sources, including ambiguous proc/tmpfs mounts, must refuse destructive signals. ESRCH is terminal; permission errors do not prove termination.

Feed aborted results containing cleanup diagnostics through the actual TUI processors. Ink's final display model must be Canceled with the marker/diagnostic/output, including actual LLM-history text; OpenTUI must produce the canceled renderer status. Non-aborted errors remain Error. Known signal or exit-code text must remain alongside diagnostics, including zero exit without hiding cleanup failure. Abort handling and UI busy/queue lifecycle are unchanged.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Current verification (2026-10-21, `5eae9188`): full build, sequential repository-wide typecheck, bundle and the normal hook's staged-file ESLint/Prettier passed using retained dependencies. All 1,283 tests across nine affected suites passed (1,224 core, including 18 real owned-process cases and one modeled supervisor case; 59 actual TUI processor cases). Five independent mocked adapter controls preserved the sandbox error veto. Serialized negative controls restored the old display behavior (eight failing status cases) and re-coupled the PTY drain budget (one failing boundary case); all originals were restored byte for byte before final aggregate checks. Normal hooks preserved the tested tree, and independent review found no further correctness issue.

Before: main `69d060e2` returned on both real transports within 5–8 ms while descendants remained running beyond 400 ms and two cleanup calls. At `96c1442`, real owned fixtures with mocked restrictive metadata recorded zero TERM on cancel, and synchronous cleanup did not settle within the 2.5-second fixture timeout. Actual Ink/OpenTUI processor tests classified aborted results with diagnostics as Error.

After: all 18 real-process cases passed on both transports. Authenticated restricted-metadata cancellation sent exactly one TERM/KILL pair; synchronous cleanup sent one KILL. In the authenticated cleanup cases, actors stopped before settlement, visibility uncertainty remained visible, and missing/recycled-authority controls sent no destructive signals. Dedicated subreapers verified fixture reaping. Restrictions were mocked; this is not real hidepid mount validation.

Historical verification at `da819b8` (2026-10-05): 1,008 tests across 14 affected suites—793 core tests (including 201 service, 79 identity/race/visibility, 18 real-process cases and one modeled supervisor-verdict case) and 215 CLI tests (51 actual processor cases plus 164 existing Ink renderer cases). The Ink processor regression checks its final display model; renderer suites separately verify downstream rendering. OpenTUI checks actual event folding and renderer-status logic. Aggregate build, bundle, repository-wide typecheck, scoped lint/format and the normal pre-commit hook passed; the hook preserved the tested tree. Independent review found no remaining must-fix correctness defect within the documented identity-source assumptions.

At `08eba9a`, both processors omitted the cancellation marker from display/history when a diagnostic coexisted; selected tests failed on those exact strings. With a real owned PTY and modeled 100 ms callback delivery, the saved service observed native exit 17/0 but settled with null/null. The correction retained 17/null and final output before the existing drain deadline. The callback delay is synthetic, not measured natural backend latency. Twenty-two serialized deterministic mutations each failed the intended regression; every source/test original was restored byte for byte before final checks. Identity parser cases represent malformed inputs; same-PGID/foreign-session tables are not kernel-reachable states. Production boot-ID caching is unchanged.

Full preflight, model/CLI E2E, real hidepid and non-Linux runtime validation were not run. [Current-head CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667) completed successfully on `5eae9188`: 5 jobs succeeded, including [web-shell E2E Smoke](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667/job/118988140924), and 3 were skipped (CLI integration, Windows and macOS). At `8b67477f`, [hosted CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39429508539) passed lint/static, Ubuntu tests and no-AK integration, but browser smoke failed: 340 passed and one menu-hover case failed at the same assertion in all three attempts. The unchanged targeted case also failed once at that assertion on both `8b67477f` and main `623cb40c`, in isolated worktrees using real system Chromium 151, mocked daemon data and one worker. Matching source/dependency provenance was verified; static review found no path to the modified cleanup code. This establishes a main baseline reproduction in this local configuration. CI uses a different browser revision, and one local execution per commit does not identify the CI trigger or establish flake frequency. The event that closes the menu remains unconfirmed. That CI run is not green; the browser case was not rerun for this follow-up.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ not tested |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ runtime not tested; existing mocked cases passed |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ tested |

### Environment (optional)

Cloud Linux, Node 22.23.3, Corepack 0.34.6, pnpm 11.24.0. Isolated owned fixtures have six-second lifetime bounds, identity-guarded teardown and a dedicated Python subreaper. No model/provider calls.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: signaling assumes trusted kernel procfs in the caller's PID namespace. Enumeration and identity-check-to-signal remain non-atomic. Confirmation requires an ordinary unfiltered view; known restrictive modes and read failures prevent enumeration-based confirmation, not otherwise authenticated signals. The guard cannot certify unknown filters, PID submounts, namespace mismatches or concurrent mount changes; these remain unsupported and can silently omit live members. There is no universal fail-closed guarantee for restrictive `/proc`. [Linux visibility semantics](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/proc.5.html).
- Timer budgets are not hard wall-clock maxima: synchronous scans, scheduling and output draining can overrun them. Scan cost was not benchmarked. Timers remain referenced to retain pending settlement. Shared boot-id reading is reused; existing liveness helpers do not supply the strict single-read group/session identity required here. Parser consolidation and existing protocol/timeout diagnostic projection are deferred. Agent-tool operational failure text can still omit status/output; the user-shell history correction does not expand that contract.
- Not validated / out of scope: macOS and other POSIX descendant cleanup remain unresolved; Windows behavior is unchanged. Descendants escaping their group/session and Managed runtime cleanup are outside this repair.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no configuration or public signature changes. Incomplete cleanup uses the existing error result independently of aborted status. Maintainer scope feedback on #13441 remains pending; no maintainer approval is claimed.

Design: [English](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.zh-CN.md).

AI disclosure: implementation, tests and review were assisted by OpenAI Codex.

## Linked Issues

Refs #13441. This Linux-only change does not close the broader POSIX issue.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

### 本 PR 的改动

普通 Linux Shell 取消时，在组长退出后继续保留所有权，并在自有进程组清理尝试后结算结果。child-process 和 PTY 共用 200 ms TERM 宽限期和 KILL 后确认的 timer 预算，KILL 最多升级一次。保留自然完成和后台提升。PTY 取消在既有 200 ms 输出排空 timer 预算内保留到达的原生退出信息；时限内未收到信息时相应字段仍为 null。

将发信号权限与清理确认分开：重新读取并匹配已记录的 boot/start、进程组及会话身份后，即使可见性不完整也可授权 TERM/KILL；不完整枚举不能确认成功。没有可读且未改变的已记录见证身份时拒绝信号；已知非 proc 来源也会拒绝信号。两种 TUI 处理器在显示和用户 shell 的 LLM history 文本中保留取消状态、取消标记、清理诊断及部分输出；诊断共存时也保留已知结果状态。PTY 输出排空预算独立于 TERM 宽限期；当前默认值均为 200 ms。

### 改动原因

响应 TERM 的组长可能退出，而忽略 TERM 的后代仍留在进程组中。此前组长退出会阻止升级并移除所有权。后续可见性保护也会阻止对已认证组发信号；两种 TUI 处理器随后又将清理诊断优先归类为错误而非取消。之后诊断分支仍遗漏取消标记及已知结果状态，且 PTY 清理确认可能早于延迟的原生退出状态，导致过早结算。

### 审查者测试计划

取消一个本次创建并拥有的 Linux 进程组，其中组长响应 TERM、后代忽略 TERM。后代应在一次组 KILL 后停止，随后结果才结算。没有存活成员时不需要 KILL；重复清理不得再次发出破坏性信号。自然完成和后台提升必须保留已转移的后代。

在真实自有进程上模拟受限挂载元数据：取消应发送一次 TERM/KILL；同步清理应发送一次 KILL。除非另有终止确认，可见性不确定必须保留为诊断。所有可读且未改变的已记录见证身份均丢失，以及明确的非 proc 来源（含有歧义的 proc/tmpfs 挂载）必须拒绝破坏性信号。ESRCH 永久结束清理；权限错误不证明终止。

将带有清理诊断的 aborted 结果传入实际 TUI 处理器。Ink 最终展示模型必须为 Canceled，并保留取消标记、诊断和输出，包括实际 LLM history 文本；OpenTUI 必须产生取消的 renderer 状态。未取消的错误仍为 Error。已知信号或退出码文本应与诊断共存，退出码为零也不能隐藏清理失败。abort 处理及 UI busy/queue 生命周期不变。

### 修改前后证据

本轮验证（2026-10-21，`5eae9188`）：复用既有依赖，完整 build、顺序执行的全仓 typecheck、bundle 及正常 hook 的暂存文件 ESLint/Prettier 均通过。9 个受影响测试集共 1,283 个用例通过（1,224 个 core，含 18 个真实自有进程及 1 个模拟 supervisor 判定用例；59 个实际 TUI 处理器用例）。另有 5 个独立 mock adapter 对照验证 sandbox 的 error 否决逻辑。串行反向对照恢复旧显示行为后，8 个状态用例失败；重新耦合 PTY 排空预算后，1 个边界用例失败。最终聚合检查前逐字节恢复全部原件。正常 hooks 保持已测试 tree 不变，独立审查无新增正确性发现。

修改前：main `69d060e2` 在两种真实传输上于 5–8 ms 内返回，但后代在超过 400 ms 和两次清理后仍运行。在 `96c1442`，模拟受限元数据的真实自有 fixture 在取消时记录到零次 TERM；同步清理在 fixture 的 2.5 秒超时内未结算。实际 Ink/OpenTUI 处理器测试将带诊断的 aborted 结果归为 Error。

修改后：两种传输的全部 18 个真实进程用例通过。已认证组在受限元数据下取消时恰好发送一次 TERM/KILL，同步清理发送一次 KILL。在已认证的清理用例中，进程在结算前停止，可见性不确定仍保留诊断；身份缺失或被复用的对照不发破坏性信号。专用 subreaper 验证 fixture 已回收。限制使用 mock；不是真实 hidepid 挂载验证。

历史验证（2026-10-05，`da819b8`）：14 个受影响测试集共 1,008 个用例——793 个 core 用例（含 201 个 service、79 个身份/竞态/可见性、18 个真实进程及 1 个模拟 supervisor 判定用例）和 215 个 CLI 用例（51 个实际处理器及 164 个既有 Ink renderer 用例）。Ink 处理器回归检查最终展示模型；renderer 测试集独立验证下游渲染。OpenTUI 检查实际事件折叠及 renderer 状态逻辑。聚合 build、bundle、全仓 typecheck、定向 lint/格式检查及正常 pre-commit hook 通过；hook 未改变已测试的 tree。独立审查在已披露的身份来源假设内未发现剩余必修正确性缺陷。

在 `08eba9a`，两种处理器在诊断共存时都从显示/history 中遗漏取消标记；定向测试对这些精确文本失败。对真实自有 PTY 模拟 100 ms callback 传递延迟时，保存的 service 已观测到原生退出 17/0，却以 null/null 结算。修正后在既有排空时限内保留 17/null 和最后输出。callback 延迟是模拟的，不是测得的自然后端延迟。22 个串行确定性 mutation 均使对应回归失败；最终检查前逐字节恢复了全部源码/测试原件。身份 parser 用例表示无效输入；同 PGID、不同 session 的表并非内核可产生状态。生产 boot-ID 缓存行为不变。

未运行完整 preflight、模型/CLI E2E、真实 hidepid 或非 Linux 实机验证。[当前 head 的 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667) 在 `5eae9188` 上已完成并成功：5 个 job 成功，包括 [web-shell E2E Smoke](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39520812667/job/118988140924)；3 个跳过（CLI integration、Windows、macOS）。在 `8b67477f`，[托管 CI](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/39429508539) 的 lint/static、Ubuntu tests 和 no-AK integration 已通过，但浏览器 smoke 失败：340 个通过，1 个菜单 hover 用例在三次尝试中均停在同一断言。该原样定向用例也分别在 `8b67477f` 和 main `623cb40c` 上各失败一次，断言相同；两者采用独立 worktree、真实系统 Chromium 151、模拟 daemon 数据和单 worker。源码及依赖来源同一性已核验，静态审查未找到通向本次修改的清理代码的路径。这确认了该本地配置下的 main 基线复现。CI 的浏览器版本不同，每个提交一次本地运行也不足以确定 CI 的触发原因或 flake 频率。导致菜单关闭的具体事件仍未确认。该轮 CI 尚未全绿；本次跟进未重跑浏览器用例。

### 已测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | ⚠️ 未测试 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未测试真实运行时；既有 mock 用例通过 |
| 🐧 Linux | ✅ 已测试 |

### 环境

云端 Linux，Node 22.23.3、Corepack 0.34.6、pnpm 11.24.0。隔离的自有 fixture 具有六秒生存上限、身份检查的回收逻辑及专用 Python subreaper。未调用模型/provider。

### 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：发信号要求 procfs 是可信内核视图，且属于调用者 PID 命名空间。枚举及身份检查到发信号仍非原子。确认要求普通未过滤视图；已知受限模式及读取失败会阻止通过枚举确认，而非阻止已另行认证的信号。保护不能认证未知过滤、PID 子挂载、命名空间不匹配或并发挂载变化；这些配置仍不受支持，可能静默省略运行成员。不能保证受限 `/proc` 总会保守拒绝。[Linux 可见性语义](https://man7.org/linux/man-pages/man5/proc.5.html)。
- timer 预算不是严格实际耗时上限：同步扫描、调度和输出排空可能超时。未进行扫描性能基准测试。timer 保持引用以保留待完成的结算。已复用共享 boot-id 读取；既有存活 helper 不提供此处所需的单次读取的严格组/会话身份。parser 合并及既有协议/timeout 诊断投影另行处理。agent-tool 的操作失败文本仍可能遗漏状态／输出；用户 shell 的 history 修正不扩展该契约。
- 未验证或范围外：macOS 和其他 POSIX 后代清理仍未解决；Windows 行为不变。逃离进程组/会话的后代及 Managed runtime 清理不在本次修复范围内。
- 兼容性或迁移：无配置或公开签名变更。清理不完整使用既有 error 结果，与 aborted 状态独立。#13441 的维护者范围反馈仍待回复；不声称已有维护者批准。

设计：[English](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/GoldArowana/qwen-code/blob/5eae918880771d6385599f95cd47475823ec3fa3/docs/design/posix-shell-cancellation.zh-CN.md)。

AI 披露：实现、测试和审查得到 OpenAI Codex 辅助。

### 关联 issue

Refs #13441。此 Linux-only 变更不关闭更广的 POSIX issue。
