prs.title: feat(acp): run re-entered, channel and Goal-proposal turns on the shared loop
prs.body:
## What this PR does

With `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` on, five more kinds of ACP turn now run on the shared round, the shared tool batch and the client's stop point. This is PR 2c-2 of #15327.

Two of them are fresh prompts that PR 2a left out:

- A **channel prompt** is a `UserQuery` like any fresh prompt. As today, it carries no submitted prompt or workflow input, its responses are not cut short by queued input, its tool results never end the turn, and its repeated-tool-failure guard stays off.
- A **Goal-proposal approval turn** is a `UserQuery`. The session settles the proposal as today. When the Todo Stop Guard gives way or the Stop hook reaches its cap, the proposal does not start a Goal, as the session's own Stop loop does.

Three of them re-enter a turn the session already has:

- A **retry**: ACP still strips the failed attempt, and puts it back if the retry never sends. The first round is a `Retry` that carries the attempt's history identity and UserPromptSubmit's verdict from `admitUserPrompt`, so the hook still runs on a retry.
- A **continue** of an interrupted turn: ACP still strips the interrupted user run, or closes the interrupted calls. The first round is a `Retry` with the history identity and without UserPromptSubmit, as today. A first request that never goes out puts the interrupted run back as it was.
- The **restore** of an unanswered `ask_user_question`: ACP asks the question again with its own tool step. The answer goes out as the first round, a `Retry`, and later batches run on the shared batch.

A re-entered turn's first round is a `Retry` even when it carries tool results. A `ToolResult` does not start the client's interaction, so the previous prompt's loop-detector counts would carry over, and UserPromptSubmit would run on the results. The client adds no system reminders to a `Retry`, so ACP still adds its plan, arena and output-style reminders.

The restored question keeps ACP's tool step for now. The shared batch records every result, but a question left unanswered on a timeout must stay unrecorded so that a later load can ask it again.

Core changes:

- `SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` also covers a `Retry`, whose todo work chain the host started.
- `promptAdmission` is accepted on a `Retry`.
- New input `historyPromptId`: the history identity a `Retry`'s request carries. Its first request uses it up, so continuations do not carry it along.

With the setting on, these turns differ from today in the ways the design's Compatibility section lists:

- Channel and Goal-proposal turns get what any fresh prompt gets on the shared path, such as the date and system reminders and the client's recall.
- A retry, a continue and a restore start the client's interaction: the loop detector, exploration budget and turn budget start over. Their first round does not count toward the session turn cap.
- A continue whose first request never goes out puts the interrupted user run back as it was, instead of keeping one merged entry.

## Why it's needed

Only fresh prompts outside channels and Goal proposals used the shared loop. Retries, continues and restores still ran ACP's legacy send path, stop loop and tool step, and channel and Goal-proposal turns did too. Each of these copies would need every loop fix again.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Run `npm run bundle`, then `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`.
  - The new scenarios "a channel prompt that reads a file" and "a retry after a model error" must send the model the same requests with the setting off and on, and produce the same `session/update` notifications and stop reasons. The other scenarios must be unchanged.
- Unit tests:
  - `packages/core` `client.test.ts`:
    - an admission spent by a `Retry`;
    - a `Retry` marked with the identity the host gives it;
    - a retry's todo work chain left to the host.
  - `packages/cli` `Session.test.ts`:
    - a channel prompt on the shared round;
    - a Goal proposal kept from starting once the guard gave way;
    - retry and continue sent as a `Retry` with the stripped identity;
    - the stripped prompt put back once when the first request fails or is cancelled before it goes out;
    - a restored question answered by ACP's executor and sent as a `Retry`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A: the change is behind an off-by-default setting, and the parity suite compares both loops.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ⚠️   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

### Environment (optional)

Local results on Linux:

- ACP parity suite 21/21 and headless parity suite 12/12, from a fresh `npm run bundle`
- root `npm run typecheck` (all workspaces and `typecheck:integration`) passes
- core `client.test.ts` and `agent-loop.test.ts`: 627 passed
- cli `src/acp-integration/`: 3,154 passed; the one failure is `acp-output.test.ts`, a Node stream test this PR does not touch, which fails the same way without this PR
- eslint and prettier clean on the changed files

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: retries, continues and restores now take the client's per-interaction state, so their loop detector and budgets start over. The first round of a restore keeps ACP's executor until a later step teaches the shared batch to leave an unattended answer unrecorded. With the setting off, nothing changes.
- Not validated / out of scope: Goal turns (PR 2c-3), and cron and background-notification turns (PR 2c-4).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

Design: [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) and [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md). Both have the new PR 2c-2 section, the widened `userTurnRecordedByHost` row, `historyPromptId` among the inputs, the new ACP scenarios and the intended differences.

## Linked Issues

Part of #15327.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 这个 PR 做了什么

开启 `experimental.unifiedAgentLoop` 后，又有五类 ACP 轮次改为使用共享模型轮、共享工具批和 client 的 stop 点。这是 #15327 的 PR 2c-2。

其中两类是 PR 2a 没有纳入的全新 prompt：

- **channel prompt** 与其他全新 prompt 一样是 `UserQuery`。和现在一样，它不带 submitted prompt 和 workflow 输入，它的回复不会被排队的输入打断，它的工具结果从不结束这一轮，重复工具失败守卫保持关闭。
- **Goal 提案审批轮次**是 `UserQuery`。会话和现在一样结算提案。Todo Stop Guard 让位或 Stop hook 达到上限时，提案不会启动 Goal，这和会话自己的 Stop 循环一致。

另外三类重新进入会话中已有的轮次：

- **retry**：仍由 ACP 剥离失败的那次尝试，retry 一直没有发出时再把它放回。第一轮是 `Retry`，带上那次尝试的历史标识，以及 `admitUserPrompt` 给出的 UserPromptSubmit 结果，因此 retry 仍会运行这个 hook。
- **continue**（继续被打断的轮次）：仍由 ACP 剥离被打断的用户输入，或关闭被打断的调用。第一轮是 `Retry`，带历史标识，和现在一样不运行 UserPromptSubmit。第一条请求一直没有发出时，被打断的那段输入按原样放回。
- **restore**（恢复一个未回答的 `ask_user_question`）：ACP 用自己的工具步骤重新提问。回答作为第一轮发出，即一个 `Retry`，之后的批次使用共享工具批。

重新进入的轮次即使带着工具结果，第一轮也是 `Retry`。`ToolResult` 不会开启 client 的一次交互，上一个 prompt 的循环检测计数会延续下来，UserPromptSubmit 也会在这些结果上运行。client 不给 `Retry` 加系统提醒，所以 ACP 仍然加上 plan、arena 和 output-style 提醒。

被恢复的问题暂时保留 ACP 的工具步骤。共享工具批会记录每一个结果，而因超时没有回答的问题必须保持未记录，之后加载时才能再次提问。

core 的改动：

- `SendMessageOptions.userTurnRecordedByHost` 也覆盖 `Retry`，表示宿主已经启动了它的 todo 工作链。
- `Retry` 也接受 `promptAdmission`。
- 新增输入 `historyPromptId`：`Retry` 的请求在历史中带的标识。它由第一条请求用掉，续发不会带上它。

设置开启时，这些轮次与现在相比有以下差异，已写进设计文档的兼容性一节：

- channel 和 Goal 提案轮次在共享路径上得到与全新 prompt 相同的处理，例如日期提醒、系统提醒和 client 的召回。
- retry、continue 和 restore 会开启 client 的一次交互：循环检测器、探索预算和轮次预算重新开始。它们的第一轮不计入会话轮数上限。
- continue 的第一条请求一直没有发出时，被打断的用户输入按原样放回，而不是作为一条合并后的条目保留。

## 为什么需要

此前只有 channel 和 Goal 提案之外的全新 prompt 使用共享 loop。retry、continue 和 restore 仍走 ACP 旧的发送路径、Stop 循环和工具步骤，channel 和 Goal 提案轮次也一样。每一份副本都需要把 loop 的每个修复再做一遍。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

- 先执行 `npm run bundle`，再执行 `cd integration-tests && npx vitest run cli/acp-agent-loop-parity.test.ts`。
  - 新增的“读取文件的 channel prompt”和“模型报错之后的 retry”两个场景，在设置关闭和开启时发给模型的请求必须一致，`session/update` 通知和停止原因也必须一致。其余场景必须不变。
- 单元测试：
  - `packages/core` 的 `client.test.ts`：
    - 由 `Retry` 用掉的 admission；
    - 用宿主给出的标识标记 `Retry`；
    - retry 的 todo 工作链交给宿主。
  - `packages/cli` 的 `Session.test.ts`：
    - 共享模型轮上的 channel prompt；
    - guard 让位后提案不启动 Goal；
    - retry 和 continue 以带剥离标识的 `Retry` 发出；
    - 第一条请求在发出前失败或被取消时，剥离的 prompt 只放回一次；
    - 被恢复的问题由 ACP 的执行器回答后以 `Retry` 发出。

### 证据（前后对比）

不适用：改动在默认关闭的设置之后，对拍测试会比较两份 loop。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ⚠️  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

### 环境（可选）

Linux 本地结果：

- 从全新的 `npm run bundle` 开始：ACP 对拍 21/21，headless 对拍 12/12
- 根目录 `npm run typecheck`（所有 workspace 和 `typecheck:integration`）通过
- core 的 `client.test.ts` 和 `agent-loop.test.ts`：627 个通过
- cli `src/acp-integration/`：3,154 个通过；唯一的失败是 `acp-output.test.ts`，这是本 PR 没有改动的 Node 流测试，不带本 PR 的改动时也以同样方式失败
- 改动文件的 eslint 和 prettier 检查通过

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或权衡：retry、continue 和 restore 现在使用 client 的每次交互状态，因此它们的循环检测器和各项预算会重新开始。restore 的第一轮保留 ACP 的执行器，直到后续步骤让共享工具批能够不记录无人应答的回答。设置关闭时没有任何变化。
- 未验证 / 不在范围内：Goal 轮次（PR 2c-3），以及 cron 和后台通知轮次（PR 2c-4）。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无。

设计文档：[docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.md) 和 [docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md](docs/design/2026-10-23-unified-agent-loop.zh-CN.md)。两份都新增了 PR 2c-2 一节，扩大了 `userTurnRecordedByHost` 那一行的说明，把 `historyPromptId` 列入输入类选项，并补充了新的 ACP 场景和有意的差异。

## What this PR does

Separates instruction files from automatic memory in context usage. Project, user, extension and language instructions now appear under Instruction files, while automatic-memory policy and catalog snapshots appear under Auto memory. The API, SDK types, formatted output, terminal UIs and Web Shell expose the same split, including English and Chinese labels.

## Why it's needed

QWEN.md is an instruction file, but context usage previously grouped it with automatic memory. This made the memory category misleading even though instruction loading and managed-memory storage are already separate.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Open context details in a session with project instructions and auto memory. Confirm the instruction paths are listed only under Instruction files and automatic-memory content only under Auto memory.
- Compare summary and detail modes: category token counts must agree. Provider totals must remain unchanged, including when overhead needs scaling.
- Render an older saved context snapshot: its original Memory files label and details should still render without guessing ownership.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the global CLI grouped QWEN.md, output-language.md and auto memory under Memory files. After: the candidate separates the categories; focused tests cover accounting, transport, terminal projections, bilingual Web Shell rendering and legacy payloads. A separate E2E report is posted below.

Local validation passed: build, bundle, full typecheck, changed-file ESLint and formatting, and 1,077 distinct focused tests. Two self-audit passes and an independent read-only review found no defects. prs.title: fix(vscode): keep sibling model settings when writing provider config
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Configuring a Coding Plan or a model provider from the VS Code companion rewrote the entire `settings.model` object with only `name`, silently deleting everything else the CLI keeps there. This change writes `name` and its paired `baseUrl` key by key through the writer's existing nested-object helper, so the rest of the model section survives.

## Why it's needed

`model` carries 23 settings — reasoning effort, session turn and wall-time caps, goal budgets, loop protection, logging flags, generation config. A user who tuned any of them through the CLI and then signed in or edited providers in the panel lost all of them without warning. Losing `baseUrl` is the sharpest case: it is the disambiguator when several providers share a model id, so the next launch can resolve to the wrong provider.

The paired `baseUrl` is written, not merely preserved. The model resolver documents an invariant that every writer of `model.name` also writes `model.baseUrl` in the same scope — a real URL, or an empty-string tombstone when there is none — because an omitted key cannot override a stale value from a lower-priority scope on merge. The old wholesale replacement satisfied that by accident (it deleted the stale value too); a key-only fix would have kept the previous provider's URL and used it as the disambiguator for the new model. Both call sites already have the URL at hand: the Coding Plan template entry, or the provider map entry with the same fallback the sibling provider entry uses.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start from a settings file whose `model` is `{ name, baseUrl, reasoningEffort, maxSessionTurns }`, then configure a Coding Plan and then an api-key provider from the panel. Expected: only `name` and `baseUrl` change; `reasoningEffort` and `maxSessionTurns` are still present, and `baseUrl` matches the provider entry just written. Before the fix, `model` is reduced to `{ name }`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A for screenshots — settings-file behavior is covered by unit tests. The new cases `preserves sibling model settings when writing a Coding Plan` and `preserves sibling model settings when writing api-key providers` fail on the pre-fix code (sibling keys dropped) and pass after; the existing api-key assertion was updated to expect the paired `baseUrl`.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   ⚠️   |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ✅   |

Linux was verified in a `node:22-bookworm` container: full companion suite, 46 files / 663 passed / 1 skipped.

### Environment (optional)

Unit tests only: `npx vitest run` in the companion package, plus Docker for the Linux run.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk: the panel now writes `model.baseUrl` where it previously wrote nothing. When the active model is missing from the provider map the value falls back to the same default the provider entry receives, so the pair stays consistent.
- Not validated / out of scope: VS Code panel end-to-end and Windows.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; the change only stops deleting existing keys.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15822

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 做了什么

从 VS Code 插件面板配置 Coding Plan 或模型 provider 时，`settings.model` 会被整体重写为只剩 `name`，CLI 存在这里的其他配置会被静默删除。本次改为通过该文件已有的嵌套对象辅助函数逐键写入 `name` 和配对的 `baseUrl`，`model` 下的其余设置得以保留。

## 为什么需要

`model` 下有 23 项设置：reasoningEffort、会话轮次与墙钟上限、goal 预算、循环保护、日志开关、generationConfig 等。用户用 CLI 调好这些之后，只要在面板里登录或改一次 provider，就会在无提示的情况下全部丢失。`baseUrl` 是最尖锐的一例：同名模型来自多个 provider 时，它是消歧符，丢了之后下次启动可能解析到错误的 provider。

配对的 `baseUrl` 是「写入」而不只是「保留」。模型解析器依赖一条已写明的不变量：每个写 `model.name` 的地方都要在同一 scope 写 `model.baseUrl` —— 真实 URL，或者没有时写空串墓碑 —— 因为缺失的键在合并时无法覆盖低优先级 scope 里的过期值。原先的整体替换是碰巧满足了它（过期值一起被删掉）；只保留兄弟键的修法会把上一个 provider 的 URL 留下来，并把它当作新模型的消歧符。两个调用点手上都已有该 URL：Coding Plan 模板条目，或 provider map 条目（兜底与相邻 provider 条目一致）。

## 评审测试计划

### 如何验证

用一份 `model` 为 `{ name, baseUrl, reasoningEffort, maxSessionTurns }` 的 settings 起步，先在面板配置 Coding Plan，再配置 api-key provider。预期：只有 `name` 与 `baseUrl` 变化，`reasoningEffort`、`maxSessionTurns` 仍在，且 `baseUrl` 与刚写入的 provider 条目一致。修复前 `model` 会被压成 `{ name }`。

### 证据（Before & After）

截图 N/A —— 这是 settings 文件行为，由单测覆盖。新增用例 `preserves sibling model settings when writing a Coding Plan` 与 `preserves sibling model settings when writing api-key providers` 在修复前失败（兄弟键被删），修复后通过；既有 api-key 断言已更新为包含配对的 `baseUrl`。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :--: |
|  🍏 macOS  |  ✅  |
| 🪟 Windows |  ⚠️  |
|  🐧 Linux  |  ✅  |

Linux 在 `node:22-bookworm` 容器中验证：插件整包测试 46 文件 / 663 通过 / 1 skipped。

### 环境（可选）

仅单元测试：在插件包内跑 `npx vitest run`，Linux 用 Docker 运行。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险：面板现在会写 `model.baseUrl`，而之前什么都不写。当 active model 不在 provider map 中时，取值兜底为 provider 条目收到的同一默认值，保证两者一致。
- 未验证 / 范围外：VS Code 面板端到端、Windows。
- 破坏性变更 / 迁移说明：无，改动只是不再删除既有键。

## 关联 issue

Fixes #15822

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): isolate web-shell smoke from shared runner networks
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Runs Web Shell browser smoke on `ubuntu-latest` for every admitted run, independently of the shared Linux runner fleet. Updates the existing routing guards and workflow size baseline to match.

## Why it's needed

The [smoke job on #15060](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40915920935/job/123596230356) ran on `ecs-qwen-hz2-3` with `self-hosted, linux, arm64` labels. It finished with 404 passed, 4 flaky and 3 failed. All nine failure snapshots across the three failed mobile cases and their retries show the startup resource-load fallback, before their intended behavior was exercised. The three retained retry traces contain 57, 69 and 194 `net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED` console errors on module requests.

Moving this gate off the shared pool removes its exposure to other jobs' host network changes. The exact process that triggered the network notifications is not established; this is runner isolation, not a claim that every possible browser network failure is fixed. Increasing timeouts or retry counts would leave that exposure in place.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm that browser smoke selects `ubuntu-latest` regardless of the classifier's fleet choice, author association or dispatch override. Other lanes should retain their existing routing. The browser assertions, two-worker limit, retry counts, job timeout, install timeout and artifact upload behavior should remain unchanged. A CI smoke run on the hosted runner should load the application and exercise the mobile cases rather than stop at the startup fallback.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the linked job and its `web-shell-e2e-smoke` artifact contain the network-change errors and startup failures described above. After: the routing change has been statically reviewed; runtime recovery is not yet verified.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | Static source/diff review and `git diff --check` only; no tests |
| Windows | Not tested |
| Linux | Existing failed CI artifacts inspected; updated routing not run locally |

No local tests, builds, lint, typecheck or dependency installation were run, as requested. The existing workflow tests were updated but not executed. CI is not awaited.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: uses GitHub-hosted capacity and cold browser installations; smoke moves from ARM64 to the hosted x64 environment. Other jobs keep their fleet selection.
- Not validated / out of scope: the specific host network-change trigger and runtime recovery. Existing conditionally skipped pool setup steps remain for a small, reversible routing change.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no product behavior or public API changes.

## Linked Issues

Related closeout work: #15060, #15274, #15286. This is an independent CI mitigation; it does not close their source issues.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 改动

所有满足运行条件的 Web Shell browser smoke 固定使用 `ubuntu-latest`，不再随共享 Linux runner 池路由。同步更新现有路由断言和 workflow 大小基线。

## 原因

[#15060 的 smoke job](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40915920935/job/123596230356) 运行在标签为 `self-hosted, linux, arm64` 的 `ecs-qwen-hz2-3`，结果为 404 passed、4 flaky、3 failed。三个失败的移动端用例及其重试共九份失败快照均停在启动资源加载失败页面，尚未执行目标行为。三份保留的重试 trace 分别记录了 57、69、194 条模块请求的 `net::ERR_NETWORK_CHANGED` 错误。

将这一通道移出共享池，可以隔离其他 job 的宿主网络变化。具体触发网络通知的进程尚未确认；这是 runner 隔离措施，不代表所有浏览器网络失败都已修复。增加超时或重试次数无法消除这种共享环境暴露。

## 评审验证计划

确认无论 classifier 的 fleet、作者关联或 dispatch override 如何，browser smoke 都选择 `ubuntu-latest`，其他通道路由保持原样。浏览器断言、两个 worker 的限制、重试次数、job 超时、安装超时和产物上传行为均应保持原样。hosted runner 上的 CI smoke 应加载应用并实际执行移动端用例，而非停在启动失败页面。

## 前后证据

改动前：上述 job 及其 `web-shell-e2e-smoke` 产物包含网络变化错误和启动失败。改动后：已完成静态审查，尚未验证运行恢复。

## 验证环境

| OS | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | 仅源码/diff 静态审查及 `git diff --check`，未跑测试 |
| Windows | 未验证 |
| Linux | 读取已有失败 CI 产物，未在本地运行新路由 |

按用户要求，未运行本地测试、构建、lint、typecheck 或依赖安装。现有 workflow 测试已更新但未执行，不等待 CI。

## 风险和范围

- 代价：占用 GitHub hosted 容量并冷安装浏览器；smoke 从 ARM64 切换到 hosted x64 环境。其他 job 保持原 fleet 选择。

- 无产品行为或公共 API 变更。

关联推进：#15060、#15274、#15286。这是独立 CI 缓解措施，不关闭它们对应的原始 issue。

prs.title: fix(core): read managed session metadata past a torn transcript line
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Read managed-session metadata with the tolerant parser already used by the legacy readers. Scan records in reverse order within a glued line, match the requested domain marker on each parsed record, and preserve the commit sequence bounds.

## Why it's needed

A torn or glued transcript line can hide a committed rename and its source, leaving the session unnamed or showing an agent session in the user's list. The managed writer does not create this corruption; this follows the legacy reader's tolerance for external damage. Three glued records also exposed a marker belonging to another domain, which could return an unrelated record.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

From `packages/core`, run `pnpm exec vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-session-metadata.test.ts`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

At `fcda26260e`, with main `415925cbdab` merged: the 43-test metadata suite passed five consecutive rounds. Core/dependency builds, core typecheck, and scoped ESLint/Prettier passed under Node 22.23.3 with frozen pnpm 11.24.0 dependencies.

The verifier reported 15-second timeouts in the two long-log fixtures ([verification report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13035#issuecomment-6172323230)). They now use one batch of 16 schema-valid message deltas plus three real metadata commits, rather than 64 separate metadata commits per case. Both still exceed the 64 KiB window. Dropping tail results makes both fail against the older head title; restoring bare JSON parsing makes the glued-tail case fail. Source was restored byte-for-byte and both passed again. Local timing improved from 940/983 ms in one old-fixture run to 175/158 ms in the fifth full round; these macOS timings do not prove the shared Linux runner is stable.

Earlier record-level-marker and sequence-bound mutation evidence remains in the thread. The broader 3338-test run was not repeated for this merge.

### Tested on

macOS. Windows and Linux were not tested locally.

### Environment (optional)

Frozen pnpm dependencies with the repository's Ink patch; local temporary transcripts and resources, no external service.

## Risk & Scope

The production reader patch is unchanged from `e9fd45986b`; this update merges main and reduces test fixture I/O. The ordinary tail case must find the previous committed title in the tail; the glued case must find the latest one there, so a head fallback cannot satisfy either witness. Commit authority and both sequence bounds remain enforced. An unreadable domain body retains its catch path. No API migration.

Not validated locally: full preflight, Windows/Linux, the shared Linux flakiness gate, or the shipped TUI/serve/CLI session list. @wenshao's earlier real-environment checks are separate evidence.

## Linked Issues

Related corruption shape: #3606. This change covers the managed metadata reader, not every transcript consumer.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

使用旧版读取器已有的容错解析器读取 managed 会话元数据；在粘连行内倒序扫描记录，按单条记录匹配域 marker，并保留提交序号窗口的上下界。

## 为什么需要

撕裂或粘连的转录行可能隐藏已提交的改名和来源，使会话无标题，或让 agent 会话出现在用户列表中。managed writer 本身不会制造这种损坏，此处沿用旧版读取器对外部损坏的容错。三记录粘连还暴露出同一行上另一个域的 marker 可能让读取器返回无关记录。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

从 `packages/core` 运行 `pnpm exec vitest run src/managed-runtime/managed-session-metadata.test.ts`。

### 前后证据

在 `fcda26260e`（合入 main `415925cbdab`）上，43项元数据测试连续五轮通过；core及依赖构建、core类型检查和相关 ESLint/Prettier 通过。环境为 Node 22.23.3 和冻结的 pnpm 11.24.0 依赖。

验证器报告两个长日志夹具有15秒超时（[verification report](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/pull/13035#issuecomment-6172323230)）。现在每例用一次批量提交写入16条符合 schema 的 message delta，再提交三条真实元数据，替代原来的64次独立元数据提交。文件仍超过64 KiB窗口。丢弃尾部结果会让两例错误返回头部旧标题而失败；恢复裸 JSON 解析会让粘连尾窗用例失败。生产源码按字节恢复后，两例再次通过。一次旧夹具运行耗时940/983毫秒，第五轮完整测试为175/158毫秒；这些macOS时间不能证明共享Linux runner已稳定。

此前针对单记录 marker 和序号边界的变异证据保留在线程中；本次合 main 未重跑更广的3338项测试。

### 已测试平台

macOS；未在本地测试 Windows 或 Linux。

### 环境

冻结的 pnpm 依赖和仓库 Ink 补丁；使用本地临时转录及资源，不依赖外部服务。

## 风险与范围

生产读取器补丁与 `e9fd45986b` 相同；此次只合 main 并减少测试夹具的I/O。普通尾窗用例须在尾部找到前一条已提交标题，粘连用例须在尾部找到最新标题，头部回退都不能满足断言。提交权限及序号上下界仍受校验；无法读取的域内容沿用原有 catch 路径。没有 API 迁移。

本地未验证完整 preflight、Windows/Linux、共享Linux抖动门或发布应用的 TUI/serve/CLI 会话列表。@wenshao 早期的真实环境检查是独立证据。

## 关联 issue

相关损坏形状：#3606。此次覆盖 managed 元数据读取器，未覆盖所有转录消费者。

</details>

prs.title: fix(web-shell): align no-workspace category header with peers
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Aligns the active No-workspace sessions category with Pinned, Workspaces, and Recent: the same header height, muted text, collapsed spacing, trailing expansion chevron, and hover/focus reveal behavior. The leading dashed-circle workspace icon is removed. Archived settings keeps its existing presentation, and the category retains its collapse persistence, search, creation, and session actions.

## Why it's needed

No-workspace sessions became a peer category but retained its individual-workspace header. Its 29.5px height, extra 12px bottom margin, leading icon, and missing trailing chevron gave it a different visual hierarchy from the 32px peer headers.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Show Pinned, Workspaces, No-workspace sessions, and Recent. Collapse all four: their heights, label alignment, text color, and spacing should match.
2. Hover or keyboard-focus No-workspace sessions: its trailing chevron and New session action should follow the same reveal rules as Workspaces and Recent. Enter and Space should toggle the category and update the chevron direction.
3. Reload after collapsing No-workspace sessions, then search for a session. The collapse preference should persist, search should reveal matching rows without overwriting it, and opening/creating sessions should retain their existing routing.
4. Check Archived settings: its no-workspace header should retain the dashed-circle workspace-entry presentation.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: the no-workspace header measured 29.5px with a 12px bottom margin, a leading dashed circle, and no trailing chevron. After: it uses the peer category's 32px header with no collapsed section margin and a trailing direction indicator. Browser evidence uses simulated daemon responses, not model traffic.

| Before | After |
| --- | --- |
| ![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/codex/sidebar-category-header/docs/assets/sidebar-category-header-before.png) | ![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/codex/sidebar-category-header/docs/assets/sidebar-category-header-after.png) |

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| 🍏 macOS | Chromium verification |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested |
| 🐧 Linux | Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

macOS, Node.js 24.14.1, Chromium, simulated daemon APIs. Global Qwen 0.26.3 and unchanged source were used for baseline reproduction. Full repository build, typecheck, and bundle passed; 130 targeted component tests and all eight standalone browser tests passed, including geometry, hover/focus, keyboard toggle, persistence/search, and session routing. Changed-file lint and formatting passed; two self-audit passes and independent review found no actionable defects. Full repository test/preflight suites were not run.

The bundled CLI now serves the fixed Web Shell successfully. Independent Chromium verification confirms the 32px header, zero collapsed section margin, trailing chevron direction, hover/focus reveal, Enter/Space toggling, independent collapse across reload, and matching search results without overwriting the saved preference; before/after screenshots are included above. Earlier approval-service capacity failures were resolved before submission.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the active header adopts the existing opacity-based action reveal rules, so browser automation must scope New session buttons to their intended row rather than count all accessible buttons.
- Not validated / out of scope: real model traffic and Windows/Linux browsers. No changes to archived presentation, daemon ownership, session membership, capability restrictions, or category names/order.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #15867.

## 风险与范围

prs.title: fix(acp-bridge): display declared Channel submissions
prs.body:
## What this PR does

For Channel-source sessions, use a nonblank original-text declaration as the display projection when the request has a text block and the turn has no channel-worker classification or worker display projection. Pending text, live user echoes, and durable recording use the original declaration verbatim, while the model still receives the complete prepared prompt.

Missing, invalid, empty, whitespace-only, and media-only submissions retain their content-derived display. An explicit worker projection keeps precedence, including an intentionally empty projection paired with a declaration. Add regression coverage for these boundaries and synchronize the [English design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md) and [Chinese design contract](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md).

## Why it's needed

An external Channel gateway can submit model text such as `gateway instructions\nhello` and separately declare the original user text `hello` through the existing non-privileged `qwen.submittedPrompt` contract. The declaration reaches the bridge, but the user echo and transcript display the prepared wrapper. This change displays `hello` consistently without removing the instructions from model input or granting worker authority.

The declaration is a display contract, not authentication or proof of authorship. Native authenticated channel-worker history behavior and Qwen product wording remain unchanged.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

1. Submit a prepared text prompt to a Channel-source session with a nonblank original-text declaration and no worker keys. Pending text and live user echo should match the raw declaration, including surrounding whitespace. The complete prepared prompt should still reach the model.
2. Complete the turn, stop the daemon, start a new process with the same isolated runtime, and load the session. Both load replay and transcript paging should show the declaration; persisted model content should retain the prepared text.
3. Omit the declaration or supply an invalid type, empty string, or whitespace-only string. Display should retain the prepared text. For an image-only request with a nonblank declaration, pending text should stay `[image]`, the echo should contain only the image, and private display metadata should be absent. Ordinary-source sessions should keep their original display.
4. Confirm caller-supplied private display metadata cannot select this fallback and worker-classified turns cannot acquire a declaration-based projection. An explicit worker projection should win over a declaration; an empty worker projection must still hide every text block and forward `''`.
5. Set a one-tool-call cap and use a controlled model to request another tool call from an ordinary declared Channel turn. Expect `turn_error` with `LOOP_DETECTED`, `errorKind: loop_detected`, and `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`.

### Evidence (Before & After)

The review baseline reproduced three display regressions: an empty declaration erased the live echo and durable user display while the turn-result record retained the wrapper; whitespace-only declarations replaced the display with blank space; a media-only declaration changed pending/child display metadata without adding a live text echo.

After the correction, all ten bridge cases pass. Six real daemon text cases pass live pending/echo, durable user/turn-result recording, and cold-process load plus transcript replay: 18 assertions. A separate real loop-cap assertion also passes, for 19 daemon assertions total. Every complete prepared text was observed in the mock model request and persisted intact. The worker-empty-projection control passes normally and fails an actually executed isolated `??` to `||` mutation.

Local quality checks passed: all 2,639 ACP Bridge package tests, repository typecheck, changed-file lint and Prettier checks, build, and bundle. Independent read-only review found no actionable issue. Test reports and artifact fingerprints are retained locally under `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` and `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`; these ignored artifacts are not included in the PR. This is protocol/recording evidence, not a browser screenshot or deployed gateway acceptance.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ Local quality checks and real daemon with a mock model |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1, pinned pnpm 11.24.0, and the rebuilt `node dist/cli.js`. The runtime test used synthetic prompts, isolated workspace/home/runtime directories, port-0 listeners, and a local mock OpenAI endpoint. The global `qwen` command was unavailable, so verification used the local bundle. Both daemon processes and the mock endpoint were stopped. CI for the newly pushed source revision must complete separately; earlier revisions do not validate this update.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: an eligible Channel caller can choose the declared display text; that text does not authenticate the caller or prove human authorship. The model still sees the full prepared prompt.
- Not validated / out of scope: external gateway integration, real provider behavior, browser rendering, historical record rewriting, and deployment. Preexisting submission-provenance forwarding remains unchanged; Session already omits blank provenance.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no new API or privileged flag. Gateway producers must explicitly declare nonblank original text beside a text-bearing prompt and omit worker classification, authorization, and private display keys to use the existing non-privileged route.

## Linked Issues

Fixes #13747.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 此 PR 的改动

对于 Channel 来源会话，当请求包含文本块、当前回合没有 channel-worker 分类或 worker 显示投影时，将非空白原文声明用于显示投影。排队文本、实时用户回显和持久录制完整保留该声明，模型仍收到完整准备后的 prompt。

缺失、非法、空串、纯空白声明及纯附件提交继续从内容取得显示文本。显式 worker 投影保持优先，包括刻意为空的投影与声明同时存在的情况。补充这些边界的回归覆盖，并同步[英文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.md)和[中文设计契约](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/channel-submitted-display/docs/design/daemon-user-prompt-submit-provenance.zh-CN.md)。

## 为什么需要

外部 Channel 网关可提交 `gateway instructions\nhello` 这样的模型文本，并通过既有非特权 `qwen.submittedPrompt` 契约单独声明用户原文 `hello`。声明已经到达 bridge，但用户回显和记录仍显示准备后的包装文本。本改动将展示统一为 `hello`，同时保留交给模型的指令，也不授予 worker 权限。

声明属于展示契约，不是认证，也不证明作者身份。原生授权 channel-worker 的历史展示行为和 Qwen 产品文案保持不变。

## 评审验收计划

### 如何验证

1. 向 Channel 来源会话提交准备后的文本 prompt 与非空白原文声明，省略所有 worker 键。排队文本和实时用户回显应完整保留声明及其空白，模型仍应收到完整准备后的 prompt。
2. 完成回合后退出 daemon，以相同隔离 runtime 启动新进程并加载会话。load 重放与 transcript 分页都应显示声明，持久模型内容仍应保留准备后的文本。
3. 省略声明，或提供非法类型、空串、纯空白字符串，显示应保留准备后的文本。纯图片请求即使带有非空白声明，排队文本仍应为 `[image]`，回显只包含图片，且不附加私有显示元数据。普通来源会话保留原有展示。
4. 确认调用方自报的私有显示字段不能选择此回退，已分类的 worker 回合也不能取得声明投影。显式 worker 投影应优先于声明；空 worker 投影仍须隐藏所有文本块，并转发 `''`。
5. 设置单回合工具调用上限为一次，让受控模型在普通声明 Channel 回合继续请求工具调用。预期收到 `turn_error`，包含 `LOOP_DETECTED`、`errorKind: loop_detected` 和 `loopType: turn_tool_call_cap`。

### 证据（修改前后）

评审基线复现了三项展示回归：空声明隐藏实时回显和持久用户展示，但回合结果记录仍保留包装文本；纯空白声明将展示替换为空白；纯附件声明改变排队项和子进程显示元数据，却没有增加实时文本回显。

修正后，十项 bridge 场景全部通过。六项真实 daemon 文本场景通过实时排队与回显、持久用户与回合结果录制、冷进程 load 与 transcript 重放，共十八项断言；独立执行的真实工具调用上限断言也通过，daemon 共十九项断言。模拟模型实际请求和持久记录都完整保留了准备后的文本。空 worker 投影控制用例正常通过，实际执行隔离的 `??` 改为 `||` 变异后则失败。

本地质量检查通过：ACP Bridge 包全部 2,639 项测试、仓库类型检查、改动文件 lint 与 Prettier 检查、构建及打包。独立只读评审未发现可行动问题。测试报告及制品指纹保留在本地 `.qwen/e2e-tests/pr-13748-*` 和 `.qwen/issues/pr-13748-review.md`，这些被忽略的制品不包含在 PR 中。上述属于协议与录制证据，不代表浏览器截图或已部署网关验收。

### 已验证平台

| 平台 | 状态 |
| :---: | :--- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ 本地质量检查与使用模拟模型的真实 daemon 验证 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未执行本地验证 |

### 环境

Node 22.23.1、固定版本 pnpm 11.24.0，以及重新构建的 `node dist/cli.js`。运行时测试使用合成消息、隔离的 workspace/home/runtime 目录、自动分配端口的监听及本地模拟 OpenAI 服务。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，因此使用本地 bundle 验证。两个 daemon 进程和模拟服务均已停止。新推送 source revision 的 CI 须单独完成，旧 revision 的结果不能验证本次更新。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：符合条件的 Channel 调用方可选择声明的显示文本；该文本不认证调用方，也不证明内容由人撰写。模型仍会收到完整准备后的 prompt。
- 未验证或不在范围内：外部网关集成、真实 provider 行为、浏览器渲染、历史记录改写及部署。已有提交来源转发保持不变，Session 已经会省略空白来源。
- 兼容性与迁移：不新增 API 或特权标记。网关生产方须在包含文本的 prompt 之外显式声明非空白原文，并省略 worker 分类、授权和私有显示键，才能使用既有非特权路由。

## 关联 Issue

Fixes #13747。

</details>

prs.body:
## What this PR does

Archived conversations in Settings now show Export conversation and Restore as inline actions beside More. Hover or keyboard focus reveals the controls on desktop; touch devices show them directly. More retains Rename and Delete and disappears when neither is available. The action area reserves space for the actual number of available buttons.

## Why it's needed

Exporting and restoring are frequent actions within archive management, but both were hidden behind More. Making them visible on the row reduces an extra click and helps users discover what they can do with archived conversations.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Open Settings → Archived conversations and hover a local workspace or no-workspace session. Expect Export conversation and Restore beside More, with translated tooltips. Tab through the controls and verify they remain visible while focused. On a touch device, expect them to be available without hovering.
- Export a conversation and restore another. Expect the existing export download and restore behavior for the owning session/workspace. More should contain only the available Rename and Delete actions.
- Check rows with restricted actions or unavailable export capability. Expect only permitted controls, no empty More menu, and enough space for the buttons that are actually shown. Standard session rows should retain their existing inline configuration.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Before: Export and Restore are inside the archived row's More menu. After: they are direct row actions. Captures use synthetic archive fixtures.

![Before](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/codex/archived-session-inline-actions/docs/design/images/archived-session-inline-before.png)

![After](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/codex/archived-session-inline-actions/docs/design/images/archived-session-inline-after.png)

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| macOS | ✅ Local build, component tests, Chromium desktop and touch emulation |
| Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment (optional)

Build, typecheck, bundle, strict lint and the serve fast-path bundle check passed. All 298 focused component tests and all 8 archived-settings browser tests passed. The full Web Shell suite ran 13,921 tests: 13,888 passed, while 33 build-artifact assertions failed because their inputs were being rebuilt concurrently. After rebuilding finished, all 40 build-artifact tests passed in an isolated rerun; no other Web Shell tests failed. Browser tests use a built CLI and synthetic daemon responses; they validate UI behavior and request routing rather than live archive persistence.

Full preflight did not pass: clean install, formatting, lint, build and typecheck succeeded, but the unchanged CLI suites reported 24 failures across model configuration, review tooling, standalone updates and workspace skill management before the run was stopped. Both model-configuration message failures reproduced on the unchanged base commit. The other failures were not individually baseline-verified, and the remaining full-workspace/script checks did not complete. These failures are recorded rather than treated as green or expanded into this UI PR.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: Restore becomes easier to activate; existing action restrictions and disabled states remain in place.
- Not validated / out of scope: live daemon archive persistence, real mobile hardware, and the separate managed-agent archive interface.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Existing callbacks, routes, storage and standard-row inline configuration are preserved.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/archived-session-inline-actions/docs/design/archived-session-inline-actions.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/archived-session-inline-actions/docs/design/archived-session-inline-actions.zh-CN.md).

## Linked Issues

Closes #15866.

prs.title: feat(skills): add native ZIP installation with result receipts
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds native Skill ZIP installation from a browser upload or a `zip-file` already on the daemon host. The new sources accept up to 50 MiB compressed, 200 MiB extracted, 4096 ZIP entries and a 32 MiB root manifest. Existing base64, directory and GitHub limits remain unchanged.

The daemon streams to an owned temporary archive, shares the existing install/delete lock, supports cancellation before publication, and completes commit or rollback once publication is admitted. Owner-scoped attempt receipts distinguish committed, not committed and recovery-required outcomes after a lost response. The SDK preserves the attempt ID on errors; Web Shell sends File/Blob directly, checks ambiguous outcomes without retransmitting, and reports activation failures separately from installation success. Older daemons retain the base64 path and show an upgrade hint before sending an oversized archive.

## Why it's needed

A real 20 MiB ZIP exceeds the existing 10 MiB JSON request limit after base64 encoding. Native transport removes that overhead, while a daemon-local file source avoids retransmitting an archive that is already on the host. A bounded receipt contract makes cancellation and timeout outcomes explicit without introducing background jobs or persistent transactions.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

- Upload a real 20 MiB ZIP through the browser and install the same content from a daemon-local ZIP into a secondary workspace. Both should install byte-identical files in the selected scope, return a matching archive digest, and preserve the caller's original file.
- Cancel while receiving or waiting behind another installation. Check the receipt; cancellation before publication should leave the previous installation intact, and later waiters must retain their order. A cancellation after publication admission may still result in a committed receipt.
- Disconnect after sending an installation and check the result. The UI should query independently, offer a manual check if still running or unknown, and never automatically resend. A runtime activation failure should leave an installed-success notice with a separate warning.
- Verify native size/layout boundaries, duplicate attempt rejection, owner isolation and recovery-backup preservation. Existing base64/folder/GitHub behavior and ordinary workspace file writes should retain their limits and serialization.
- Connect the new UI to an older daemon: a small ZIP should still install through base64, while a 20 MiB ZIP should show upgrade guidance before any install request.

### Evidence (Before & After)

| Scenario | Before: unmodified main | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Real 20 MiB ZIP | Base64 JSON returns 413; native routes/sources unavailable | Raw and host-file installation return 200; installed bytes and archive digests match |
| Browser cancellation | No native receipt flow | One install POST; automatic receipt lookup, then manual check; cancellation confirmed without retransmission |
| Two simultaneous 200 MiB expanded packages | Exceed legacy package limits | Both install correctly; a third active archive request returns 429 |
| Older daemon | Small base64 ZIP supported | Support retained; oversized native requirement explained before upload |

Root build, typecheck and bundle passed. Focused CLI, SDK and Web Shell tests cover the new contracts and existing shared consumers. Independent real HTTP and Chromium acceptance used isolated daemons; the detailed E2E report is posted separately.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ macOS 26.6.2 arm64; Chromium 149.0.7827.55 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ Not tested locally |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ Not tested locally |

### Environment

Local bundle on Node.js 26.7.0, isolated homes/workspaces, real HTTP and browser requests. No provider credentials or model calls were needed for installation acceptance.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: cross-package lifecycle and cancellation changes need maintainer review. Borrowed ZIPs are copied once; callers must keep them stable during copying, and can provide an expected SHA-256. Metadata checks are not an atomic snapshot. The ZIP dependency is updated to the repository's existing 3.4 version after reproducing a file-stream hang in 2.10.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux/Windows execution, cross-process serialization, resumable uploads, automatic retry, persistent receipts and restart recovery. Receipts are process-local and retained for ten minutes after completion. The final short HTTP smoke encountered an ACP-preheat shutdown error during teardown; no test process remained. The local `/review` command could not run because Qwen authentication was not configured; two self-audit passes completed, the repository bot findings are tracked in the follow-up verification report, and maintainer approval remains required.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: no change to legacy source limits or the JSON body limit. New file sources are confined to modern config routes. All sources, including legacy sources, preserve leftover backups for recovery; successful installations still clean their own backups. Expiring process-local receipts cannot safely identify disposable backups after a restart.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md). Both versions describe the same decisions, constraints and acceptance criteria.

## Linked Issues

Follow-up to #15030.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

增加浏览器原生 ZIP 上传和 daemon 主机已有 `zip-file` 两种 Skill 安装入口。新来源支持压缩 50 MiB、展开 200 MiB、4096 个 ZIP 条目和 32 MiB 根 manifest；原有 base64、目录及 GitHub 来源限额保持不变。

daemon 流式生成自有临时归档，复用现有安装/删除锁，支持发布前取消；一旦获准发布，就完成提交或回滚。按所有者隔离的尝试回执可在响应丢失后区分已提交、未提交和需要恢复。SDK 在错误中保留尝试 ID；Web Shell 直接发送 File/Blob，对不确定结果只查询、不自动重传，并将激活失败与安装成功分别展示。旧 daemon 继续走 base64 路径，大文件在发送前提示升级。

## 为什么需要

真实 20 MiB ZIP 经 base64 编码后超过现有 10 MiB JSON 请求限制。原生传输消除编码开销；本地文件来源避免重新传输已位于 daemon 主机的归档。有界回执让取消、超时后的结果可确认，不引入后台任务或持久化事务。

## 审查验证计划

### 如何验证

- 在浏览器上传真实 20 MiB ZIP，并将同样内容通过主机文件来源安装到 secondary workspace。两者都应安装到对应 scope，内容逐字节一致、归档摘要匹配，且保留调用方原文件。
- 在接收中或等待另一个安装释放锁时取消，然后查询回执。发布前取消应保留此前安装；后续等待者顺序不变。发布准入后的取消可能仍返回已提交回执。
- 发出安装后断连并检查结果。UI 应使用独立请求查询，仍在进行或未知时提供手动检查，绝不自动重传。运行时激活失败应保留安装成功提示并显示独立警告。
- 检查新来源大小与布局边界、重复尝试拒绝、所有者隔离和恢复备份保留。旧 base64/目录/GitHub 行为以及普通 workspace 文件写入应保持原有限额及串行语义。
- 用新 UI 连接旧 daemon：小 ZIP 仍通过 base64 安装，20 MiB ZIP 在发起安装请求前提示升级。

### 前后对比证据

| 场景 | 改动前：未修改的 main | 改动后 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 真实 20 MiB ZIP | Base64 JSON 返回 413，原生路由/来源不可用 | Raw 和主机文件来源返回 200，安装内容及归档摘要一致 |
| 浏览器取消 | 没有原生回执流程 | 仅一次安装 POST，自动查询后可手动检查，无重传并确认取消 |
| 两个并发的 200 MiB 展开包 | 超过旧包限额 | 两个均正确安装，第三个活跃归档请求返回 429 |
| 旧 daemon | 支持小型 base64 ZIP | 保持兼容，上传前说明大文件所需升级 |

根目录 build、typecheck、bundle 通过。CLI、SDK、Web Shell 的 focused tests 覆盖新契约及已有共享消费者。独立真实 HTTP 和 Chromium 验收使用隔离 daemon，详细 E2E 报告另发评论。

### 测试平台

| 系统 | 状态 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 🍏 macOS | ✅ macOS 26.6.2 arm64；Chromium 149.0.7827.55 |
| 🪟 Windows | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |
| 🐧 Linux | ⚠️ 未在本地验证 |

### 环境

Node.js 26.7.0 上的本地 bundle，独立 home/workspace，真实 HTTP 和浏览器请求。安装验收不需要模型服务凭证或模型调用。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：跨包生命周期及取消改动需要维护者审查。借用 ZIP 复制一次；调用方须在复制期间保持来源稳定，并可提供预期 SHA-256。元数据检查不等于原子快照。复现 2.10 的文件流挂起后，将 ZIP 依赖升级到仓库已有的 3.4 版本。
- 未验证或不在范围内：Linux/Windows 执行、跨进程串行化、断点续传、自动重试、持久化回执和重启恢复。回执仅在当前进程内保存，工作结束后保留十分钟。最后一次短 HTTP smoke 在清理时遇到 ACP 预热关闭错误，已确认无测试进程残留。本地 `/review` 因未配置 Qwen 认证而未能运行；已完成两轮自审，仓库机器人的意见已记录在后续验证报告中，仍需维护者审批。
- 兼容与迁移：旧来源限额和 JSON 请求上限保持不变。新文件来源仅支持现代 config 路由。所有来源（包括旧来源）都保留遗留备份以便恢复；成功安装仍清理自己创建的备份。进程内回执会过期，重启后也无法据此安全判断哪些备份可删除。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/skill-install-redesign/docs/design/2026-10-29-skill-archive-installation.zh-CN.md)。两份文档包含相同决策、约束及验收标准。

## 关联

基于 #15030 的后续增强。

</details>

prs.title: test(cli): cover row budget wiring, selection reclamp, and multi-option layout (#15819)
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds regression coverage for the provider dialog's constrained height, scroll-window reclamping after the available height grows, and keeping another fitting option visible. This covers R1-7, R2-2 and R2-3 from #15819. The maintenance also integrates current main while preserving its queued provider-update prompt test.

## Why it's needed

The previous navigation assertions guessed which labels were visible and also ran inside an input-reliability guard that skips them on Windows and in CI. They could neither demonstrate CI coverage nor reliably describe the current scroll window. Those assertions are removed. The option-visibility regression now runs in the existing render-only budget suite, and the dialog-manager fixture uses local actions without changing the shared helper. The resize test also retains the same provider tree during rerender, so it exercises an update of the mounted component rather than passing after a remount.

## Reviewer Test Plan

Confirm that a constrained auth dialog actually paints content within its 14-row budget, that a list scrolled to its end exposes the newly fitting earlier rows after expansion, and that a 14-row provider dialog with the tested error still paints the second fitting option. Confirm that the existing provider-update prompt test remains intact.

### How to verify

Run the three affected CLI test suites with `CI=true`. Inspect the test names and skipped count: render-only and mocked-list cases must execute; stdin-dependent cases retain the existing environment guard. A local mutation check should fail when the height forwarding, scroll reclamp, or multi-option viewport is deliberately removed, and return to normal after restoration.

### Evidence (Before & After)

This is a test-only change with no product UI change; screenshots are N/A.

- The old input-driven navigation selection executed zero tests under the Windows/CI guard; its filtered run reported 36 skipped. This is not passing behavioral evidence.
- The updated three suites: 43 passed, 24 skipped, 67 total on Windows with `CI=true`. The queued provider-update prompt test executed and passed as well.
- Targeted ESLint and Prettier checks passed. An independent read-only review found no substantive issue in the three-file patch.

Mutation checks caught each named regression: removing height forwarding fails the row budget, removing the reclamp fails because Item 5 is absent, and forcing a one-item viewport fails because the second option is absent. The original resize test survived the reclamp mutation due to remounting; the provider-wrapper correction makes it fail for the intended reason. All temporary mutations were restored byte-for-byte. The full workspace build completed before that final test-fixture-only correction; the final clean three-suite rerun again passed 43 tests with 24 skipped. Final `npm run typecheck`, including the integration-test typecheck, passed after the correction. Final targeted ESLint and Prettier checks also passed.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Unit suites executed: 43 passed / 24 skipped |
| Linux | Not tested |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node 24.20.0. Local CLI package unit tests; no live provider request or interactive Linux/macOS TUI session was executed.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: test expectations can become coupled to layout behavior; the retained assertions target the reported budget and reclamp regressions without duplicating the scrolling arithmetic.
- Not validated / out of scope: Linux/macOS interactive navigation; other open findings in #15819; no claim that skipped stdin tests passed.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none. Production source, settings and runtime behavior are unchanged.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15819. Addresses R1-7, R2-2 and R2-3 only; the tracking issue must stay open for the remaining findings.

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## What this PR does

补充 provider 对话框受限高度、窗口扩大后的滚动偏移重新收敛，以及保留另一项能容纳的选项的回归覆盖。对应 #15819 的 R1-7、R2-2、R2-3。本轮同步当前主干，并保留其 provider-update 队列提示测试。

## Why it's needed

原导航断言猜测哪些标签可见，而且位于 Windows/CI 会跳过的输入可靠性 guard 之内，既不能证明 CI 覆盖，也不能准确描述实际滚动窗口。因此移除这些断言，把选项可见性回归放在已有的仅渲染预算测试中；对话框管理测试使用局部 actions，不修改共享 helper。扩窗测试在重新渲染时保留相同 Provider 结构，确保验证的是已挂载组件的更新，而不是重新挂载后的初始计算。

## Reviewer Test Plan

确认受限 auth 对话框确实绘制内容并保持在 14 行内；列表从末尾扩窗后显示新能容纳的较早行；带已测试错误文案的 14 行对话框仍绘制第二项。确认主干原有 provider-update 队列测试保留。

### How to verify

在 CLI 包目录以 `CI=true` 执行三个相关测试套件。核对实际测试名及跳过数量：仅渲染和模拟列表用例必须执行，stdin 用例保留现有平台限制。临时移除高度透传、滚动收敛或多选项视口时，对应变异测试应失败；恢复后回到正常结果。

### Evidence (Before & After)

本 PR 只改测试，不改变产品 UI；截图为 N/A。

- 原输入导航定向运行实际执行零项，Windows/CI guard 使其报告 36 skipped，不能当作行为已验证。
- 更新后的三个套件：Windows、`CI=true` 下 43 passed、24 skipped，共 67 项。主干 provider-update 队列测试也实际执行并通过。
- 定向 ESLint、Prettier 通过；独立只读审阅未发现这三个文件差异中的实质问题。

变异检查分别捕获了三个目标回归：移除高度透传会超出预算；移除滚动收敛会缺少 Item 5；强制只显示一项会缺少第二选项。原扩窗测试曾因重新挂载而未能发现变异，Provider 包装修正后才按预期失败。所有临时变异均逐字节恢复。完整工作区构建在最后这项仅涉及测试 fixture 的修正前完成，正常三个套件复验仍为 43 passed / 24 skipped，修正后的 `npm run typecheck`（含集成测试类型检查）通过，最终定向 ESLint 和 Prettier 也通过。

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | 未测试 |
| Windows | 已执行单元套件：43 passed / 24 skipped |
| Linux | 未测试 |

### Environment (optional)

Windows、Node 24.20.0。本地 CLI 包单元测试；未执行真实 provider 请求或 Linux/macOS 交互 TUI。

## Risk & Scope

- 风险或取舍：布局断言可能与实现耦合；保留的断言针对已报告的预算和滚动回归，不复制滚动窗口计算公式。
- 未验证或范围外：Linux/macOS 交互导航；#15819 其他开放发现；不把跳过的 stdin 测试算作通过。
- 破坏性变化或迁移：无。生产源码、设置和运行行为不变。

## Linked Issues

Refs #15819。仅处理 R1-7、R2-2、R2-3，不自动关闭仍有其他未完成项的跟踪 issue。

</details>

prs.title: feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Adds one read-only request for complete live-session snapshots from 1–20 explicitly selected registered workspaces. Each workspace keeps its own canonical identity, catalog version, and independent success or error result. The new request shares the existing single-workspace snapshot and catalog-cache reconciliation logic. A distinct capability and TypeScript SDK method let clients opt in with cancellation and timeout support.

## Why it's needed

Clients showing several workspaces currently make one live-state HTTP request per workspace on every refresh. The recently added batch session catalog can read persisted history, so it is not a suitable high-frequency execution-state endpoint. This API lets clients fetch the same authoritative in-memory state in one request, while preserving the existing single-workspace route and per-session SSE.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Start a local daemon with a primary workspace, register a trusted secondary workspace, then send one batch request containing both IDs and an unknown selector. Expect two full snapshots and one explicit `workspace_not_found` member in input order, with `Cache-Control: no-store`. Confirm malformed bodies fail with HTTP 400, an untrusted or transitioning workspace fails only its own member, and the capability is advertised. Change a live session between running, waiting, and idle without advancing its catalog version; every batch snapshot should still reflect the current state. Confirm the SDK makes one authenticated native REST request and preserves abort and timeout behavior. Older daemons should continue to use the single-workspace route after callers preflight capabilities.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A (HTTP and SDK change; no TUI change). The local daemon returned two workspace snapshots and one explicit unknown-workspace error in a single POST.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ Build, typecheck, bundle, focused tests, and local HTTP E2E passed; the large server test file showed unrelated intermittent failures |
| 🪟 Windows | Not tested locally |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64: frozen install/build/bundle, typecheck, focused tests, and daemon HTTP E2E passed |

### Environment (optional)

Node 22.23.1 on macOS arm64 and `dev` Linux x86_64, each with an isolated daemon on a dynamically assigned loopback port. The global `qwen` binary was unavailable for the pre-change CLI dry-run; the absence of this route was confirmed in the current base source.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: A batch is not atomic across workspaces. Each successful member is capped at 512 KiB and an oversized member gets an explicit error.
- Not validated / out of scope: Web Shell still polls workspaces separately until a client migration adopts the new capability; no model-driven live session was created in the HTTP E2E. Windows was not tested locally.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: None. Clients preflight `workspace_session_live_state_batch` and retain the existing single-workspace path for older daemons.

Design: [English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## Linked Issues

Closes #12511

<details>
<summary>中文说明</summary>

## 本 PR 的改动

新增一个只读请求，一次获取 1–20 个显式选定、已注册 workspace 的完整会话运行状态快照。每个 workspace 独立返回规范化身份、目录版本及成功或错误结果。新请求与单 workspace 接口共用快照生成和目录缓存校准逻辑。独立 capability 和 TypeScript SDK 方法支持客户端按能力接入，并支持取消与超时。

## 为什么需要

同时展示多个 workspace 的客户端目前每次刷新都要逐 workspace 发起运行状态 HTTP 请求。近期增加的批量会话目录可能读取持久历史，不适合高频查询执行状态。新接口让客户端通过一次请求获取同样的权威内存状态，保留原单 workspace 路由和逐会话 SSE。

## 评审验证计划

### 如何验证

启动包含 primary workspace 的本地 daemon，注册可信的 secondary workspace，再用一次批量请求查询两个 ID 和一个未知 selector。预期按输入顺序得到两个完整快照和一个明确的 `workspace_not_found` 成员，响应包含 `Cache-Control: no-store`。确认无效请求体返回 HTTP 400，不可信或过渡中的 workspace 只影响自身成员，且 capability 已公布。在目录版本不变时使会话在运行、等待和空闲之间切换，每次快照都应反映当前状态。确认 SDK 只发送一次带鉴权的原生 REST 请求，并保留取消与超时行为。旧 daemon 的调用方应预检能力，继续使用单 workspace 路由。

### 前后证据

不适用（HTTP 与 SDK 改动，无 TUI 变化）。本地 daemon 实测一次 POST 返回两个 workspace 快照及一个未知 workspace 的明确错误。

### 测试平台

|     OS     | 状态 |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  | ⚠️ 构建、类型检查、打包、聚焦测试和本地 HTTP E2E 通过；大型 server 测试文件出现无关的间歇性失败 |
| 🪟 Windows | 本地未测试 |
|  🐧 Linux  | ✅ `dev` x86_64：锁文件安装/构建/打包、类型检查、聚焦测试与 daemon HTTP E2E 均通过 |

### 环境

在 macOS arm64 和 `dev` Linux x86_64 上使用 Node 22.23.1，各自启动使用动态 loopback 端口的隔离 daemon。全局 `qwen` 命令不可用，无法进行改动前 CLI dry-run；已从当前基线源码确认该路由不存在。

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：批量结果不保证跨 workspace 原子性；每个成功成员上限为 512 KiB，超限会返回明确错误。
- 未验证或范围外：Web Shell 在后续客户端迁移前仍逐 workspace 轮询；HTTP E2E 未创建由模型驱动的运行会话；未在本地运行 Windows 测试。
- 破坏性变更或迁移说明：无。客户端预检 `workspace_session_live_state_batch`，旧 daemon 保留现有单 workspace 路径。

设计文档：[English](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.md) · [简体中文](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/blob/codex/batch-workspace-live-state/docs/design/daemon-batch-session-live-state.zh-CN.md)

## 关联 Issue

Closes #12511

</details>

auto_merge.commit_title: feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots (#12513)
auto_merge.commit_message:
* feat(serve): batch workspace session live-state snapshots

* test(serve): include batch live-state capability in integration baseline

* fix(serve): close review gaps in the batch session live-state route (#12513)

Index POST /sessions/live-state in the REST reference's persisted-catalog
row so the docs contract sees the protocol section, give the batch route the
single-workspace route's server-side records (routing-failure warn on
untrusted members, daemonLog error on unexpected bridge failures), make the
mid-batch disconnect guard observable with an AbortController and a
macrotask yield between members, and move the duplicated member-failure,
generation-currency, and bound literals into workspace-route-runtime for
both plural batch routes. Six tests pin the new witnesses.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(serve): align live-state scope docs and pin batch route guards (#12513)

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* test(cli): pin grouped REST doc rows against bare SDK names and column shifts

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* test(cli): fail closed on grouped REST doc rows and ambiguous SDK qualifiers

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* test(serve): pin documented live-state batch bounds against silent drift (#12513)

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* test(cli): isolate the suite from the operator's settings home (#12513)

The autofix verification gate runs the packages/cli suite with the host's
real HOME on a machine shared with other jobs. A malformed
$HOME/.qwen/settings.json there (observed content: "X") makes every
operator-settings reader fail closed at once — readOperatorSettingsScopes
is designed to refuse a corrupted policy file — and one such file failed
408 tests across 15 files in the measured gate rejection.

Pin a private empty QWEN_HOME per test-file process in the suite setup
when the environment did not select one, following the file's existing
doctrine for operator-owned environment. Tests that exercise QWEN_HOME
set, stub, or delete it themselves. settings.test.ts keys every
user-settings and .env path off a mocked os.homedir, so it now deletes
an ambient QWEN_HOME explicitly; with any ambient value set, 13 of its
tests fail regardless of this change.

* test(cli): harden the QWEN_HOME suite pin and batch maxima test (#12513)

- Pin on truthiness so an ambient empty QWEN_HOME no longer falls
  through to $HOME/.qwen, matching every production reader.
- Sweep the pinned home from afterAll instead of an 'exit' listener
  that vitest workers never fire (51 leaked dirs on src/config -> 0).
- Restore QWEN_DEBUG_LOG_FILE around loadCliConfig tests so the debug
  logger's fire-and-forget writes stop racing the sweep.
- Witness that the suite never resolves settings from the ambient
  $HOME/.qwen, and assert member shape in the 20-selector maxima half
  so twenty failed members cannot read as twenty snapshots.

* test(cli): keep AppContainer store work off the pinned per-file QWEN_HOME (#12513)

* test(managed-agent): settle fresh group leaders before age-judged sweeps (#12513)

A just-forked process can read in ps with procps's negative-elapsed
wraparound (e.g. 441077234-00:18:40), which parsePsElapsed deliberately
leaves undatable. An undatable leader judges every worker/group identity
'unknown', so an unwitnessed sweep conservatively holds the live process
and rejects unproven — flaking the real-process sweep tests within
milliseconds of the spawn. settledGroupTable now also waits for the
leader's row to be datable, and the four sweep sites that judged a fresh
process without the guard use it.

* fix(cli): keep the QWEN_HOME test pin unconditional and alive for the process lifetime (#12513)

The conditional pin honored an ambient QWEN_HOME, so agent-gate vitest
runs read and wrote the operator's live settings home; the teardown
sweep then deleted the live pin while un-awaited extension-store work
was still reading it, turning Test (ubuntu-latest) red on ENOENT. Pin
unconditionally, keep the pin for the process lifetime, reap stale pins
by age at setup, await the floated extensions-list handler, and add
teardown, pin, reaper, and memory-only-contract witnesses.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* fix(cli): keep the QWEN_HOME teardown witness inside test-setup.ts (#12513)

The previous commit registered the pin teardown witness as a second
setupFiles entry in packages/cli/vitest.config.ts, which deterministic
verification rejects as CI/verification machinery outside the PR
footprint. Revert vitest.config.ts and fold the witness into
test-setup.ts itself: vitest runs root-level afterAll hooks in reverse
registration order, so the hook registered immediately after the pin
runs last among this file's root hooks and still turns every file red
if a teardown sweep of the live pin is reintroduced below it
(mutation-probed). The separate witness setup file is deleted.

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

Co-authored-by: Qwen-Coder <qwen-coder@alibabacloud.com>

* test(integration): raise the installed distribution case ceiling

The tui-parity installed-distribution darwin-x64 leg failed on the
npx-lifecycle-enabled no-relaunch-fallback case with "Test timed out in
120000ms" (run 40537979533, job 122316223603). The five preceding cases
averaged ~117s on that host, right at the ceiling: startup alone can
spend the whole 90s ready-prompt budget there (#15677) and the /about
retry window is another 90s, so 120s cannot contain a healthy case.

Raise the per-case ceiling to 240s and keep the budget helper's note in
sync.

prs.title: fix(auth): preserve navigation hints in compact provider menus
prs.body:
## What this PR does

Keeps the complete navigation hint visible in compact provider submenus by wrapping it and reserving its actual row count. The existing height gate still leaves room for a selectable option. Provider selection, authentication handling and the main-menu terms link are unchanged.

Codex assisted with implementation, tests and verification. This is a draft while clean upstream build/typecheck and CI remain outstanding.

## Why it's needed

At 36 columns, the compact submenu truncates the end of the navigation hint, hiding “Esc to go back”. Simply enabling wrapping without reserving the extra row can instead exceed a short dialog's height budget. This change addresses both parts of the same layout defect.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Open `/auth`, enter Third-party Providers, and check a 36-column dialog with both 14-row and 6-row budgets. The full navigation hint should be readable, a provider option should remain present, and rendered rows must not exceed the budget. Check the 100-column control and the main-menu terms link at both widths.

The two focused auth suites passed **17 tests**, with **24 existing stdin-dependent tests skipped** by the repository's Windows guard; all five new regression cases executed. A separate real-Ink observation recorded the before/after submenu frames. Independent mutation checks revert truncation and footer-row accounting separately, so text visibility and height accounting are tested independently. Exact commands and results are provided in the separate verification comment.

### Evidence (Before & After)

Actual Ink frame excerpts at 36 columns / 14 rows:

```text
Before — 11 rendered rows; the return instruction is missing:
│ Enter to select, ↑↓ to navigate… │

After — 12 rendered rows; the complete instruction is visible:
│ Enter to select, ↑↓ to navigate, │
│  Esc to go back                  │
```

The render probe uses a transparent observer around the real selector to invoke its existing selection callback. It renders the real AuthDialog and Ink layout; it does not claim an interactive PTY keyboard session, live authentication or model calls.

### Tested on

| OS | Status |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | Not tested |
| Windows | Focused component/layout verification |
| Linux | Not locally tested; upstream CI pending |

### Environment (optional)

Windows, Node 24.22.1, Vitest 3.2.7, the original package test configuration and setup, reused dependencies with the same pinned lockfile. Focused lint, formatting and whitespace checks pass. Full workspace build/bundle/preflight is not claimed. The normal CLI no-emit typecheck remains blocked by missing/stale workspace declarations in this reused environment; the diagnostics are disclosed in the verification comment.

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: a multi-row hint leaves fewer rows for visible provider choices; existing scrolling and minimum-option budgeting remain in place.
- Not validated / out of scope: full workspace build/preflight, native PTY keyboard navigation, authentication, Linux/macOS local execution, and the other deferred findings.
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; no new settings or translation keys.

## Linked Issues

Refs #15819, **R1-5 only**. This does not close the other follow-ups or duplicate #15843's separate test coverage.

让紧凑提供商子菜单中的完整导航提示换行显示，并按实际行数预留空间。原有高度门槛继续保证至少一个选项可显示。提供商选择、认证处理和主菜单服务条款链接保持不变。

Codex 协助实现、测试与验证。干净环境的完整上游构建、类型检查和 CI 尚未完成，因此先提交草稿。

## 修改原因

## 审阅者测试计划

### 验证方式

### 证据（修复前后）

上方代码块是实际 36 列、14 行预算下的 Ink 帧摘录：修复前共 11 行，提示在 navigate 后截断；修复后共 12 行，完整显示 Esc 返回说明。

观察器透明包装真实选择器并调用其原有选择回调，使用真实 AuthDialog 和 Ink 布局；没有宣称执行原生 PTY 键盘会话、真实认证或模型调用。

### 测试平台

| 操作系统 | 状态 |
| :---: | :---: |
| macOS | 未测试 |

## 风险与范围

- 主要风险或取舍：多行提示会减少可见提供商选项的行数；保留已有滚动和最少选项预算。
- 未验证或范围外：完整构建/preflight、原生 PTY 键盘导航、认证、Linux/macOS 本地执行及其他延期发现。
- 破坏性变更或迁移：无；不增加设置或翻译键。

## 关联 Issue

仅处理 #15819 的 **R1-5**，不关闭其余后续项，也不重复 #15843 的独立测试覆盖。

</details>

prs.title: fix(ci): route the E2E build job through the pool-first runner expression
prs.body:
## What this PR does

This PR moves the E2E workflow's shared build job onto the same pool-first runner routing every other job in this repository already uses: prefer the self-hosted ecs-qwen pool when it is enabled, fall back to hosted ubuntu otherwise. The job gains the standard self-hosted disk-floor gate that every pool-routed job carries, and the workflow meta-tests now pin the build's routing expression to be identical to the Linux leg's.

## Why it's needed

On 2026-10-28 the hosted ubuntu queue became the critical path for every post-merge E2E signal. The build job was the one job in the workflow pinned to a hosted-only label, and every test leg waits on its artifact. Hosted allocation that day degraded from 47 minutes (run created 02:19 UTC, build started 03:06) to 2 hours 52 minutes (run created 05:26 UTC, build started 08:18), so each main push piled up a queued E2E run while the 300+ runner self-hosted pool sat mostly idle: 15 push runs plus the nightly queued at once, none schedulable. One shared build per push is negligible load for the pool, and the hosted fallback remains for the disabled-pool configuration.

## Reviewer Test Plan

### How to verify

Confirm the build job now carries the same routing expression as the Linux test leg (the meta-test asserts byte equality, so they cannot drift apart) and that it gained the standard self-hosted disk-floor gate before its install step. Expected on the next main push after merge: the E2E build starts on an ecs-qwen runner immediately instead of queueing behind hosted ubuntu; the hosted ubuntu fallback still applies when the pool is disabled. The workflow meta-tests cover both contract points locally.

### Evidence (Before & After)

N/A — CI routing change, no user-visible UI.

### Tested on

|     OS     | Status |
| :--------: | :----: |
|  🍏 macOS  |   ✅   |
| 🪟 Windows |   N/A  |
|  🐧 Linux  |   ⚠️   |

### Environment (optional)

Meta-tests only: `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts` on the five suites that parse this workflow (e2e-workflow, ci-platform-lanes, no-ak-integration-ci, ready-prompt-budget, sdk-java-workflow) — 326 passed, 9 skipped (pre-existing skips). Prettier and ESLint clean on both touched files.

<!-- pr-evidence -->

| Check | Command | Result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| e2e.yml meta-tests | `npx vitest run --config ./scripts/tests/vitest.config.ts scripts/tests/e2e-workflow.test.js` | 130/130 passed |
| sibling suites parsing e2e.yml | same config over ci-platform-lanes, no-ak-integration-ci, ready-prompt-budget, sdk-java-workflow | all passed (326 total across the five files) |
| routing expression parity | diff of the build job's runs-on vs the Linux leg's | byte-identical |
| formatting/lint | `npx prettier --check` both files, `npx eslint scripts/tests/e2e-workflow.test.js` | clean |

## Risk & Scope

- Main risk or tradeoff: the build now competes with PR CI for pool slots; one build per main push against 300+ runners is negligible, and the disk-floor gate matches the pool's standard hygiene.
- Not validated / out of scope: an actual pool execution of this exact workflow head (requires merge to main or a feat/e2e/* branch push; meta-tests cover the routing contract).
- Breaking changes / migration notes: none; when the pool is disabled via the existing repo variable the job falls back to hosted ubuntu exactly as before.

## Linked Issues

None. The 2026-10-28 hosted-ubuntu queueing episode that motivated this routing change is not tracked by any issue; it is recorded in `docs/design/e2e-build-once.md` ("Why the build left the hosted runner") with the wait figures and probe run [40935790797](https://github.com/QwenLM/qwen-code/actions/runs/40935790797). The previous `Refs #15751` pointed at an unrelated merged PR.

## What this PR does Remove persisted public conversation snapshots and make bounded current-message paging the default for public Items, transcript, recent history and export. The canonical schema drops `ma_snapshot` and its public snapshot metadata, reducing business tables from 39 to 38; background snapshot construction, refresh and collection disappear. Native journal snapshots, canonical history, execution checkpoints, reader leases and recovery protection remain intact. Dependency #15865 is merged as `89d3aaea62af96849c4b9b7a2bc68e26347a7ac8` (final head `ca8970b84b96c6d3cc5f77fc43b577150a0944c8`). This PR now targets `main`, replaying only the snapshot-removal increment and preserving the dependency's coverage validation and smoke-fixture repairs. The user-authorized dependency condition for Ready for review is met; CI acceptance remains pending. ## Why it's needed The direct message pager makes a second persisted copy of conversation history unnecessary for the selected live-read/export behavior. Removing the table together with its readers, writers, retention paths and CSI inventory avoids obsolete SQL and repeated whole-history copies while preserving bounded reads and safe event-stream handoff. ## Reviewer Test Plan ### How to verify Initialize fresh matching Server/Broker state and confirm exactly 38 business tables with no public snapshot table or metadata. Read recent history and older pages, including equal first-sequence positions and numeric `after`; verify complete ordering, scope/direction/projection checks and current authorization on every request. Change message bodies during export and confirm membership remains bounded by the first request while content stays live. A lagging initial export must return retryable pending; transcript must resume SSE from actual materialized coverage without skipping the unprojected tail. Exercise replay-floor advancement/rebuild, reader-versus-GC interleavings, retirement and strict CSI validation, and retain native journal snapshot/recovery checks.
